Download Your e-Aadhaar Instantly Get your digitally signed, password-protected Aadhaar PDF on your phone or computer in just 2 minutes. Secure and valid everywhere. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Please use this service carefully. LIMITED TIME OFFER Free Document Update Is your Aadhaar 10 years old? Upload Proof of Identity Address documents online for FREE till 14 06 2026. Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . (Note If you visit an offline Aadhaar Center, you will have to pay 50.) Which Documents do you need to upload? You need to upload one document for Identity and one for Address. Common valid documents include 1. Proof of Identity (PoI) To verify your Name and Photo. PAN Card e-PAN Driving License Passport Voter ID Ration Card (with Photo) Mark Sheet School Certificate 2. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. documents: Is Atheism Still Taboo? 5 Indian Non-Believers Tell Us Their Stories What the mysterious is I do not know. I do not call it God because God has come to mean much that I do not believe in. I find myself incapable of thinking of a deity or of any unknown supreme power in anthropomorphic terms, and the fact that many people think so is continually a source of surprise to me. Any idea of a personal God seems very odd to me. The last place you d expect to hear a quote this outrightly ungodly is 20th century India. The last person you d expect to say it without fear for his own life (or at least, the next election) is the Prime Minister of India. At a time when atheists are being killed for expressing their thoughts on the subject of god or the lack thereof it s hard to imagine that just 70 years earlier, Jawaharlal Nehru was able to make such a statement publicly in our country. For all our lauded progress in the years since, modern India remains a land firmly rooted in theism. It is a land of multiple religions, a thousand gods, a million doctrines, and a billion believers. With a religiously-charged populace who have no qualms resorting to violence in defence of their gods, few would argue that religious sentiment does not lie at the heart of almost everything we hold dear right from movies to McDonald s. How else does one explain entire states being held hostage by thousands of rioters angered by the fact that their Godman, Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh, was convicted of rape? Or that the meat we eat is becoming a political pawn, betting on our basest instincts to turn against each other where our religious interests differ? But while we re embroiled in similar everyday conversations, furiously debating the rights of the religious minorities of this country, there s a tendency to ignore the smallest, most minuscule minority of them all atheists. To understand who they are, we need to look at the numbers. According to the2011 census, 29 lakh people refused to state their religion, but only33,000 peopledeclared themselves atheists a mere 0.0027 of the population. For a country of 1.2 billion people, that number, quite simply, is mind-boggling. As shocking as that is, it doesn t take an expert to know that logically speaking, the number is far from the truth. The way our administrative system and society is set up contributes significantly to this distorted picture. To better understand the experiences of those who openly disbelieve, we spoke to five Indian atheists about their journeys. It s pertinent to note that atheism is not officially recognised in India. Hypothetically, if a child were to be born to atheist parents, he or she would be considered as belonging to the religion of his or her parents birth for administrative purposes. So whether you like it or not, you will grow up, live a life, and die belonging to the religion of your birth in this country. Just ask Ira Godbole. Born a Hindu into a relatively religious family that followed all the customs and rituals, religion played a huge role in her life even as recently as five years ago. It was a rather restrictive environment, she admits. My education was never hindered, sure, but things like going out at night, eating out, wearing western clothes, and the like were dictated. As a teenager, I didn t understand a lot of it, but I thought that I was doing the right thing by playing along. The 20-year-old life sciences student says that through extensive reading and exposure to the intricacies of science, she eventually realised that it didn t matter who prayed and who didn t, because god wasn t the explanation for anything. She also struggled to forge an alliance with the idea that religion was any indication of moral uprightness. Hinduism says that the goddess of education is Saraswati. And yet, how many women are deprived of a basic primary education in this country? Godbole explains the hypocrisy that began to wear down her conditioning. The reality of our religious, apparently morally upright country is one where goddesses have a special place but women were treated like secondary citizens. Furthermore, hundreds of thousands of kilos of food is wasted on deities when millions starve to death every year. If the picture they paint of an all-loving, all-merciful god was real, this wouldn t happen. Unfortunately, however, it s this apparent link between religiousness and goodness that makes it so difficult for atheists to be honest with strangers or family. Violent backlashes are all too possible and familiar. On Conditioning, Epiphanies And The Subsequent Struggle With Identity Every child is programmed to mimic, follow, and learn the way of living from his her parents. Whether it s being encouraged (or forced) to visit a temple on Mondays as a devotee of Lord Shiva, or imitating your parents for the fifth namaz of the day, the religion of your birth is foundational for most in their formative years. Sara Hussain, a 24-year-old writer based in Mumbai, born into a Muslim family can attest to this. She was taught how to pray, fast, and celebrate Eid from an early age although she never took interest nor found peace or joy in any of the religious activities that she was made to indulge in through her childhood. Over the years, I would find some excuse or way out of saying my namaz or fasting. I recall my father getting upset about it on occasions, especially when he wasn t around to oversee it. When I was in my teen years, I d always get my period during Ramzaan which gave me an excuse to not fast. Still, coming out was never really a part of her thinking. I think it was in my first year in college that I openly said that I don t believe in God, Hussain says.. I was generally hesitant earlier, but I met an incredible woman that year, my professor Rina Ramdev. She taught me a lot more than just English Literature, classical studies, philosophy or literary theory. I never saw a reason to believe in God , nor was I mystically provided one, I didn t see the rationale in having blind faith in something I could not see, nor feel a presence of in my life. I ve been pretty vocal about my dislike for organised religion and my own beliefs since then. Sara s experiences also shed light on how trivial your own beliefs can seem when set against a backdrop of overwhelming religious belief. Despite never really feeling othered as the only Muslim kid in her batch, she has a different story to tell of the real world . House-hunting in Bombay post college made me hyper aware of my religion, she admits, and it didn t matter whether or not I was practicing, let alone believed in, it. There is a perception involved and my last name, Hussain, tends to set me up for failure before I even try. The reality of her situation forces us to acknowledge the triviality of distancing oneself from religion in first place. Is there any merit at all? And what of people who weren t born into generations of religious belief, do they face the same reality? Religion And Culture A Coalescence To understand it a little more holistically, we spoke with Raag Mathur Ramdev. One of the rare few to be born into a semi-atheistic household, yet undoubtedly influenced by the religious traditions around him otherwise, too. Irrespective of how I was brought up, it d be foolish to claim that the dominance of the Hindu religion didn t affect me as I was growing up, he explains. For example, when I was in school, I remember watching my classmates come to class after a pooja. I would think the tika and the orange thread around their wrist looked very cool because it was something I personally only got once or twice a year. As I grew older, however, I attempted to be more reflective, so as to determine what parts of the Hindu religion affected me. Today, one of my favourite texts, in fact, is the Mahabharata, and I love it because it is filled with flawed characters. For Susanne James, however, it really boils down to priorities a sentiment many we spoke with can relate to. I tend to follow my family s customs during festivals, and I humour my mother blessing me each morning, and asking me to touch our shrine before I leave, says the 23-year-old literature student who has grown up in an orthodox Syrian christian household. I do this because I don t want to offend the people I care about. Religion may not be important to me, but it is to them. When I m asked to do small things like this that don t impact my life in any way, I see no reason not to do it. At the same time, I love churches, the peace associated with them, the architecture and the history. I d willingly go to a new church or temple or wherever I m allowed access for this. Sara adds her own anecdotes in support of the sentiment, All religions have their faults and follies, and my religion of birth has those too, she says, However, zakaat is one aspect of Islam I admire a lot. There are other things, like saying alhamdulillah after a sneeze, but that s more out of habit than anything else. Another would be greeting relatives with salaam , but that itself is more out of respect than habit, and it s pretty much for the sake and comfort of my parents. I don t really mind it, anyway. Atheism And The Indian Law Today The question is if any of this matters at all if culturally, you enjoy no benefits, and legally, no protection. Freedom of religion is a fundamental right in India freedom from it, not so much. As mentioned earlier, atheism is not officially recognised in our country. While apostasy, thankfully, is a right, there are no specific laws that cater to atheists, or help them identify as one. Try filling out a municipal form, and you ll fail to find atheist or even none, as an option under religion . Try filling out your child s birth certificate, and you ll meet the same fate. When it comes to marriage and divorce, the Special Marriage Act of 1954 is your best bet, albeit with complications of its own. As for legal inheritance, you have no choice but to follow the laws of your religion of birth, whether you like it, or not. So no matter what our beliefs, we re all shackled to the beliefs of the majority anyway. This becomes even more pertinent when you consider that identifying as an atheist In a country full of people who re obsessed with religion and easily offended, can be seriously dangerous. Just ask the family of H Farook, a 31-year-old atheist who,was savagely hacked to death by a religious mob in Tamil Naduearlier this year for refusing to bow down to the dogmas of faith. Furthermore, it s almost impossible to engage in any form of religious discourse thanks to archaic blasphemy laws. Try criticising a religion in public, and you stand a chance to be jailed for three years for insulting a religion or religious beliefs of a class under sec. 153(a) or sec. 295(a). To sum it up, it s 2017, and yet, we live in a country where religious doctrines are continually used to twist the law of the land. Since the fear of persecution or a violent backlash is very real, it s no surprise that we barely see Indians identifying as atheists. Furthermore, there is often disbelief of the existence of atheists in the country. Tell someone you don t believe in god, and they ll view you with contempt, and question your character and morals. Without mincing words, there have been instances where religious fanatics have come to metaphorical and literal blows over their differing ideologies. However, what they collectively agree is that the only thing worse than believing in another religion is not believing in religion at all. In my opinion, religion should be a lifestyle choice, but more than that, religion needs to be personal, says Sara. It can t be politicised, nor made into a doctrine for the masses. Over the years I ve observed more and more people being put off by religion because of the politics that surround it to a point whereparody religions like Dinkoismthat mock believers illogical and absurd practices are gaining popularity too. The point is, seventy years after we had an atheist leader, we re nowhere close to accepting atheism as a concept, let alone a fundamental right. Sure, cultural cognitive dissonance on the part of atheists doesn t help, but that religious dissent isn t tolerated by our peers, family, or the law is worrisome. The question we need to ask is, if freedom of religion is a fundamental right, why can t freedom of being irreligious be one too? More importantly, if people are losing sleep and in more recent cases, their lives due to beliefs and non-beliefs, isn t it imperative to try and find a golden mean? Some names have been changed to protect identities. documents: नरेंद्र दामोदरदास मोदी (Narendra Damodardas Modi) भारत के 14वें प्रधानमंत्री हैं. 2014, 2019 और 2024 लोकसभा चुनाव में बीजेपी के जीत के बाद नरेंद्र मोदी लगातार तीसरी बार प्रधानमंत्री बनें. साल 2014 लोकसभा चुनावों में भारतीय जनता पार्टी की जीत के बाद, नरेंद्र मोदी ने 26 मई को पहली बार प्रधानमंत्री का पद ग्रहण किया (Prime Minister of India). उत्तर प्रदेश के वाराणसी लोकसभा क्षेत्र से सांसद चुने गए (MP Varanasi) नरेंद्र मोदी की अगुवाई में 1984 के बाद पहली बार किसी एक राजनीतिक दल को अकेले लोकसभा में बहुमत मिला था. 1947 में देश की आजादी के बाद पैदा होने वाले वह पहले भारतीय पीएम हैं. एनडीए की 2019 के लोकसभा चुनाव में जीत के बाद 2019 में पीएम के रूप में मोदी का दूसरा कार्यकाल शुरू हुआ. 2024 लोकसभा चुनाव में जीत के बाद मोदी सरकार ने हैट्रिक लगाई. प्रधानमंत्री बनने से पहले, नरेंद्र मोदी ने एक दशक से अधिक समय तक गुजरात के मुख्यमंत्री के रूप में कार्य किया (Chief Minister Gujarat). नरेंद्र मोदी का जन्म 17 सितंबर, 1950 को गुजरात के मेहसाणा जिले के वडनगर (Vadnagar) में हुआ था (Narendra Modi Age). उनके माता - पिता, हीराबा और दामोदरदास मोदी थे (Narendra Modi Parents). हालांकि नरेंद्र मोदी का राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ से पहला परिचय आठ साल की उम्र में ही हुआ, लेकिन 1970 के दशक में वे आरएसएस (Narendra Modi RSS) के पूर्णकालिक कार्यकर्ता बन गए. वे 80 के दशक के अंत में भारतीय जनता पार्टी में शामिल हुए (Narendra Modi BJP). साल 2001 में, उन्होंने गुजरात के मुख्यमंत्री के रूप में पदभार संभाला, वे इस पद पर 2014 तक बने रहे. 2019 में भारतीय जनता पार्टी (BJP) को मिली जीत के बाद, बतौर प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी का दूसरा कार्यकाल शुरू हुआ. वे भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस से इतर, लगातार दो बार जीत दर्ज कर भारत के प्रधानमंत्री बनने वाले दूसरे राजनेता हैं. उनका ऑफिशियल ट्विटर हैंडल narendramodi है और फेसबुक पेज का नाम Narendra Modi है. इंस्टाग्राम पर वह narendramodi यूजरनेम से एक्टिव हैं संसद में Saayoni Ghosh का बड़ा यू-टर्न, अब Modi सरकार का करेंगी समर्थन? लोकसभा में एंटी पेपर लीक विधेयक पर चर्चा के दौरान सरकार और विपक्ष के बीच तीखी बहस देखने को मिली. इसी बीच सांसद सायोनी घोष का नाम भी चर्चा में रहा, क्योंकि उन्हें इस विधेयक पर बोलने वाले सांसदों की सूची में शामिल किया गया है. सदन में पेपर लीक रोकने के उपायों, फास्ट ट्रैक अदालतों और शिक्षा व्यवस्था से जुड़े कई मुद्दों पर विस्तार से चर्चा हुई. एनसीपी प्रमुख शरद पवार ने पुणे के पवार ट्रस्ट के कार्यक्रम में प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी को न्योता देने की तैयारी की है, जिससे महाराष्ट्र के राजनीतिक समीकरण में बदलाव की अटकलें लगने लगी हैं. ममता की खास से मोदी की मुरीद तक... एनडीए मीटिंग में सायोनी घोष को कैसे हुआ फील गुड? CJP की सरकार को खुली चेतावनी, छात्रों पर कार्रवाई हुई तो दोबारा शुरु होगा आंदोलन! सुप्रीम कोर्ट के अंतरिम आदेश के बाद कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी ने अपनी आपत्ति दर्ज कराते हुए सरकार से छात्रों से जुड़े मामलों पर अपने पूर्व आश्वासनों का पालन करने की मांग की है. पार्टी का कहना है कि यदि प्रदर्शनकारियों के खिलाफ कार्रवाई जारी रही तो वह दोबारा शांतिपूर्ण आंदोलन शुरू करने पर विचार करेगी. फिलहाल मामला न्यायिक प्रक्रिया में है और सभी पक्षों की अगली कार्रवाई पर नजर बनी हुई है. PM Modi ने इंस्टाग्राम पर बनाया नया रिकॉर्ड, एक हफ्ते में जुड़े 40 लाख नए फॉलोअर्स! प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के आधिकारिक इंस्टाग्राम अकाउंट ने 10.5 करोड़ फॉलोअर्स का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है. हाल के दिनों में साझा किए गए उनके कई वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर व्यापक रूप से देखे और साझा किए गए. उपलब्ध आंकड़ों के अनुसार एक सप्ताह में उनके फॉलोअर्स की संख्या में उल्लेखनीय बढ़ोतरी दर्ज हुई है. हालांकि, इस वृद्धि के कारणों पर इंस्टाग्राम की ओर से कोई आधिकारिक जानकारी नहीं दी गई है. 'कैमरा नहीं, दिल का एंगल बदलिए', PM मोदी के इंस्टाग्राम रील्स पर प्रियंका गांधी का तंज प्रियंका गांधी ने मॉनसून सत्र के दौरान संसद में पीएम मोदी पर तंज कसा. उन्होंने प्रधानमंत्री को सलाह दी कि वो इंस्टाग्राम रील्स के जरिए युवाओं का दिल जीतने की बजाय, अपने विचार बदलें. उन्होंने कहा कि अगर युवाओं का दिल जीतना है तो 'कैमरे का एंगल नहीं, दिल का एंगल बदलना होगा.' इंस्टाग्राम पर पीएम मोदी के फॉलोअर्स 10 करोड़ के पार, GenZ प्रोटेस्ट पर बनाए थे दो वर्टिकल वीडियोज प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने इंस्टाग्राम पर एक नया मुकाम हासिल कर लिया है. अब इंस्टाग्राम पर उनके 105 मिलियन (10.5 करोड़) फॉलोअर्स की संख्या पार हो चुकी है. इंस्टाग्राम पर हाल ही में उन्होंने CJP प्रदर्शन के चलते दो वीडियो पोस्ट किए थे, जिनपर मिलियन में लाइक हैं. पीएम मोदी ने बुलाई अहम बैठक, अमेरिका-ईरान तनाव के बीच वैश्विक संकट और सप्लाई चेन पर होगा मंथन प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी मंगलवार शाम को प्रमुख मंत्रालयों के सचिवों के साथ एक बैठक की अध्यक्षता करेंगे. बताया जा रहा है कि इस बैठक में ईरान-अमेरिका संघर्ष के कारण पैदा हुई वैश्विक स्थिति और भारत की रणनीतिक प्रतिक्रिया पर चर्चा होने की उम्मीद है. पीएम मोदी का वीडियो हटाने को लेकर सरकार सख्त, मेटा से पूछा क्या सवाल, जान िए फेसबुक से पीएम मोदी का वीडियो हटाने के मामले में भारत सरकार ने सख्ती दिखाई है. मेटा के ग्लोबल हेड को सरकार ने समन भेजा है. उधर, पीएम मोदी की पोस्ट हटाने के मामले में मेटा की ओर से माफी मांगी गई है. मेटा ने अपनी सफाई में कहा था कि टेक्नीकल गड़बड़ी के चलते पीएम मोदी का वीडियो हटा था. मेटा ने हटाया पीएम मोदी का वीडियो, बाद में दी सफाई मेटा ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी का फेसबुक पोस्ट हटाने पर सफाई देते हुए कहा कि यह एक तकनीकी Exodus 4 10,11And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, Iamnot eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant but Iamslow of speech, and of a slow tongue and said, He has done all things well!This declaration by the people echoes the creation narrative inGenesis 1, where God saw that everything He made was "very good." It suggests that Jesus, in His works, reflects the perfect and complete nature of God. The phrase "all things well" indicates not only the quality of Jesus' miracles but also His fulfillment of messianic expectations. This statement can be seen as an acknowledgment of Jesus' divine nature and His role as the Messiah who restores and redeems.He makes even the deaf hearThis miracle of healing the deaf is significant in the context ofIsaiah 35 5-6, which prophesies that in the time of the Messiah, "the ears of the deaf will be unstopped." By performing this miracle, Jesus is fulfilling Old Testament prophecy, demonstrating that He is the promised Messiah. The ability to make the deaf hear also symbolizes spiritual awakening and the opening of hearts to the message of the Gospel.and the mute speak! The healing of the mute is another fulfillment of messianic prophecy, as seen inIsaiah 35 6, where "the mute tongue will shout for joy." This miracle not only demonstrates Jesus' compassion and power but also serves as a sign of the in-breaking of God's kingdom. In a broader sense, it represents the restoration of communication between God and humanity, as Jesus enables those who were once spiritually mute to proclaim His praises. Jesus, the Creator in human flesh (John 1 3 Colossians 1 16), continues to do everything flawlessly. Unlike human leaders who often do some things well and others poorly, Christ s works are uniformly perfect (Psalm 18 30). This affirmation foreshadows believers eternal praise inRevelation 15 3, Great and marvelous are Your works, Lord God Almighty. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak! Isaiah 35 5-6promised that in Messiah s day the ears of the deaf will be unstopped, and the tongue of the mute will shout for joy. By fulfilling this prophecy literally, Jesus identifies Himself unmistakably as the promised Savior. documents: Save Share facebook x whatsapp-stroke copylink India's PM Narendra Modi greets supporters as he arrives at the BJP headquarters in New Delhi, India, May 4, 2026 Adnan Abidi Reuters By Nadim Asrar Published On 5 May 2026 5 May 2026 For the first time in its 46-year history, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi s Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has won the state of West Bengal, arguably the Hindu nationalist party s most consequential victory since 2014, the year Modi first came to power. The legislative assembly elections were held on several dates in April in West Bengal, three other Indian states Tamil Nadu, Assam and Kerala as well as in the federally-governed territory of Puducherry. Recommended Stories list of 4 items list 1 of 4 Hegemonic power How Modi s BJP won India s Bengal for the first time list 2 of 4 Cocktail of Hindutva and welfarism How Modi s BJP is wooing Assam voters list 3 of 4 Muslims the target? Fury as millions lose voting rights in India s Bengal list 4 of 4 India loses its last left-wing government after five decades end of list The BJP retained Assam for a third consecutive term, while the coalition it is a part of also returned to power in Puducherry. The southern state of Tamil Nadu saw the rise of yet another film star, following in the state s long tradition of cine icons turning into mass political leaders. Actor Joseph Vijay broke the stranglehold of two long-dominant state parties with a fledgling political outfit and is poised to become the next chief minister. In neighbouring Kerala, a communist government lost to its traditional rival, an Indian National Congress-led alliance a familiar election cycle in the state, which also marks the first time in 50 years that the left is not in control of any Indian state. But while each of these votes matters and we ll return to them the West Bengal outcome represents the biggest takeaway from Monday s verdict. A history that has defined India Bengal is where the story of Indian colonialism began after the Battle of Plassey in the mid-18th century, when the British East India Company defeated the Nawab of Bengal, transforming from a trading firm into the sword arm of British imperialism in South Asia. Advertisement Some 150 years later, the British partitioned Bengal in 1905 the first major instance of division along religious lines in modern South Asia. By separating the largely Muslim eastern regions from the Hindu-majority western districts, Lord Curzon, the then British viceroy, established a template in which religious identity could be mapped onto a territory and then mobilised politically. Although annulled in 1911, the partition of Bengal catalysed a new political consciousness in the region that took various forms during the anticolonial movement, producing national figures of all hues, including several Hindu nationalist ideologues, the most prominent of them being Shyama Prasad Mukherjee, founder of the BJP s precursor, the Bharatiya Jan Sangh. Mukherjee founded the Jan Sangh two years before his death in 1953 to advocate for a culturally united India. He opposed a special status granted to the Indian-administered Kashmir after India and Pakistan emerged as independent nations in 1947. Modi fulfilled Mukherjee s dream by scrapping the disputed region s partial autonomy weeks after coming into power for a second term in 2019. Addressing his party workers on Monday night, Modi said the West Bengal win would bring peace to his Mukherjee s soul . BJP supporters celebrate the Bengal victory near a counting station in Kolkata, India Piyal Adhikary EPA But despite its history of religious cleavages, Bengal displayed a much more complex post-independence political trajectory. It elected a communist government in 1977, which remained in power for a record 34 consecutive years before the Trinamool Congress (TMC), a centrist party led by the now-outgoing Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, brought it down in 2011. The state also remained relatively peaceful during some of the most tumultuous periods in modern India. In 1984, anti-Sikh riots erupted in many states following the assassination of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi by her Sikh bodyguards. An estimated 3,000 Sikhs were killed in the national capital, New Delhi. West Bengal remained peaceful. Eight years later, the state again remained a sanctuary from the nationwide bloodbath that erupted following the 1992 demolition of a Mughal-era mosque in Uttar Pradesh state by Hindu hardliners led by Modi s party. Will that sense of communal exceptionalism and relative harmony that has long characterised West Bengal remain intact under a BJP government? That is one of the big questions emerging from the election results. Lotus has bloomed the question is how West Bengal is home to nearly 100 million people, 27 percent of them Muslims. The BJP, riding on a combination of anti-incumbency sentiment against Banerjee and its own tried-and-tested anti-Muslim rhetoric, won a stunning 207 seats, reducing the TMC to 80 legislators in the 294-member assembly a remarkable rise for a party that until a decade ago had just three seats. Advertisement The lotus has bloomed in West Bengal! Modi posted on X on Monday afternoon, referring to the BJP s election symbol, even as Election Commission of India (ECI) officials were still counting the votes . He called it a historic victory , which will remain unforgettable , promising a politics of good governance in the state. The ECI, an autonomous constitutional body led by government-appointed bureaucrats, has faced severe scrutiny and criticism since 2014, with opposition parties and electoral watchdogs accusing it of vote theft, fraud, manipulation, and, more recently, of a controversial revision of electoral rolls that denied some 2.7 million people their voting rights in West Bengal. The ECI denies the allegations, but an analysis of voter deletions in West Bengal by SABAR Institute, a Kolkata-based independent research organisation, showed that Muslims were disproportionately affected, mainly in districts where they constitute a high percentage of the population and could have swayed the election. According to political commentator Yogendra Yadav, the deletion of 2.7 million votes amounts to 4.3 percent of votes cast in West Bengal, in an election where the BJP s lead over the TMC was about 5 percent. The question is inescapable If these 27 lakh 2.7 million persons were allowed to vote, how would it have affected the outcome? he asked in a column for the Indian Express newspaper on Tuesday, urging the opposition to stop legitimising curated election results that raise questions on the integrity of electoral processes. Banerjee, who stunningly lost her own seat, alleged the BJP looted more than 100 seats . The Election Commission is the BJP s commission, she told reporters in Kolkata, the state capital, promising to bounce back . Will BJP follow the Assam model in Bengal? The BJP s historic win in West Bengal follows a familiar election strategy, in which stirring up anti-Muslim sentiments is a central pillar. In their campaign speeches, its leaders, including Modi, accused Muslims of being Bangladeshi infiltrators as the party called for a Hindu consolidation to drive out the illegal immigrants from the state. As the BJP takes West Bengal, fears of a crackdown on allegedly illegal Muslim residents will be more pervasive. In a state famous for its roadside food stalls offering a wide range of fish and meat, including beef, delicacies, an insistence on and promotion of vegetarianism is difficult to rule out. BJP-led governments in several other states have tried to enforce rules around the sale and consumption of meat, especially beef. Only fish is likely to be an exception . A hardcore staple for both Hindus and Muslims, fish is not just a protein source in West Bengal it is also an integral marker of Bengali culture, with marriages and even religious rituals performed with it. To ward off people s fears about the BJP policing their food choices if it wins the election, many party leaders were seen campaigning with a fish in hand. Advertisement Modi appeared to have such fears in mind when he thanked the people of West Bengal on Monday for electing the BJP. Our double-engine government will ensure equal opportunities and respect for all sections of society, Modi posted on X, using a media-coined term, implying a political and administrative continuity between New Delhi and the BJP-ruled states that, according to the party, accelerates the formulation and implementation of government policies and prioritises their development. But Modi has often promised to work for all sections of society . His successful 2014 election campaign was built on the slogan Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas , which translates to Support for all, development for all . On the ground, though, it is a very different kind of double-engine government that the BJP has delivered in several states and one, in neighbouring Assam in particular, offers a glimpse of what could await West Bengal. Assam and West Bengal share 263km (163-mile) and 2,216km (1,377-mile) borders, respectively, with Bangladesh, a Muslim-majority country that declared its independence from Pakistan with India s military help in 1971. Long before colonial cartographers divided the subcontinent into its modern nation-states, people from present-day Bangladesh had been migrating to what is now Assam to work in its rice fields and tea estates. Today, one-third of Assam s 31 million residents are Muslim, the largest percentage among Indian states, a majority of them having historically migrated to the northeastern state in waves. These Bengali-origin Muslims, pejoratively called miyas , have been the target of xenophobic campaigns for decades that the BJP has championed since coming to power in the state in 2016. With 102 seats in the 126-member Assam assembly, Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma has returned with a larger majority than in 2021. The emphatic victory is likely to see a more hardline Sarma doubling down on his attacks on Muslims. The last five years saw him and his government demonising the community as infiltrators , evicting them from their lands and demolishing homes. A controversial gerrymandering exercise turned the state s large Muslim voter base much less influential than it was previously. Of the 19 legislators from the opposition Congress who won in Assam, 18 are Muslim a stark indication of the religious polarisation in the state. Sarma promised a more virulent crackdown in his campaign speeches this year, pledging to break the backbones of illegal Bangladeshi Muslims . He has committed to implementing a Uniform Civil Code, a polarising proposal that replaces religion-based personal laws. The BJP, in its manifesto, has also promised to pass laws related to the alleged forced religious conversion of people, and on the so-called love jihad , an unsubstantiated right-wing conspiracy theory that accuses Muslim men of entrapping Hindu women into marriages in order to convert them to Islam. Beyond West Bengal The southern state of Tamil Nadu one of India s most developed threw up a surprise. The state has a long history of film stars turning into politicians. Actor Vijay, who launched the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) party only two years ago, trounced the ruling Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK)-led alliance by winning 108 seats in the 234-member assembly. Like West Bengal s Banerjee, state Chief Minister MK Stalin also lost his seat a shock defeat for a leader whose government is credited with making Tamil Nadu the fastest growing economy in India at an impressive rate of 11 percent. Advertisement Vijay s rise breaks a decades-long duopoly of Tamil Nadu s two main Dravidian parties, which derive their names from a powerful movement against caste inequalities. The two Dravidian parties had also opposed attempts by north Indian-dominated parties to impose Hindi and its accompanying so-called upper-caste Hindu values on the non-Hindi speaking southern states. However, the 51-year-old actor is 10 seats short of a simple majority mark of 118 in the Tamil Nadu assembly and needs allies to form the government. According to media reports, the Congress and other regional parties are likely to join his government. TVK workers hold Vijay s photos as they celebrate the results in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, May 4, 2026 AP Photo In neighbouring Kerala, which boasts of developmental indices better than those of the United States, a familiar oscillation of power happened. The communist government led by Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan lost to an alliance led by the Congress, which won 101 of the 140 seats. Muslims, who, like West Bengal, form about 27 percent of the state s population, won one-fourth of the seats, including a first-time female MLA from the Indian Union Muslim League (IUML). Despite trying for decades, Modi s BJP has not been able to make a significant dent in Kerala and Tamil Nadu. But even in those two states, the BJP s vote percentage continues to rise. The BJP, with Modi as prime minister, has long faced accusations of backing crony capitalism. However, the party denies those claims. What is indisputable, though, is that billionaires seen as being close to the prime minister have won rights to more and more land, forests and mines in recent years. With Monday s results, the BJP s consolidation of power has grown. The party now governs or is part of the governing coalition in 21 of the country s 28 states. These states now make up nearly 80 percent of India s 1.4 billion people a phenomenon last seen in the 1960s when the Congress was at the peak of its power. Critics often call the BJP an election machine , with a total income of 712m, compared with nearly 96m for its closest national rival, the Congress, according to an assessment by the election watchdog Association of Democratic Reforms in 2025. It s a race between a Ferrari and a bicycle, as writer and activist Arundhati Roy had once said. Now that the machine has delivered one of the most significant results in India s recent electoral history, the state election results strengthen Modi midway through his third term. However, they also raise serious questions about whether India is turning more authoritarian. Is it moving towards one-party dominance? And will elections in the world s most populous democracy be free and fair any more?

Bombay High Court issues notice to Wakf board over Ambani's residence Bombay High Court today issued a notice to Wakf board to clarify its stand on the Mumbai residence of Reliance company chief Mukesh Ambani. Live TV Share Advertisement Bombay High Court Vidya Mumbai , UPDATED Jul 21, 2017 15 21 IST Bombay High Court today issued a notice to Wakf board to clarify what exactly is the nature of case that is pending before the Supreme Court concerning the Mumbai residence of Reliance company chief Mukesh Ambani. In 2005, this property was purchased by Muffin-Antilia Commercial Private Limited, a company owned by Ambani. The land earlier belonged to Currimbhoy Ebrahim Khoja orphanage Trust which was meant to help orphaned Muslim children. advertisement There were various litigations filed in the case including the present petition which is being heard in Bombay High Court. Jalna resident Abdul Mateen had read about the sale of property in newspapers and had filed a petition in 2007. His petition was tagged along with 66 other petitions on the same issue that were being heard by the Bombay High Court at that time. Mateen, a school teacher and also a part time journalist with an Urdu newspaper, however, managed to convince the court through his lawyer M S Chaudhari that at the heart of his petition is the mismanagement of Wakf board and the errant sale of all the properties. Meanwhile, in the court advocate Milind Sathe who is representing Ambani's company said that the issue raised by the petitioner is also an issue that is being deliberated upon by Supreme Court. SECULAR TRUST Sathe said that Currimbhoy Ebrahim Khoja orphanage Trust is a secular trust and hence it did not come under the wakf board. He said that it is registered with the charity commissioner. According to Sath, when the said land was bought, only the charity commissioner's permission was taken. Bombay High Court had also upheld that. It is against this order that Wakf board and Maharashtra government had approached Supreme Court. However, Chaudhri pointed out that after the enactment of Wakf act all properties belonging to any agency was deemed to be under Wakf board. The division bench of Bombay High Court headed by the chief justice asked the Wakf board to clarify its stand and also clarify what are the issues that are being looked at by the Supreme Court. Apri il file con un editor di testo, modifica la riga RenderPhoto da 1 a 0 , e poi salva il file. How do I get games? Puoi scaricare i giochi homebrew da Universal-DB e GameBrew . If you only have a Slot-1 flashcard and would like to dump a DS game, you can use Wooddumper , which requires a Wi-Fi connection compatible with the DS, as well as an FTP client on a separate device to receive the ROM On DSi you can use GodMode9i to dump your DS games and DSiWare On 3DS you can use GodMode9 to dump your DS games, DSiWare, and Virtual Console titles Can I get the save files from my Game Cards onto my SD card or vice versa? Sì. Puoi usare Checkpoint su 3DS o GodMode9i su DSi 3DS. How do I change TWiLight Menu s language? Le uniche console emulate sono le console del passato, parzialmente il GBA (visto che alcune o tutte le parti come la grafica sono eseguite nativamente). What systems does TWiLight Menu support? Visita Elenco dei sistemi supportati da TWiLight Menu . Can exploits of Slot-1 games boot TWiLight Menu ? No. L accesso alla scheda SD è consentito solo alle applicazioni DSiWare, quindi i giochi dello Slot-1 non possono avviare (o accedere) a TWiLight Menu . Why can t I find see my games? I motivi per cui non riesci a trovarli possono sono molteplici. The _nds folder found on the root of the SD card is not intended for applications one would access via TWiLight Menu , due to its reservation for functionality based files (themes, configuration, images, emulators and more). If you ve placed your titles here, please move them to another location. If you have more than 39 items in a folder and all of the slots on the menu are taken, your games may be on the next page. Use L R or SELECT Left Right to switch pages If your game or folder is hidden, you may need to show hidden files via TWiLight Menu s GUI settings If your game is in an archive ( zip , rar , 7z , etc), it cannot be used by TWiLight Menu . Extract the game from the archive to use it If your game does not use one of the supported extensions , you may have to change the extension by renaming the file How do I access TWiLight Menu settings? Il modo di accedere alle impostazioni di TWiLight Menu varia a seconda della configurazione. DS Classic Menu Tap the DS icon at the bottom of the lower screen Nintendo DSi SEGA Saturn Homebrew Launcher themes using SELECT Menu Press SELECT , then launch the Settings Applet (use the D-PAD to highlight options) Nintendo DSi SEGA Saturn Homebrew Launcher themes not using SELECT Menu Hitting SELECT will bring you to the DS Classic Menu Nintendo 3DS theme Tap the the wrench icon on the lower screen R4 Original theme Hit START (if you re in the file browser), then hit SELECT Wood UI theme Hitting START will bring you to the DS Classic Menu È anche possibile tenere premuto SELECT mentre avvii TWiLight Menu per accedere direttamente alle impostazioni. How do I use custom icons banners for games? You can use a custom banner in either PNG or DS banner.bin format by placing it in the sd _nds TWiLightMenu icons folder with the name of the ROM (including the extension) or folder .png or .bin . For PNG banners you simply need any PNG file with 15 colors or fewer and a maximum resolution of 32x32. Full transparency works and does not count towards the 15 colors, but semitransparency does not work. I banner di tipo banner.bin possono essere animati e consentono di sostituire il titolo che verrà visualizzato in TWiLight Menu . They can be made using NDS Banner Editor . Pre-made banners can be found in the icons section of the TWiLight Menu themes site and if you make any they can be shared there as well. How do I install custom themes for TWiLight Menu ? Custom themes can be acquired from the official themes site , which houses serveral community-made themes ready to apply. You can also make a custom theme for the Nintendo 3DS and Nintendo DSi UIs on your own by following this guide . The Homebrew Launcher , Sega Saturn and Game Boy Color UIs are not customizable. Once you have acquired a custom theme, you can install it by placing its folder on the appropiate path, which depends on what UI the theme is made for. Themes for the Nintendo DSi UI go in sd _nds TWiLightMenu dsimenu themes Themes for the Nintendo 3DS UI go in sd _nds TWiLightMenu 3dsmenu themes Themes for the R4 Original UI go in sd _nds TWiLightMenu r4menu themes Themes for the Wood UI go in sd _nds TWiLightMenu akmenu themes If you are using a 3DS family console, you can install custom themes using Universal-Updater . Go to Universal-Updater settings, then Select Unistore , , TWiLight Menu Themes . To apply a custom theme you must access TWiLight Menu Settings. On the GUI Settings page, go to the User Interface option and choose the UI using the right and left buttons on the D-Pad. Once the target UI is selected, go to the Custom Theme option and press the A button to choose between the themes you have installed. Using the up and down buttons on the D-Pad, highlight the desired theme, then press A to select it. Apply the settings by pressing B to go back to TWiLight Menu . TWiLight Menu should now have a customized look (and music, if the selected theme supports it and is enabled on the settings). Is there a 3DS emulator for DS(i)? No, there isn t.
