Download Your e-Aadhaar Instantly Get your digitally signed, password-protected Aadhaar PDF on your phone or computer in just 2 minutes. Secure and valid everywhere. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Please use this service carefully. LIMITED TIME OFFER Free Document Update Is your Aadhaar 10 years old? Upload Proof of Identity Address documents online for FREE till 14 06 2026. Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . (Note If you visit an offline Aadhaar Center, you will have to pay 50.) Which Documents do you need to upload? You need to upload one document for Identity and one for Address. Common valid documents include 1. Proof of Identity (PoI) To verify your Name and Photo. PAN Card e-PAN Driving License Passport Voter ID Ration Card (with Photo) Mark Sheet School Certificate 2. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . (Note If you visit an offline Aadhaar Center, you will have to pay 50.) Which Documents do you need to upload? You need to upload one document for Identity and one for Address. Common valid documents include 1. Proof of Identity (PoI) To verify your Name and Photo. PAN Card e-PAN Driving License Passport Voter ID Ration Card (with Photo) Mark Sheet School Certificate 2. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. documents: مَـوْﻻَىَ صَـلِّ وَ سَـلِّـمْ دَآئـِمـًا اَبَدًا عَلـىٰ حَبِيْبِكَ خَيْـرِ الْخَلْقِ كُلِّهـِمِ وَالْآلِ وَ الصّحْبِ ثُمَّ التَّابِعِيْنَ لَهُمْ أَهْلِ التُّقىٰ وَ النُّقىٰ وَ الْحِلْمِ وَ الكَرَمِْ صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلىٰ آلِِه وَصَحْبِهِ وَبَارِكَ وَسَلَّمَ بِسْمِ اللہِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ Muaqaddamah Aaj 18 Zilhajja Hai, Jis Din Huzoor Nabi-E-Akram صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم Ne Hijjat-ul-Wada Se Madinah Tayyabah Waapasi Ke Dauraan Ghadir-E-Khum Ke Maqaam Par Qayam Farmaya Aur Sahaba-E-Kiram رِضْوَانُ اللهِ تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ اَجْمَعِيْن Ke Hujoom Me Sayyiduna Ali-ul-Murtaza كَرَّمَاللهُ تَعَالىٰ وَجْهَهُ الْكَرِيْم Ka Haath Utha Kar Elaan Farmaya مَنْ كُنْتُ مَوْﻻَهُ فَعَلِىُّ مَوْﻻَهُ Jis Ka Mein Mawla Hoo n Us Ka Ali Mawla Hai. Ye Elan-E-Wilayat-E-Ali كَرَّمَاللهُ تَعَالىٰ وَجْهَهُ الْكَرِيْم Tah, Jis Ka Itlaaq Qayamat Tak Jumlah Ahl-E-Iman Par Hota Hai Aur Jis Se Ye Amr Qat i Tour Par Thaabit Hata Hai Ki Jo Wilayat-E-Ali كَرَّمَاللهُ تَعَالىٰ وَجْهَهُ الْكَرِيْم Ka Munkar Hai Woh Wilayat-E-Mohammadi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم Ka Munakr Hai. Is Aajiz Ne Mahsoos Kiya Ki Is Masla Par Ba z Log Bewajah Jahaalat Mutaraddid Rahte Hain Aur Ba z Log Bewjahe Inaad Wa Ta assub. So Ye Taraddud Aur Inkaare Ummat Me Tafarriqah Wa Intishaar Me Izaafa Ka Ba ith Ban Raha Hai. In Halaat Mein Ne Zaroori Samjha Ki Masla-E-Wilayat Wa Imamat Par Do² Risaale Taalif Karoo n Aik BaUnwan السيف الجلى على منكر وﻻية على كَرَّمَاللهُ تَعَالىٰ وَجْهَهُ الْكَرِيْم Aur Dusara BaUnwan القول المعتبر فى الإمام المنتظر . Pehle Risaale Ke Zariye Fateh-E-Wilayat Hazrat Imama Ali عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام Ke Maqaam Ko Waazeh Karu Aur Dusare Ke Zariye Khatim-E-Wilayat Hazrat Imam Mahdi عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام Ka Bayan Karu Taa Ki Jumla Shub haat Ka Ijaala Ho Aur Ye Haqiqat Khawaas Wa Awaam Sab Tak Pahunch Sake Ki Wilayat-E-Ali عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام Aur Wliayat-E-Mehdi عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام Ahl-E-Sunnat Wa Jama at Kee Moatabar Kutub-E-Hadith Me Riwayat-E-Mutwatirah Se Saabit Hai. Mein Ne Pehle Risalae Me Hadith-E-Nabawi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم Kee Ikyawan-51 Riwayat Poori Tehqiq Wa Takhrij Ke Saath Darj Kee Hain. Is Adad Kee Wajah Ye Hai Ki Mein Ne Imasaal Apni Umr Ke 51 Baras Mukammal Kiye Hain, Is Liye Husool-E-Barkat Aur Iktisaab Khair Ke Liye Aajizaan Taur Par Adadi Nisbat Ka Wasila Ikhtiyar Kiya Hai Taa Ki Bargah-E-Ali-ul-Murtaza كَرَّمَاللهُ تَعَالىٰ وَجْهَهُ الْكَرِيْم Me Is Haqir Ka Nazaraana Sharaf-E-Qubooliyt Paa Sake. (Aameen) Ab Is Muqaddamah Me Ye Nuktah Waazeh Karna Chaahta Hoo n Ki Huzoor Nab-E-Akram صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم Kee Zat-E-Muqaddasa Se Teen³ Tarah Kee Wirashatein Jaari Huwi ❶ Khilafat-E-Batini Kee Roohani Wirashat ❷ Khilafat-E-Zahiri Kee Siyaasi Wirashat ❸ Khilafat-E-Deeni Kee Umoomi Wirashat ❶ Khilafat-E-Batini Kee Roohani Wirashat Ahl-E-Bayt-E-At har Ke Nufoos-E-Tayyibah Ko Ata Huwi. ❷ Khilafat-E-Zahiri Kee Siyaasi Wirashat Khulfa-E-Rashideen Kee Zawaat Muqaddasa Ko Ata Huwi. ❸ Khilafat-E-Deeni Kee Umoomi Wirashat Baqiyyah Sahaba Wa Taba in Ko Ata Huwi. . . .. Yake Az Ghulaman-E-Ahl-E-Bayt Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri ١٨ زى الحج، ١٤٢٢ه ( Ab Yah n Safah-06 Se Le Kar Safah-16 Tak Aap Is Kitab السيف الجلى على منكر وﻻية على كَرَّمَاللهُ تَعَالىٰ وَجْهَهُ الْكَرِيْم Me Padh Sakte Hain Jo Alhamdulillah Net Par Bhi Haasil Hain. Filahl To Hum Ne Yaha n Jo 51 Ahadith Mubaraka Hai Usi Ko Roman Urdu Me Likhi Hai, InshaAllah Aap Ki Duaa Rahi Wa Waqt Mila To Ye Bhi Likh Diya Jayega. ) Al-Hamdulillah Ghulam-E-Mawla Ali KarramaAllahu Ta ala Waj hah-ul-Karim Hamaare Aziz Muhammad Shadab Shaikh Ne Yaha n Par Jo Muqaddamah Hum Ne Waqt Kee Qillat Ke Sabab Baaqi Rakha Tha Use Muhammad Shadab Shaikh Ne Apna Kimti Waqt Nikaal Kar Roamn Urdu Me Muqammal Kar Diya Hai Jise Aap Qaarein Kiram Kee Khidmat Me Pesh Kiya Jaata Hain Khilafat-e-Baatini Nayabat-e-Muhammadi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم ka woh sarchasma hai jis se na sirf Deen-e-Islam ke roohani kamalaat aur baatini fuyoozaat ki hifazat hui balke is ummat me Wilayat wa Qutbiyat aur Mujaddidiyat ke chasme phoote aur ummat isi waas-te se Roohaniyat-e-Muhammadi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم se faizyab hui. Khilafat-e-Zaaheeri Nayabat-e-Muhaamadi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم ka wo sar chasma hai jis se Galba-e-Deen-e-Haq aur nifaazi Islam ki amli surat wujood me aayi aur Deen-e-Muhammadi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم ke tamakkin aur zameeni iqtedar ka silsila qayam hua. Isi waas-te se Taarikh-e-Islam me mukhtalif riyasaten aur saltanaten qayam hue aur Shariyat-e-Muhammadi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم Nizam-e-Aalam ke tor par duniya me amalam muta aarif hui. Khilafat-e-Umoomi Nayabat-e-Muhammadi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم ka wo sar chasma hai jis se ummat me Taalimat-e-Islam ka farog aur Aamal-e-Swaleha ka tahaqaq wujood me aaya. Is waas-te se afrad-e-ummat me na sirf Ilm wa Taqwa ki hifazat hui balke Ikhlaaq-e-Islami ki umoomi tarweej wa shaa at jaari rahi goya Pehli Qism Khilafat-e-Wilayat qaraar paayi Dusri Qism Khilafat-e-Saltanat qaraar paayi Teesri Qism Khilafat-e-Hidayat qaraar paayi Is Taqseem-e-Wirasat-e-Muhammadi صَلَّى الله تَعَالىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَالِه وَسَلَّم ke mazmoon ko Shsh Wali-ullah Muhaddis Dehlvi Rehmatullah Alaih ne in alfaz ke sath bayan farmaya Huzoor Nabi-e-Akram SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ki wirasat ke hamilin teen tarah ke hain Ek wo jinhone Aap SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam se Hikmat wa Asmat aur Qutbiyat-e-Baatini ka faiz haasil kiya, wo Aap SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke Ahle Bait aur Khawaas hain. Dusra Tabqa wo hai jinhone Aap SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam se Hifz wa Talqeen aur Rushdo Hidayat se muttasif qutbiyat-e-Zaaheeri ka fiaz haasil kiya, wo Aap SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke kabaar Sahaba Ikram RajiAllahu Anhu jaise Khulfa aur Ashra-e-Mubashhira hain. Teesra Tabqa wo hai Infaraadi Inayat aur Ilm wa Taqwafaiz haasil kiya, ye wo Sahaba Ikram hain jo Ehsaan ke wasf se muttasif hogaye, jaise Hazrat Anas RajiAllahu Anhu aur Hazrat Abu Hurarirah RajiAllahu Anhu aur unke alawa digar mutakharin. Ye teeno madarij Huzoor Nabi-e-Akram SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke kamalat-e-Khatme Risalat se jaari hue. Waajeh rahe ke yeh taqsim Galba-e-Haal aur khusoosi imtiyaj ki nishandahi ke liye hai, warna har se aqsam me se koyi bhi dusri qism ke khawaas wa kamalatkulliyatan khali nahi hain, Un me se hare k ko dusri qism ke koi na koi nisbat ya ishtaraq hasil hai. Saltanat me Sayyaduna Siddiq-e-Akbar RajiAllau Anhu Huzoor Nabi-e-Akram SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke Khalifa-e-Bila-Fasl yaani barahe raast naaib hue. Wilyat me Sayyadina Ali Murtaza RajiAllau Anhu Huzoor Nabi-e-Akram SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke Khalifa-e-Bila-Fasl yaani barahe raast naaib hue. Hidayat me jumla Sahaba Ikram RajiAllau Anhu Huzoor Nabi-e-Akram SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke Khalifa-e-Bila-Fasl yaani barahe raast naaib hue. Iska mutaala ye hua ke Khatme Nabuwwat ke baad Faizan-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke daayimi tasalsul ke liye musataqil muta ale qaayam ho gaye Ek muta ala-e-Siyasi Wirasat ke liye Dusra muta ala-e-Roohani Wirasat ke liye Teesra Muta ala Amali Wirasat ke liye Huzoor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ki siyasi wirasat, Khulfaat-e-Raashida ke naam se mausuf hui. Huzoor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ki Roohani wirasat, Wilayat wa Imamat ke naam se mausuf hui. Huzoor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ki Ilmi wa Amali wirasat, Hidayat wa Dayanat ke naam se mausuf hui Lihaza siyasi wirasat ke fard-e-awwal Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq RajiAllahu Anhu hue, Roohani wirasat ke fard-e-awwal Hazrat Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu hue aur Ilmi wa Amali wirasat ke awwalin haamilin jumla Sahaba Ikram RajiAllahu Anhu hue. So ye sab waarisin wa haamilin apne apne dayare me bila fasl khulfa hue, ek ka dusre ke saath koi tazadiya ta.aariz nhi hai. Dusri Aham baat ye hai ke un manasib ki haqiqat bhi ek dusre se kai umoor me mukhtalif hain 1. Khilafat-e-Zaahiri Deen-e-Islam ka siyasi mansab hai. Khilafat-e-Baatini Khaalisatan Roohani mansab hai. 2. Khilafat-e-Zaahiri intekhaabi wa shurayi amr hai Khilafat-e-Baatini w ahbi wa ahbtabaayi amr hai 3. Khalifa-e-Zaahiri ka taqarrur awaam ke chunaav se amal me aata hai. Khalifa-e-Baatini ka taqarrur Khuda ke chunaav se amal me aata hai. 4. Khalifa-e-Zaahiri muntakhab hota hai. Khalifa-e-Baatini muntajab hota hai. 5. Yahi wajah hai ke pehle Khalifa-e-Raaashid sayyadina Siddiq-e-Akbar RajiAllahu Anhu ka intekhab Hazrat-e-Umar Farooq RajiAllahu Anhu ki tajviz aur raaye aam ki aksirati taa id se amal me aaya, magar pehle Imaam-e-Wilayat Sayyadina Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu ke intekhab me kisiki tajviz matloob hui na kisiki taa id. 6. Khilafat me jamhooriyat matloob thi, Isliye Huzzor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ne iska aylaan nhi farmaya. Wilayat me Maamoriyat maqsood thi, isliye Huzoor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ne Waadi-e-Ghadir-e-Khum ke Maqam par iska aylan farmaya. 7. Huzoor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ne Ummat ke liye Khalifa ka intekhaab awaam ki maqrzi par chod diya, magar Wali ka Intekhab Allah ki marzi se khud farmaya. 8. Khilafat zameeni nizam ke sanwaarne ke liye qaayam hoti hai. Wilayat usay aasmaani nizam ke husn se nikhaarne ke liye qaayam hoti hai. 9. Khilafat afraad ko aadil banati hai. Wilayat afraad ko kaamil banati hai. 10. Khilafat ka daayara farsh tak hai. Wilayat ka daayara arsh tak hai. 11. Khilafat takht nasheeni ke bagair mausar nhi hoti. Wilayat takht wa saltanat ke bagair bhi mausar hai 12. Gaaliban yahi wajah hai ke khilafat ummat ke supurd hui. Wilayat itrat ke supurd hui Lihaza khilafat se mafarr hai na wilayat se, kyunke Hazrat Sayyadina Abu Bakr Siddiq RajiAllahu Anhu ki khjilafat-e-bila fasl ijtimaayi Sahaba se munaqid hui aur tarikh ki shahdat-e-qatyi se saabit hui aur Hazrat Maula Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu ki wilayat bila fasl Khud farmaan-e-Mustafa SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam se munaqid hui aur Ahadeese mutawaatira ki shahadat-e-qatyi se saabit hui. Khilafat ka saboot ijtimaayi Sahaba hain aur wilayat ka saboot Farmaan-e-Mustafa SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam. Jo khilafat ka inkar karta hai wo taarikh aur ijtimaa ka inkaar karta hai aur jo imamat aur wilayat ka inkar karta hai wo Aylan-e-Mustafa SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ka inkaar karta hai. Zarurat is amr ki hai ke dono institutions ki haqiqat ko samajh kar unme tatbeeq paida ki jaaye naa-ke tafreeq. Jaan lena chahiye ke jis tarah Khilafat-e-Zaaheeri, Khulfa-e-Rashideen se shuru hui aur iska faiz hasbe haal ummat ke swaaleh hakaam aur aadil amraa ko muntaqil hota chala gaya, usi tarah Khilafat-e-Baatini bhi Sayyadina Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu se shuru hui aur iska faiz hasbe haal Aaimma-e-Athaar-e-Ahle Bait aur ummat ke Auliya-e-Kaamileen ko muntaqil hota chala gaya. Huzoor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ne Man Kuntu Maula Hu Fa Haaza Aliyyum Maula (Jiska Mai Maula Hun Uska Ye Ali Maula Hai) aur Aliyyun Waliyyu Kum Min Ba adi (Mere Baad Tumhara Wali Ali Hai) ke Aylan-e-Aam ke zariye Hazrat Ali RajiAllahu Anhu ko ummat me wilayat ka faatahe awwal qarar dediya. Baab-e-Wilayat me Shah Waliullah Muhaddis Dehlavi Rehmatullah Alaih ke alfaz mulahizan hon 1. Is Ummate Marhumah me (Faathe Awwal) Wilayat ka darwaza sabse pehle kholne waale fard Hazrat Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu hain. 2. Hazrat Ameer(Leader) RajiAllahu Anhu ka Raaz-e-Wilayat Aapki Aulaad-e-Kiram RajiAllahu Anhu me Sarayat kargaya. 3. Chunanche Aouliya-e-Ummat me se ek bhi aisa nhi jo kisi na kisi tour par Hazrat Ali RajiAllahu Anhu ke Khaandani Imamat se (Iqtesaab-e-Wilayat ke liye) wabasta na ho 4. Huzoor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ki ummat me pehla fard jo wilayat ke (sabse a alaa wa aqwaa tareeq) baab-e-jazab ka faateh bana aur jisne is maqami bulandi par (pehla) qadam rakha Ameerul Momineen Hazrat Ali RajiAllahu ki Zaat-e-Girami hai, isi wajah roohaniyat wa wilayat ke mukhtalif tareeqon ke salasil Aap he ki taraf ruju karte hain 5. Ab ummat me jise bhi Bargaahe Risalat SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam se Faiz-e-Wilayat nasib hota hai wo ya to Nisbat-e-Ali Murtaza RajiAllahu se nasib hota hai ya Nisbat-e-Gaus-e-Aazam Jeelani RajiAllahu se iske bagair koi bhi shaks Martaba-e-Wilayat par faa iz nhi ho sakta. Shāh Wal ī Al lāh, at -Tafhīmāt -ul -i lāhiyyah (1 103). 2. Shāh Wal ī Al lāh, at -Tafhīmāt -ul -i lāhiyyah (1 103) 3. Shāh Wal ī Al lāh, at -Tafhīmāt -ul -i lāhiyyah (1 104). 4. Shāh Wal ī Al lāh, Hama āt (p. 60). 5. Shāh Wal ī Al lāh, Hama āt (p. 62). Is nuqte ko Shah Ismail Dehlvi ne bhi basarahat yun likha hai Hazrat Ali Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu ke liye Shaikhain RajiAllahu Anhuma par bhi ek guna fazilat saabit hai aur wo fazilat Aapke farmabardaaron ka zyada hona aur maqamaat-e-wilayat balke Qutbiyat aur Gausiyat aur Abdaaliyat aur inhi jaise baaki khudmaat Aapke zamane se lekar duniya ke khatam hone tak Aap he ki wasatat se hona hai aur badshahon ki badshahat aur ameeron ki amarat me Aapko wo dakh al hai jo aalam-e-malakoot ki seerkarne waalon par makhfi nhi. .. Ahle Wilayat ke aksar silsile bhi Janab-e-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu he ki taraf mansoob hain, pas qayamat ke din bahot farmabardaron ki wajah se jinme aksar badi badi shaano walen aur umdah martabe waale honge, Hazrat-e-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu ka lashkar is rounaq aur buzurgi se dikhayi dega ke us maqm ka tamasha dekhne waalon ke liye amr nihayat he tajjub ka baayis hoga -Shāh Ismā ī l Dihlawī , Si rāt Mustaqīm (p. 67). Ye faiz-e-wilayat ke Ummat-e-Muhaamadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam me jiske Mamba aur Sarchasma Sayyadina Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu muqarrar hue usme Sayyada-e-Kainat Hazrat Faatimah Tuz Zahra (Salamullahi Alaiha) aur Hazrat-e-Hasnain Kareemain RajiAllahu Anhuma bhi Aap RajiAllahu Anhu ke saath shariq kiye gaye hain, Aur fir Unki wasatat se ye Silsila-e-Wilayat-e-Kubra aur Gaus-yat-e-Uzma Un 12 Aa imma-e-Ahle Bait me tarteeb se chalaya gaya jinke aakhri fard Sayyadina Imaam Muhammad Mahdi Alaihissalam hain. Jis tarah Sayyadina Maula Ali RajiAllahu Anhu Ummat-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam me faathe wilayat ke darje par faa iz hue, usi tarah Sayyadina Imam Mahdi Alaihissalam Ummat-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam me khaatam-e-wilayat ke darje par faa iz honge. Is mauzu par Hazrat Mujaddid-e-Alfe Saani Shaykh Ahmed Sarhandi Rehmatullah Alaih ki tehqiq mulahiza ho Aur ek raah wo hai jo Qurb-e-Wilayat se taalluk rakhti hai Aqtab aur wa Awtaad aur Badla aur Najba aur Aam Auliya Allah isi raah se waasil hain, aur Raah-e-Sulooq isi raah se ibaarat hai, balke mutaarif jazba bhi isi me daakhil hai aur is raah me to sat saabit hai aur is raah ke waasalmeen ke peshwa aur unke sardar aur unke buzurgon ke manbaa-e-faiz Hazrat Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu hain Aur ye Azeemusshan mansab Unse talluq rakhta hai. Is raah me goya RasoolAllah SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke Dono Kadam-e-Mubarak Hazrat Ali RajiAllahu Anhu ke Mubarak Sar par hain aur Hazrat Fatiamh (Salamullahi Alaiha) aur Hazrat Hasnain Kareemain RajiAllahu Anhuma is maqam me Unke saath shariq hain. Mai yeh samjhta hun ke Hazrat Ameer (Leader Maula Ali) RajiAllahu Anhu Apni jasadi paidaish se pehle bhi is maqam ke malja wa mamba the, jaisa ke Aap RajiAllahu Anhu jasadi paidaish ke baad hain aur jise bhi faiz wa hidayat is raah se pahunchi Unke zariye se pahunchi, Kyunke wo is raah ke aakhri nuqta ke nazdeek hain aur is maqam ka markaz Unse talluq rakhta hai, aur jab Hazrat Ameer RajiAllahu Anhu ka dour khatm huwa to ye azeemul qadr mansab tarteebwaar Hazrat Hasnain Kareemain RajiAllahu Anhuma supurd huwa aur Unke baad wahi mansab Aa imma-e-Sana Ashrah me se hare k ko tarteebwaar aur tafseel se tafweez huwa, aur Un Buzurgon ke zamane me aur isi tarah Unke Inteqaal ke baad jis kisi ko bhi faiz o hidayat pahunchi hai Unhi Buzurgon ke zariye pahunchi hai Agarche Aqtaab wa Najbaa-e-Waqt he kyu na hon aur sabke malja wa mamba yahi Buzurg Hain(Aa imma-e-Athar-e-Ahle Bait) kyunke atraaf ko apne markaz ke sath Alhaaq ke bagair chara nhi hai. (Shaykh Ahmad Sarhandī, Maktūbāt (9 173 123). Hazrat Mujaddid-e-Alfe Saani Rehmatullahi Alaih Farmaate hain ke Imam Mahdi Alaihissalam bhi kaari wilayat me Hazrat Ali Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu ke saathg shariq honge. Khalasiye kalam ye hua ke Maqam-e-Ghadir-e-Khum par Wilayat-e-Ali RajiAllahu Anhu ke mazmoon par mushtamil Aylan-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ne is haqiqat ko abadal aabad tak ke liye saabit wa zaahir kardiya ke Wilayat-e-Ali RajiAllahu Anhu dar haqiqat Wilayat-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam he hai. Baisat-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke baad Nabuwwat wa Risalat ka baab hamesha hamesha ke liye band kardiya gaya, lihaaza taa-qayamat Faiz-e-Nabuwwat-e-Muhaamadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke ajraa wa tasalsul ke liye Baari Ta ala ne ummat me naye darwaaze aur raaste khol diye jinme kuch ko Martaba-e-Zaaheer se nawaza gaya aur kuch ko Martaba-e-Baatin se. Martaba-e-Baatin ka Haamil raasta Wilayat qarar paaya, aur Ummat-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam me Wilayat-e-Uzma ke haamil sabse pehle Imam-e-Barhaq Maula Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu muqarrar hue. Phir wilayat ka silsila Huzoor Nabi-e-Akram SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ki Ahle Bait aur Aal-e-Athaar me Aa imma Asna Ashra(Baara Imamon) me jaari kiya gaya. Har chand Inke alawa bhi hazarhan Nufoos-e-Qudsiya har zamane me Martaba-e-Wilayat se baharyaab hote rahe, Qutbiyat wa Gausiyat ke Aala wa Arfa maqamaat par faa-iz hote rahe, Ahle Jahan ko Anwaar-e-Wilayat se munawwar karte rahe aur karodon insano ko har zulmat a zalalat se nikal kar Noor-e-Baatin se humkinar karte rahe, magar unsabka faiz Sayyadina Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu ki Baargah-e-Wilayat se bil-waas-ta ya bila-waas-ta maakhooz wa mustafaad tha. Wilayat-e-Ali RajiAllahu Anhu se koi bhi bay-niyaz aur aazad na tha. Yahi silsila qayamat tak jaari rahega taanke Ummat-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam me aakhri Imam-e-Barhaq aur Markaz-e-Wilayat ka zahoor hoga. Ye Sayyadina Imam Muhammad Mahdi Alaihissalam honge jo Barhawe Imam bhi honge aur aakhri Khalifa bhi. Unki Zaat-e-Aqdas me zaahir wa baatin ke dono raaste jo pehle juda the mujtama a kardiye jaenge. Ye Haamil-e-Wilayat bhi honge aur Waaris-e-Khilafat bhi, Wilayat aur Khilafat ke dono martabe Unpar khatam kardiye jaenge. So jo Imam Mahdi Alaihissalam ka munkir hoga wo Deen ki zaahiri wa baatini dono khilafaton ka munkir hoga. Ye Mazhariyat-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ki inteha hogi, islye Unka naam bhi Muhammad hoga aur Unka Khalq bhi Muhammadi (SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam) hoga, taake duniya ko maalum hojaye ke ye Imam Faizan-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke zaahir wa baatin dono wirasaton ka Ameen hai. Isliye Huzoor SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ne Farmaya Jo Imam Mahdi Alaihissalam ki takzeeb karega wo kafir hojaega. Us aqt ru-e-zameen ke tamaam Auliya ka Marja a Aap Alaihissalam honge aur Ummat-e-Muhammadi SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ka Imam hone ke baa is Sayyadina Isa Alaihissalam bhi Aap Alaihissalam ke iqtida me Namaz Ada Farmaenge aur isi tarah ahle jahan me Aap Alaihissalam ki Imamat ka Aylan Farmaenge. So hum sabko jaan lena chahiye ke Hazrat Maula Ali Al-Murtaza RajiAllahu Anhu aur Hazrat Mahdi Alal Ardh Was Samaa Alaihissalam.. Baab aur Beta Dono ..Allah ke Wali aur RasoolAllah SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke Wasi hain. Inhen Tasleem Karna Har Sahib-e-Iman Par Wajib Hai. Baari Ta ala hame in Azeem Manbaye Wilayat se iktisab-e-faiz ki taufeek marhamat farmaye. Shab_e_Zarbat Shab_e_Gham _ 19 Ramzan Ki Shab, Fazar me Jab Ameerul Momineen Ali Ibne Abi Taalib ع , Masjid e Kufa Me Apni Namaz Ada Kar Rahe Hotey Hain., Itne Me Abdur Rehman Ibne Muljim (Lanati) Ne Douran e Namaz, Maula e Qayenaat ع Ke Sar_e_Aqdas Pe Zehar Me Doobi Hui Talwar Se Waar Kiya.. Sar_e_Aqdas Par Zarb Lagtey Hee, Maula Ali ع Ki Zubaañ Se Ye Alfaaz Nikle Rabb_e_Kaaba Ki Qasam, Mai Kamyaab Ho gaya! _ Is Waar Ke Zakhm Aur Zehar Ke Asar Se, 21 Ramzan ko Maula Ali ع , Iss Duniya e Faani Se Parda Farma Gaye Jab Maula Ali ع Ko Zakhmi Halat Me Paaya Gaya, Tou Fouran Hakeem Ko Bulaya Gaya.., Hakeem Ne Maula Ko Dekh kar Kaha Ke Khoon Bohat Nikal Chuka Hai, Isliye Maula Ali ع Ko Dhoodh Pilaya Jaaye, Taa ke Inko Sukoon Haasil Ho.. Us Waqt, Ibn Muljim (Lanati) Ko Bhi Giraftaar Kar ke, Maula Ali ع Ke Saamne Laya Gaya.. Maula Ali ع Ko Dekh kar Ibne Muljim, Khouf Se Kaanp Uthaa.. Maula Ali ع Ne Jab Ibne Muljim ki Aisi Haalat Dekhi Tou Aapne Farmaya ke, isko Thanda Sharbat Isey Pila Do, Taa ke Uska Khouf Khatm Ho Zarb Kha kar Bhi Jo, Qaatil Ko Pilaye Sharbat, Zeb Deta Hai Usey SAAQI E KAUSAR Hona ! _ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد ﷺ सबसे पहला आतंकवादी हमला के दिन 19 रमजान को मौला अली इब्न ए अबुतालिब पे नमाज़ की हालत मे मस्जिदें कुफा में हुआ सबसे पहला आतंकवादी इब्न ए मुल्जिम था जिसने सजदे की हालत मे मौला अली (अ) पे ज़हर बुझी तलवार से सर पे हमला किया इब्न ए मुल्जिम पे लानत उसको भेजने वाले उसके आक़ा पे लानत बेशुमार Maula Ali ne Imam Hasan se farmaya ki apni behen umme kulsum se kaho ke aaj 18 roza me apni beti ke Ghar iftar krungaa,Maula e Qayenat Pohche apni beti ke Ghar janabe umme kulsum ne dastar khwan sajaya ek zarf me doodh ek zarf me namak aur ek zarf me maula ki pasandida roti (jaw ki roti) rakhi Maula ne farmaya Beti Ummul kulsum tumne apne baba ko bhula diya kya kabhi mere dastar khwan ne ek chiz se jyda chiz rahi hai. Phir umme kulsum ne chaha ke namak utha le lekin maula ne mana kr diya aur kaha ki doodh utha lo yaha kufe me yateem bohot hai unke paas peene ke liye doodh nhi hai, Phir maula ne namak aur jaw ki roti ke sath iftar kiya, Phir maula jab Bibi Umme kulsum ke ghar se bahar nikle toh Ghar ke bahar batakh(Duck) rasta rokne lage maula ke samne zor zor se awaaz nikalne lage Bibi Umme kulsum ne pucha baba yeh kya kr rhe hai toh Maula ne kaha ki yeh Noha kr rhe hai , Phir maula masjid e kufa me pohche aur soye hue logo ko uthaya aur waha pr Ibn Muljim bhi tha maula ne use bhi awaaz di Aur uthaya phir maula ne imamat ki namaz ki aur jab maula ne sajda kiya phir us lanati Ibn e Muljim ne talwar nikala aur maula ke sar par zarb laga di jo usne 1000 dirham me kharidi thi aur zeher me duba kr rakha hua tha ,Phir maula ne Sukr Adaa krte hue kaha Fuztu Bi Rabbil Kaaba (Rab e Kaaba ki Kasam me Kamyab ho gaya) Phir huqum Diya imam Hasan ko namaz muqammal krne ki Imam Hasan ne Namaz muqammal krwayi Phir Imam Hasan,Imam Hussain aur Hazrat Muhammad e hanafiya ne sambhala aur phir Ghar le gaye, logo ne Ibn Muljim ko pakad liya tha aur Maula ke pass pesh kiya use phir Maula Ali ne Hazrat e Abbas ko kaha Bete Abbas ise Sharbat pilao yeh khabraya hua hai aur phir farmaya jo tum khate ho ise khilao aur Jo tum peete ho ise pilao . अय्याम ए ग़म __ शब ए ज़रबत मस्जिद ए कूफा इमाम अली (अ.स.) की आँखों मे आँसू देख कर किसी ने पूछा .. मौला आप क्यूँ रो रहे हैं ?
