Led by the party s top brass including Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, former party chief Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, Sonia Gandhi, K.C. Venugopal, Jairam Ramesh, Sachin Pilot and other senior leaders the rally echoed with fierce accusations of vote theft and urgent calls for accountability from constitutional authorities. Also Read Vote chori biggest anti-national act Rahul in fiery Lok Sabha address Speakers charged the ruling BJP with hollowing out democratic norms, alleging that power was being secured not through the people s mandate but by sidestepping institutions and rules meant to safeguard free and fair elections. From the dais, Congress leaders framed the mobilisation as far more than a routine political protest, describing it instead as a battle to defend democracy itself. They said repeated questions raised by the Opposition on electoral transparency had been stonewalled, fuelling public mistrust and casting a long shadow over the perceived impartiality of the Election Commission. A day earlier, Kharge had sharpened the party s attack, accusing the Modi government of dodging accountability in Parliament and placing incorrect information before the House even as concerns over electoral integrity went unanswered. He alleged that the government had chosen evasion over explanation, while Rahul Gandhi, he said, had backed claims of vote theft with documentary evidence pointing to the subversion of the popular will. The people of this country are not choosing the BJP, Kharge asserted, alleging that governments were being stitched together by manipulating the electoral process rather than reflecting the verdict of voters. Such practices, he warned, strike at the heart of the Constitution and threaten to erode public faith in democracy. Adding to the chorus, former Uttarakhand chief minister Harish Rawat expressed deep unease over the credibility of the electoral system, saying doubts about the Election Commission s neutrality were growing among citizens who felt disenfranchised. He said Rahul Gandhi s persistent questions had been met with silence from both the government and the poll body a silence that, he warned, was deeply corrosive to democratic trust. This is not merely a political fight, Rawat said, calling it a constitutional struggle to protect the Republic s foundations. He cautioned that the reluctance of authorities to respond transparently was weakening the very bedrock of free and fair elections. Meanwhile, Congress leader Raj Babbar mounted a sharp attack on the SIR process, alleging that it undermines rights guaranteed by the Constitution. Addressing party workers, he said democracy thrives on the freedom to question authority and warned that no system or government has the right to take that away. Babbar said Congress workers have come together in unity to defend these constitutional freedoms, framing the struggle as one to safeguard the very soul of democracy. As chants of Vote Chor, Gaddi Chhod rolled through the rally, Congress leaders vowed to take the movement beyond Parliament and into the streets, announcing plans for similar mobilisations across the country. The party said the campaign would continue until transparency, accountability and constitutional propriety are restored. The massive show of strength marked a decisive escalation in the Congress campaign on electoral issues, signalling that the question of democratic credibility is set to dominate India s political discourse in the days ahead. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). One Login, Many Services Access all Aadhaar services with a single secure login. Use your SSO ID or try our new Face Authentication feature for instant access without a password. Secure 256-bit Encryption Biometric Face Auth Supported Access Document Update Status Manage Family Profiles SSO Portal Login SSO ID User ID Password Use your camera to scan your face or upload a photo for verification. Click to Scan Face Upload Photo Supports JPG PNG (Max 5MB) Forgot Password? Create New Account What is SSO ID? (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

documents: HOME NEWS Education NEET Protest 'Main bhi cockroach' New York aur London tak pahuncha - 2024 NEET exam ke khilaf students ka protest international level par pohunch gaya. New York aur London mein students ne 'Main bhi cockroach' slogan se NEET system ke khilaf avaaz uthai. Biplab Biswas Published on 22 Jul 2026 Follow Advertisement NEET ke against chal rahe student protests ab sirf India tak mehboob nahi rahe ye London aur New York tak pahunch gaye hain! Hazar se zyada Indian students jo videshi sheher mein padhai kar rahe hain, unhone streets par utar kar "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare lagaaye hain aur NEET exam system ko leke apna gussa zahir kiya hai. Ye global movement dekh kar sarkari talash ho gai hai, kyunki National Testing Agency ke exam conduct karne ke tareekon ko lekar poore desh mein ek bada shukhna badh gaya hai aur ab videshi universities ke students bhi apna voice uthaane lage hain. Poori Khabar Kya Hai? NEET examination ko leker jo controversy badh gai hai, voh sirf desh ke andar tak simit nahi rahi. Lakho students jo India se bahar padhne gaye hain, unhe bhi iska prabhav pad raha hai kyunki unke parivar aur bhai-bahan jo desh mein hain, unko NEET dena padta hai. Jab se National Testing Agency ne exam conduct karne mein different tareekon ko follow kiya hai, tab se ek alag hi frustration ka mauhaul ban gaya hai. London aur New York mein Indian student communities ne "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare likhe hue placards le kar protests kiye hain, jo ek musical composition ke lyrics se liye gaye hain jo NEET se related ek satire ban gaya hai. Ye "Main bhi cockroach" slogan ek deep comment hai Indian education system aur NTA ke exam conduct ke tareekon par. Students ka kehna hai ki jis tarah cockroaches ko lab mein bekar samjha jata hai, usi tarah NTA unhein bhi sirf statistics samjh raha hai, numbers samjh raha hai, par unke actual learning aur skills ko nahi dekh raha. Jab National Testing Agency lakho students ke marks ko revise karta hai, jab answer keys mein galtiyan aati hain, toh students ko lagta hai ki unhein insaan ki tarah treat nahi kiya ja raha. Video clips aur social media posts se dekha ja sakta hai ki London ke Piccadilly Circus aur New York ke Times Square jaise jagahon par ye protests hue hain. NTA ke under NEET exam hota hai jo medical colleges mein admission ke liye zaruri hai. Pichle kuch mahine mein NEET ke marks mein jo modifications ane hain, jo grace marks diye gaye hain, jo ek saath multiple answer keys banaye gaye hain sab kuch mein ek bada jhoomla hai. Students ke hisaab se transparency nahi hai, sabka fairness nahi hai, aur jo topper ban gaye hain, unhe bhi shubh nahi hai kyunki unhe lagta hai ki shayad unhe galti se marks zyada mil gaye hain ya phir doosre ko kam mil gaye hain. Isse jo psychological pressure create hua hai, uspar ye global protests utha hai. Videshi sheher se ye protest signal bhej rahe hain ki NEET issue sirf ek local matter nahi raha. Agar lakho students jo abroad hain aur apne sapne poore kar rahe hain, ve bhi apne desh ke exam system ke khilaaf bolne ke liye bahar aaye, toh samajho ki problem kitna bada hai. International media ne bhi inn protests ko cover kiya hai, aur ye India ke education system par ek global spotlight ban gaya hai. Students kehte hain ki jab tak NTA ne NEET conduct karne ke tareekon ko transparent aur fair nahi banaya, tab tak ye protests chalte rahenge. Key Highlights Global Reach NEET protests London, New York aur doosre videshi sheher tak pahunch gaye hain jahaan large Indian student population hai Slogan "Main bhi cockroach" students ke gussa aur frustration ka symbol ban gaya hai jo NTA ke exam system ke khilaaf ek strong message de raha hai NTA ke Issues Multiple answer keys, grace marks, score revisions, aur transparency ki kami ke karan students mein ek bada distrust hai Student Base Hazaron Indian students jo videshi universities mein padhe hue hain, unhe apne family members ke NEET scores ko leker chinta hai International Coverage Global media networks ne in protests ko cover kiya hai aur India ke education system par international attention aa gaya hai Psychological Impact NEET takers ko ek bada stress aur anxiety feel ho raha hai kyunki unhe pata nahi ki final score kya hoga aur kab announce hoga Demand for Transparency Students chahte hain ki National Testing Agency sara detailed analysis public kare, har question ke liye explanation de, aur clear guidelines set kare Youth Frustration Symbol Ye protests sirf NEET tak nahi, balki Indian education system ke poore structure par ek bada sawaal ubhaara hai Advertisement Kisko Milega Fayda? Iss global movement se directly jo faida mil sakta hai voh hai medical education ko leker ek alag tarah ki consciousness create hona. Jab lakho students poore duniya se ek issue ko highlight kar rahi hain, toh sarkari vibhag ko sunna padta hai. NEET ke through jo lakho students har saal medical colleges mein admission lena chahte hain, unhe agar ye protests successful hote hain toh ek transparent aur fair system mil payega. Aaj jo NEET exam de raha hai, voh ek chota student nahi hai, uska ek international connection hai, uska voice international stage par suna ja sakta hai isse NTA ko samajhna padega ki exam conduct mein ek bada responsibility hai. Medical profession se jude 15-16 lakh students jo har saal NEET dete hain, unhe sab se zyada faida milega. Agar ye global movement se transparency aaye aur answer keys saaf-sutra ho jayen, toh future generations ko ek better examination experience milega. NEET ke marks par lakho students aur un ke parivar ke sapne depend karte hain. Jab scores revise hote hain, tab unhe lagta hai ki unhe na-insaafi hui hai. Agar protests se ye badlav aaye ki NTA apne processes ko improve kare, aapne training de, aapne double-check system banaye, toh lakho students ko aage faida milega. Indian government aur Ministry of Education ko bhi isse ek signal milega ki youth ko education system ke bare mein kitni chinta hai. Global level par agar India ke exam system ko lekar controversy ho raha hai, toh ye desh ke talent aur credibility ko affect karta hai. Videshi universities mein jo Indian students padhte hain, ve apne desh ko represent karte hain. Agar unhone videshi sheher mein streets par uttar kar protest kiya, toh iska matlab hai ki system mein kuch fundamental problems hain jo solve hone zaruri hain. International reputation ke liye bhi Indian government ko respond karna padega. Zaroori Dates aur Timeline Event Date Period Details NEET Exam Controversies Shuru 2024 - Mid Year Multiple answer keys aur score revisions se frustration badha Grace Marks Announcement 2024 NTA ne kuch students ko grace marks diye jo baki students ko unfair laga Domestic Protests Intensify 2024 Poore desh mein college aur school ke students ne roads par protesting shuru kiya Global Protests Begin 2024 - Recent London, New York aur other international cities mein Indian students ne "Main bhi cockroach" protests organize kiye International Media Coverage 2024 - Current Global news channels ne Indian education system par criticism ki Ongoing Demands Abhi Complete transparency, answer key justification, aur NTA accountability ke liye chhoti-chhoti protests chalti rahin Sarkar Vibhag ka Aadhikarik Bayaan National Testing Agency ne apne official statements mein kaha hai ki NEET exam conduct mein transparency aur fairness sabse zaroori hai. NTA ke representatives ne media mein bola hai ki jab bhi koi error ya discrepancy dekha gaya hai, unhone usse immediately address kiya hai. Agency ke hisaab se, grace marks dena sirf un students ko tha jinhe exam conduct mein technical issues face karne pade. Score revisions ke bare mein NTA kahta hai ki scientific method se ye kiya gaya tha aur har student ke liye fair tha. Sarkari level se bhi Ministry of Education ne kaha hai ki NEET system India mein sabse transparent aur merit-based system hai, lekin students ke grievances ko seriously liya ja raha hai aur further improvements par kaam chal raha hai. Advertisement Important Details at a Glance Aspect Information Exam Name National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) Conducting Authority National Testing Agency (NTA) Purpose Medical colleges mein MBBS aur BDS courses ke liye admission Annual Candidates Approximately 15-16 lakh students Main Controversy Multiple answer keys, grace marks, score revisions, transparency kami Protest Symbol "Main bhi cockroach" systemic dehumanization ka representation Geographic Spread India ke ander plus London, New York, aur other international cities Student Demand Complete transparency, detailed explanation of marking, uniform answer keys Aage Kya Hoga? Aage ke months mein ye protests aur bhi vocal ho sakte hain kyunki jo momentum iss global movement ne create ki hai, voh rokna mushkil hai. International students jo apne desh ke liye iska voice ban gaye hain, unhe support milega apne colleges aur universities se. Faculty members, international student organizations, aur even some foreign governments Indian education system ko lekar questions pooch sakte hain. NEET exam ke next year ke conduct mein NTA ko behti-soch-samajh kar decision lena padega. Agar 2025 mein bhi same tarah issues aaye, toh protests aur bhi bade hote jayenge. Government level par bhi iska impact padega. Sarkaari committees aur education ministry ko NEET system ke liye ek complete audit karna padega. Technical issues, human error, aur systematic problems sab ko identify karna padega aur ek robust system develop karna padega. Isse pehle ke exam conduct mein NTA ko apne QA QC processes ko strengthen karna chahiye. Students ke complaints ko ek structured mechanism ke through handle karna chahiye taaki transparency baniye rahe. Individual students jo NEET de rahe hain aur Jo future mein denge, unhe ye advice hai ki apne scores ko leker anxiety mein pad jayen toh isse no point hai. Jo kiya hai wo kiya hai, ab apne appeals aur grievance redressal process ko utilize karna chahiye. Agar kisi ko genuinely koi issue nazar aaye apne paper checking mein, toh NTA ke official website par detailed review request karna chahiye. Exam mein har question par ek answer key available hona chahiye with justification, aur uss par agar question mark hain toh official appeal file karna chahiye. Aksar Pooche Jaane Wale Sawaal Q1 "Main bhi cockroach" ka matlab kya hai? Ye ek symbolic statement hai jiska matlab ye hai ki students ko NTA unhe humans ki tarah value nahi de raha sirf statistics samjh raha hai. Cockroach lab experiment ka subject hote hain aur inhein scientific experiments mein use kiya jata hai. Students ye kehna chahte hain ki unhe same way treat kiya ja raha hai jaise lab specimens ko, unke individual concerns ignore ho rahe hain, sirf data collection chal raha hai. Ye phrase ekdum harsh criticism hai exam system ka. Q2 NEET scores revise kyun hote hain? Jab exam conduct ke baad NTA ko kisi question mein scientific error ya multiple valid answers mil jayein, toh voh answer key ko revise karte hain. Isse jo students affected hote hain, unhe grace marks diye jate hain. However, students ka point hai ki ye grace marks system arbitrary hai kisi ko mil gaya, kisi ko nahi. Transparency nahi hai kaunse exactly questions ko revise kiya gaya aur kyu, aur grace marking criteria kya tha. Q3 Videshi countries mein kyu ye protests ho rahe hain? Indian diaspora pura duniya mein phela hai. Jo students videshi universities mein padhe hue hain, unke younger siblings, cousins, aur family members ko India mein NEET dena padta hai. Jab apne gharwalon ke scores niyay karne wale system ko unfair dekha, toh unhone apna voice uthaaya. Plus, unhe videshi countries mein freedom of expression ka advantage hai jo unhe apni taraf India mein possible nahi hota. Q4 Kya NEET exam system badlega? Ye baat ki confirm nahi hai, lekin international pressure aur domestic protests se NTA ko zaroor apni processes improve karne padenge. Jo students demand kar rahe hain transparency, detailed answer explanations, grievance redressal mechanism ye sab reasonable hain. Sarkar ko bhi social unrest dekh kar respond karna padega. Changes slow hote hain, lekin ye momentum continue rahegi. Q5 Abhi NEET dene wale students ko kya karna chahiye? Apni preparation par focus rakhni chahiye aur exam mein apna best performance dena chahiye. Agar exam ke baad kisi ko kisi answer key par doubt ho, toh official review request file karna chahiye. Isme himmat mat haar system mein problems ho sakte hain, lekin individual effort se success milti hai. Apne score announce hone se pehle padhna mat chhod har mark matters. Advertisement Closing NEET protest jo "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare ke saath London aur New York tak pahuncha hai, voh sirf ek exam issue nahi hai ye India ke education system, student welfare, aur governance ko lekar ek bada global conversation hai. Lakho students unke dreams pursue karte hain, unhe fair aur transparent system deserve hai. Abhi jo protesting ho rahe hain aur jo government mein hain, dono ko bahut seriously iss issue ko lena chahiye. Students apne scores, apne future, apne rights ke liye apni awaaz uthaao, lekin registered aur structured tareekon se. Government aur NTA listen karo, respond karo, aur ek truly transparent exam system banao jo sabko capable banaye bina discrimination ke. Sabhi students ke liye advice National Testing Agency ki official website nta.ac.in par visit karo, apne scores aur answer keys check karo, agar koi issue ho toh official grievance portal mein appeal karo. Apne education aur apne future ko seriously lo, kyunki ye tumhara hi responsibility hai. Baaki, ye global movement ensure karega ki system mein change zaroor aayega sirf Time ka sawaal hai. To insert a custom post from WordPress without using it s native post page you can use WordPress wp_insert_post() function from a plugin or an individual page. In WordPress wp_insert_post() is being used to insert a post programmatically but what if you want to add some custom fields with the post that you are going to insert using wp_insert_post() function. Well, I found this topic very useful during one of my projects and would like to share it. At first you have to insert the post then you can add custom fields. Inserting The Post How to use wp_insert_post function my_post array( 'post_title' _POST 'post_title' , 'post_content' _POST 'content' , 'post_status' 'publish', 'post_author' 1, 'post_category' array(7,8) ) newpost_id wp_insert_post( my_post) Above code snippet will just insert a new post into the WordPress database and will return an integer value of the newly inserted post on success, otherwise it will return 0. Please remember that you can specify other values in the my_post array like post_date, post_status etc but you can omit those because by default those will be inserted. Now we have just inserted a new post and we have the ID of that post. Hence, to insert or add some custom fields with this post we need to add some meta values using add_post_meta() function. This function will insert meta values into the wp_postmeta table using the post s ID. To add custom field two custom fields we need to call use add_post_meta() function right after wp_insert_post() function and we need the ID ( newpost_id) that wp_insert_post() function returned on success. Adding Custom Fields How to use add_post_meta function if( newpost_id! 0) profession 'Designer' status 'Active' add_post_meta( newpost_id, 'profession', profession) add_post_meta( newpost_id, 'status', status) Above code snippet will add two custom fields with the new post. The add_post_meta() function accepts three arguments, first on is the post ID, for which the meta value will be added, the second on is the custom field name (meta_key name) and third one is the field value (meta_value). Here we have added two custom fields profession and status, that s it. Updating Post And Fields To update a post and it s custom fields (meta values) you need to use wp_update_post function and update_post_meta function. my_post array( 'ID' '25', Post id is required to update the post. 'post_title' _POST 'post_title' , 'post_content' _POST 'content' , 'post_status' 'publish', 'post_author' 1, 'post_category' array(7) ) newpost_id wp_update_post( my_post ) if( newpost_id! 0) profession 'Designer' status 'Active' update_post_meta( newpost_id, 'profession', profession) update_post_meta( newpost_id, 'status', status) You can learn more about it from codex.wordpress.org Ask AI about this post ChatGPT Claude Perplexity Grok

Business 20 30 28 July, 2026 Armenia-UK Business Forum 2026 to Be Held in Yerevan New Chapter of Armenian British Cooperation make preferable On 5 6 October 2026, Yerevan will host the inaugural Armenia-UK Business Forum 2026, strengthening business, investment and institutional ties between Armenia and the United Kingdom, opening with a Gala Concert on 5 October and continuing with the main business programme on 6 October. Organised by the Oxford Alumni Business Club of Armenia (OABCA) in partnership with Government of Armenia, represented by the Ministry of Economy, Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sport, Enterprise Armenia as well as the British-Armenian Chamber of Commerce (BACC), the Forum comes at a defining moment as Armenia continues to strengthen its position as a strategic destination for investment, trade and innovation. Amid deepening EU cooperation and initiatives such as the Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity (TRIPP), Armenia is reinforcing its role as an emerging gateway linking Europe, the Middle East and Asia, creating new opportunities for investors seeking resilient, long-term growth markets. The Forum will bring together 800 invited participants, including 100 UK delegates, 25 featured speakers and 10 institutional partners, spanning government, finance, infrastructure, nature resources and energy, AI, education and culture. "Strong economic partnerships are built through trust, continuity and meaningful dialogue. Our ambition is to establish a platform that brings together the right people - not only to discuss opportunities, but to create them. We believe the Armenia UK Business Forum can become a long-term catalyst for new investments, stronger institutional relationships and deeper business cooperation between our two countries," said Aleksandr Shagikyan, Chair of the Board of the Oxford Alumni Business Club of Armenia. Held under the theme "Building Bridges for Capital, Talent and Innovation," the Forum is a curated platform for senior decision-makers, built around six pillars Capital, Talent, Innovation, Infrastructure, Nature Resources and Energy, Partnership and Culture bringing together government leaders, investors, executives, innovators and academics to foster dialogue, build strategic partnerships and unlock new opportunities for Armenian British cooperation. The programme opens on 5 October with an invitation-only Gala Concert at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall the Forum's first act of bridge-building, translating the theme into culture. British cellist Guy Johnston performs Elgar's Cello Concerto with the Armenian State Symphony Orchestra, founded by Sergey Smbatyan, conducted by Dr Marios Papadopoulos MBE, Founder and Music Director of the Oxford Philharmonic Orchestra. The theme continues on 6 October with a dedicated panel, "The Cultural Bridge Heritage, Music and Cultural Diplomacy." The business programme will take place on 6 October at Dvin Music Hall, featuring keynote addresses, panel discussions, fireside conversations and curated business matchmaking. Speakers include Dr Alex Connock, Senior Fellow in Management Practice at Saïd Business School, University of Oxford. Bringing together public and private sector leaders, the programme will highlight successful partnerships, showcase practical case studies and explore new avenues for bilateral cooperation. The programme will culminate in the presentation of the Armenian British Bridge Builder Award. "Business leaders don't need another agenda full of panels they need the right room, the right people, and the right moment to turn conversation into commitment. Through curated programming, structured networking and targeted B2B and B2G meetings, we are designing an environment where dialogue turns into partnership and partnership into results," said Hayk Karapetyan, Founding Board Member of OABCA and Chair of the Organising Committee. Following the Forum, selected UK delegates and Armenian counterparts will join curated B2B and B2G meetings on 7 8 October to advance sector-specific discussions and long-term commercial partnerships. Registration is now open forum.oabc.am . About OABCA The Oxford Alumni Business Club of Armenia is an NGO uniting Armenian graduates of the University of Oxford, including Saïd Business School alumni, across finance, telecommunications, consulting, data science and international relations. Founded by Oxford alumni who returned to Armenia, the Club applies international expertise locally, launches impact-driven projects, and expands access to education and global opportunities. That special moment when a child is placed in the arms can be a blissful experience. New born babies not only put a smile on our face but they trigger something deep within us that triggers excess dopamine release in our brain. Researches say this overwhelming sense of joy when holding a baby is equivalent to the dopamine released when taking drugs like cocaine. New born babies give us a euphoric high of pure magic, sparkling hope and new beginnings in our lives That s great but what does that have to with holding a baby in my dreams? Well dreams like to use certain symbols to relay messages to you, and in your case holding a baby is a positive symbol suggesting happiness from something new in your life. Though this is a symbol that can interpreted in many different ways. Babies emerge in the dreams of women of all ages, even those well beyond child-bearing age. This can apply to men as well. The baby is not just an image of a wishful fulfillment or desire, but symbolizing something much deeper. Dream Holding A Baby Analysis Before we jump the gun and say babies simply imply something new on the horizon , first we must explore the context of your dream first. Alternatively holding a baby boy can be interpreted differently than holding a baby girl or even carrying the baby on your back. Dreams often speak to us in a metaphoric language that uses symbols and images to display its true meaning. Babies often appear in our dreams reflecting a major change occurring in your life, but where exactly? Your dream will offer you clues such as the gender of the baby, how you are carrying them, or if the baby belongs to somebody else. Reflecting on your emotions will mirror how you will embrace this new birth. The specific details in your dream such as locations, people and feelings will determine if this is an internal or external gift. Holding A Baby Dream Symbolism Internal rebirth Development, protection and growth Healing your inner child Unconditional love, benefits and rewards Fun Facts Newborns have natural aquatic instincts when in water and not born with kneecaps. Dreams Holding A Baby Girl Meaning Women who dream of holding a baby girl often it points to their own inner growth , rebirth or inner child . Men who dream of holding a baby girl relates to the development of their feminine nature that is often unconscious (see below). When a baby girl emerges for a women they are usually holding the baby in their arms. This is a symbol that mirrors the nurturing and preserving of your self love, protection, vulnerable, needy and soft nature. In essence you have reconnected with something that needs your love and protection. Alternatively the baby girl might be a manifestation of your own personal rebirth taking place in your life. The new you will be cared for and loved differently then the past. Changes in your relationships, ideas or your general disposition might be reflected though the baby girl. Fun Facts Babies will sleep, on average, 5400 hours in the first year. Their taste buds only recognize sweet and sour. Dreams Carrying A Baby Boy Dreams of holding or carrying a baby boy will differ from men to women. Men might view the baby boy as a representation of their own inner child, rebirth or inner development. A women can view the baby boy as nurturing her unconscious masculine traits . Courage Leadership Independence Assertiveness The baby boy becomes the image of inner growth that flowers the beginnings stages of her independent nature. This would be sort of like the balance or yin and yang energies that resides in you. According to analytical psychologist Carl Jung the boy could be the animus unconscious masculine side of a woman. The anima for men, once fully integrated the psyche becomes whole. Caring For Your Inner Child In every adult there lurks a child an eternal child, something that is always becoming, is never completed, and calls for unceasing care, attention, and education. That is the part of the personality which wants to develop and become whole . Carl Jung Alternatively the baby could be connected to your inner child , this is the hurt or damaged child you that needs your love and attention. Your past may have damaged this child from becoming a fully integrated adult. This can be anything from your parents separating, enduring physical or mental abuse, financial stress or emotional neglect. It can be even as simple as your sibling receiving more attention. In essence your dream might be connecting your with your inner child, or wanting you to communicate with him or her. Carrying A Baby On My Back The fact that you are holding or carrying a new born baby boy girl on your back could be a metaphoric translation. If something is behind you it is felt and not seen. Holding Somebody s Baby This is a very common dream but the context can change depending the baby you are holding. Who does it belong too? What do they mean to you? That I address you as a friend is no formality. I own no foes. My business in life has been for the past 33 years to enlist the friendship of the whole of humanity by befriending mankind, irrespective of race, colour or creed. I hope you will have the time and desire to know how a good portion of humanity who have view living under the influence of that doctrine of universal friendship view your action. We have no doubt about your bravery or devotion to your fatherland, nor do we believe that you are the monster described by your opponents. But your own writings and pronouncements and those of your friends and admirers leave no room for doubt that many of your acts are monstrous and unbecoming of human dignity, especially in the estimation of men like me who believe in universal friendliness. Such are your humiliation of Czechoslovakia, the rape of Poland and the swallowing of Denmark. I am aware that your view of life regards such spoliations as virtuous acts. But we have been taught from childhood to regard them as acts degrading humanity. Hence we cannot possibly wish success to your arms. But ours is a unique position. We resist British Imperialism no less than Nazism. If there is a difference, it is in degree. One-fifth of the human race has been brought under the British heel by means that will not bear scrutiny. Our resistance to it does not mean harm to the British people. We seek to convert them, not to defeat them on the battle-field. Ours is an unarmed revolt against the British rule. But whether we convert them or not, we are determined to make their rule impossible by non-violent non-co-operation. It is a method in its nature indefensible. It is based on the knowledge that no spoliator can compass his end without a certain degree of co-operation, willing or compulsory, of the victim. Our rulers may have our land and bodies but not our souls. They can have the former only by complete destruction of every Indian-man, woman and child. That all may not rise to that degree of heroism and that a fair amount of frightfulness can bend the back of revolt is true but the argument would be beside the point. For, if a fair number of men and women be found in India who would be prepared without any ill will against the spoliators to lay down their lives rather than bend the knee to them, they would have shown the way to freedom from the tyranny of violence. I ask you to believe me when I say that you will find an unexpected number of such men and women in India. They have been having that training for the past 20 years. We have been trying for the past half a century to throw off the British rule. The movement of independence has been never so strong as now. The most powerful political organization, I mean the Indian National Congress, is trying to achieve this end. We have attained a very fair measure of success through non-violent effort. We were groping for the right means to combat the most organized violence in the world which the British power represents. You have challenged it. It remains to be seen which is the better organized, the German or the British. We know what the British heel means for us and the non-European races of the world. But we would never wish to end the British rule with German aid. We have found in non-violence a force which, if organized, can without doubt match itself against a combination of all the most violent forces in the world. In non-violent technique, as I have said, there is no such thing as defeat. It is all 'do or die' without killing or hurting. It can be used practically without money and obviously without the aid of science of destruction which you have brought to such perfection. It is a marvel to me that you do not see that it is nobody's monopoly. If not the British, some other power will certainly improve upon your method and beat you with your own weapon. You are leaving no legacy to your people of which they would feel proud. They cannot take pride in a recital of cruel deed, however skilfully planned. I, therefore, appeal to you in the name of humanity to stop the war. You will lose nothing by referring all the matters of dispute between you and Great Britain to an international tribunal of your joint choice. If you attain success in the war, it will not prove that you were in the right. It will only prove that your power of destruction was greater. Whereas an award by an impartial tribunal will show as far as it is humanly possible which party was in the right. You know that not long ago I made an appeal to every Briton to accept my method of non-violent resistance. I did it because the British know me as a friend though a rebel. I am a stranger to you and your people. I have not the courage to make you the appeal I made to every Briton. Not that it would not apply to you with the same force as to the British. But my present proposal is much simple because much more practical and familiar. During this season when the hearts of the peoples of Europe yearn for peace, we have suspended even our own peaceful struggle. Is it too much to ask you to make an effort for peace during a time which may mean nothing to you personally but which must mean much to the millions of Europeans whose dumb cry for peace I hear, for my ears are attended to hearing the dumb millions? I had intended to address a joint appeal to you and Signor Mussolini, whom I had the privilege of meeting when I was in Rome during my visit to England as a delegate to the Round Table Conference. I hope that he will take this as addressed to him also with the necessary changes. I am,Your sincere friend,M.K. GANDHI

Study In life-years lost, H1N1 pandemic had sizable impact Robert Roos H1N1 2009 Pandemic Influenza Copied to clipboard Mar 23, 2010 (CIDRAP News) A new study argues that because the H1N1 influenza pandemic cut many young lives short, its real public health impact has been substantially greater than is generally perceived. In the study, a team of government and academic researchers came up with new estimates of deaths in the pandemic. By combining those with data on the age distribution of deaths, they estimated the number of "years of life lost" because of the pandemic. By that measure, its impact was at least as severe as a tough seasonal flu epidemic and possibly greater than the pandemic of 1968-69, they contend. "We conclude that the 2009 A H1N1 pandemic virus had a substantial health burden in the US over the first few months of circulation in terms of years of life lost, justifying the effort to protect the population with vaccination programs," says the report, published last night by PLoS Currents Influenza. In the interest of rapid dissemination, the online journal publishes studies that have been screened by experts but have not undergone formal peer review. The lead author of the study is Cecile Viboud, a research scientist at the National Institutes of Health's Fogarty International Center, and the senior author is Lone Simonsen, research professor at the Department of Global Health, George Washington University, School of Public Health and Health Services, Washington, D.C., and Bethesda, Md. Another co-author is Michael T. Osterholm, PhD, MPH, director of the University of Minnesota Center for Infectious Disease Research and Policy, publisher of CIDRAP News. Their report seeks to counter a popular view that the pandemic, at least to date, has been much "milder" than expected. This perception has prompted criticism that the threat was exaggerated by public health officials and by pharmaceutical companies hoping to profit from it. In particular, critics point to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) estimate that the pandemic has caused 12,000 deaths and note the CDC's own oft-quoted estimate that seasonal flu kills about 36,000 people annually. The authors of the PLoS study contend that such comparisons are misleading, because the estimates were derived by different methods and because seasonal flu kills almost exclusively elderly people, whereas the H1N1 pandemic has primarily preyed on children and younger adults. They sought to devise an "apples to apples" way to compare pandemic and seasonal flu mortality. To estimate the age distribution of pandemic deaths, they relied mainly on a European study of 468 laboratory-confirmed pandemic deaths, published in August 2009. It showed that more than 85 of the deaths were in people younger than 60, with an overall mean age of 37.4, as compared with an estimated mean age of 76 in those who die of seasonal flu. The team then developed an estimate of pandemic deaths, given that only a fraction of cases and deaths are laboratory tested and that final statistics will not be available for another 2 to 3 years. This task involved comparing preliminary mortality data from the CDC's 122 Cities mortality surveillance system with final mortality data from the National Center for Health Statistics for 1999 through 2006. The team also used data on deaths in non-flu-season months to estimate the number of monthly deaths that would occur in the absence of flu. Using these variables and the 122 Cities data for April through December 2009, the researchers estimated the pandemic death toll to be between 7,500 and 44,100. The lower number is based on deaths classified as due to pneumonia and influenza (P I). The higher number, Viboud told CIDRAP News by e-mail, is an estimate of "excess all-cause mortality, which is more inclusive as it also takes into account excess deaths from all respiratory and cardiovascular diseases that are associated with influenza infection, but may not be reported as such." She added that the "excess all-cause mortality" approach has traditionally been used to measure the impact of seasonal epidemics and for the 1957 and 1968 pandemics, while the P I approach has been used in assessing the 1918 pandemic. The team used both approaches to allow fair comparisons with past flu seasons, she said. The team's range of estimates is considerably wider than the CDC estimate of between 8,500 and 17,600 H1N1 deaths in 2009. Viboud said the CDC estimate relies primarily on hospitalizations for lab-confirmed flu and related hospital deaths, with a correction for underreporting. By applying the age-group mortality data from the European study to the estimated deaths, the researchers calculate that the pandemic took a toll of between 334,000 and 1,973,000 years of life lost (YLL). The team used the same method of estimating flu-related deaths to come up with YLL estimates for previous pandemics and for seasonal flu. The results The 1968 pandemic, with 86,000 deaths and victims averaging 62.2 years old, caused 1,693,000 YLL. The 1957 pandemic, with 150,600 deaths and a mean age of 64.6, caused 2,698,000 YLL. The 1918 pandemic, with an estimated 1,272,300 deaths and a mean age of only 27.2, exacted a toll of 63,718,000 YLL. An average flu season dominated by influenza A H3N2 which generally causes more severe epidemics than other strains causes 47,800 deaths and 594,000 YLL, with a mean age of 75.7. Thus, the authors say, the lower end of their YLL estimate for the H1N1 pandemic is comparable to the estimate for an H3N2-dominated flu season, while the upper end is greater than that for the 1968 pandemic. Those impacts, of course, are dwarfed by that of the catastrophic 1918 pandemic. "Based on US mortality surveillance data, we conclude that the YLL burden of the 2009 pandemic may in fact be as high as for the 1968 pandemic but that at this time the assessment is still tentative," the report states. More waves of H1N1 cases are likely to come over the next few flu seasons, and later waves could be worse, it says. The 1968 pandemic is regarded as the least severe of the three 20th century pandemic and has been described as mild. But Viboud objected to the latter characterization. "We do not like to use qualifiers such as 'mild,' 'moderate,' or 'severe' for influenza pandemics," she commented. "While the 1968 pandemic was associated with fewer deaths than the 1957 or 1918 pandemics, those deaths occurred in younger than usual age groups, as compared with typical seasonal influenza epidemics. By using the years of life lost metric, which takes into account both the number of deaths and their age distribution, the burden of the 1968 pandemic is estimated at about three times that of a typical influenza season in recent years, after adjusting for time trends in size and age structure of the US population." In their report, the authors write that using terms such as mild, moderate, and severe to describe the health impact of seasonal and pandemic flu "is insufficient, and possibly inappropriate," because they are based on just one outcome measure total deaths. "We recommend not using those terms anymore, because they really don't portray what happened," said Osterholm in an interview. "If there are 300,000 years of life lost, is that something mild?" Terms like mild and moderate not only don't reflect YLL, but also fail to count lost work productivity when young people die and the pandemic's impact on hospital intensive care units, he added. Concerning the CDC estimate of 36,000 deaths in an average flu season, Osterholm commented, "Those deaths in a traditional flu season are primarily in the elderly, where there's a question of how many cases you can prevent with vaccine anyway, whereas these H1N1 pandemic deaths are in a much younger population. From a public health perspective, it's clear that a death is not just a death." "I think we can all agree that we'd all like to live long, healthy, prosperous lives, and anything that has a median age of death of 37 years is something that cuts short many healthy prosperous lives," he said. The researchers don't claim to have found a single outcome measure that best describes the impact of a pandemic, but say the YLL approach is the best for now. "We're wide open to suggestions on how to better measure pandemic flu in relation to seasonal flu. How do you do it?" said Osterholm. Viboud C, Miller M, Olson D, et al. Download Your e-Aadhaar Instantly Get your digitally signed, password-protected Aadhaar PDF on your phone or computer in just 2 minutes. Secure and valid everywhere. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated.
