طه ١ مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ ٢ إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ ٣ تَنزِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى ٤ "Taha" Hum ne tujh par ye quran isliye naazil nahi kiya ke tu musibat me padd jaye. Balke nasihat karne ke liye, usko jo darta hai. Us ki taraf se utaara hua hai jis ne zameen ko aur oonche aasmano ko paida kiya" Allah Taala ne Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) ko mukhatib karke farmaya ke ye Quran aap aur aapke sahaba ke liye shiqawat o badbakhti ka sabab nahi hai, balke ye to Allah Taala se darne walo ke liye apni aayato me moazzat o nasihat liye hue hai, taakey wo isse istefadah karte hue khuloos niyat ke sath Allah ki bandagi kare aur is raah me kuffar o mushrekeen ki janib se jo bhi takleef pahuche use khandah peshani se bardasht kare. Aakhri aayat me Quran kareem ki azmat aur shaan ko bayaan kiya gaya hai ke Aey Mere Nabi! Ye Quran aap par aap ke Rab ki janib se naazil hua hai , jis ne zameen aur oonche aasman paida kiye hain. Makhlooqat me se zameen o aasman ka bataur khaas isliye zikar aaya ke bande Allah ki azeem makhlooqat ka har waqt mushahidah karte rehte hain. مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ Saiyyada Aayesha (Razi Allahu anha) bayan karti hain ke Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) unke paas tashreef laye, tab unke paas ek aurat baithi hui thi. Aap ne poochha "Ye kaun hai?" Maine jawab diya, ye fala'n aurat hai jo raat bhar nahi soti aur inn ki namaz (tahajjud) ka zikar kiya gaya, to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Bas tumhe itna hi amal karna chahiye jitne ki tum me taqat ho, kyonki Allah ki kasam! Allah (sawab dene se) nahi uktata, lekin tum khud hi (amal karte karte) ukta jaoge aur Allah Taala ko sab se zyada mehboob ibadat o itaat wo hai jis par amal karne wala hameshgi kare." Bukhari 1151, Muslim 785 221 Saiyyadna Abu Huraira'h (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Yaqeenan deen aasan hai aur jo deen mein beja sakhti karta hai to deen uspar ghalib aajata hai. Pas tum seedhe raste par raho myanarawi ikhtiyaar karo aur (apne rab ki tarf se milne wale ajar par) khush ho jao aur subah o shaam aur raat ke kuch hisse mein ibadat se madad talab karo." Bukhari 39 Saiyyadna Anas (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) masjid mein tashreef laye to ek rassi ko do satoono ke darmiyan bandha hua paya. Aap ne poochha "Ye rassi kis maqsad ke liye hai?" Logon ne batlaya ke ye Saiyyada Zainab (Razi Allahu anha) ki rassi hai, jab wo (ibadat karte karte) thak jati hain to iske sath sahara le leti hain. Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) ne farmaya "aisa na karo, ise khol do, tum me se har shakhs ko chahiye ke wo uss waqt namaz padhe jab wo farhat o nishaat mehsoos kare, jab thak jaye to wo baith jaye." Bukhari 1150, Muslim 784 Saiyyadna hanzalah bin Rabi Aseedi (Razi Allahu anhu) se riwayat hai aur ye Nabi (ﷺ) ke katibo mein se the, bayan farmate hain ke mujhe Abu Bakar(Razi Allahu anhu) mile, unhone poochha, hanzalah! kaise ho? Maine kaha, hanzalah to munafiq ho gaya hai. Abu Bakar ne farmaya, Subhan Allah! Ye tum kya keh rahe ho? Maine kaha, (baat ye hai ke jab) hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas hote hain to Aap hamare saamne jannat aur dozakh ka is tarah tazkirah karte hain goya hum unhe aankho se dekh rahe ho, lekin jab hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki majlis se nikal aate hain aur biwi aur bachcho aur duniya ke karobar mein mashghool ho jate hain to hum bahut kuch bhool jate hain. Abu Bakar ne farmaya, Allah ki kasam! aisi hi kaifiyat se to hum bhi dochaar hain. Chunanche mai aur Abu Bakar (Razi Allahu anhu)(dono) chalte chalte Nabi Kareem(ﷺ) ki khidmat me pahuch gaye. Maine kaha, Aye Allah ke Rasool! hanzalah to munafiq ho gaya hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "wo kaise?" Maine kaha, Ya Rasool Allah! Hum aapke paas hote hain aur aap hamare saamne jannat aur dozakh ka tazkirah farmaate hain to aise maalum hota hai ke hum apni aankho'n se ye sab dekh rahe hain, phir jab hum aapki majlis se nikal jate hain to biwi bachcho aur karobar mein mashghool ho jate hain to hum bahut kuch bhool jate hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "iss zaat ki qasam, jiske hath me meri jaan hai! Agar tum hamesha isi haalat o kaifiyat me raho jis mein tum mere paas hote ho aur (har waqt) Allah ki yaad mein raho to farishte tumhare bistaro aur tumhare raasto mein tum se musafah kare, lekin aey hanzalah! Waqt waqt ki baat hai." Aapne teen martaba ye jumla irshad farmaya. Muslim 2750 إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٖ وَأَجۡرٖ كَرِيمٍ ١١ Ya-Sin 36 11 "Tu sirf usi ko darata hai jo nasihat ki pairawi kare aur Rehman se bin dekhe dare. So use badi bakhshish aur ba-izzat ajr ki khushkhabri de." Saiyyadna Moaviya (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Allah Taala jis ke sath bhalayi ka irada farmata hai to usey deen ki samajh ata farma deta hai." Bukhari 71, Muslim 1037 ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ ٥ "Wo behad reham wala arsh par buland hua." Khaliq arz-o-samaa aur duniya-o-aakhirat mein reham karne wala wo Allah hai jo arsh par mustavi hai. Allah ki sifat "Astava" ke bare mein salf saleheen ka ye aqeedah hai ke Quran-o-Sunnat mein Allah Taala ki jo sifat sabit hain unhe isi tarah taweel-o-tahreef, tashbiya-o-tamseel aur baghair koi kaifiyat bayan kiye hue maan liya jaye. لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ ٦ "Usi ka hai jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo zameen mein hai aur jo un dono ke darmiyan hai aur geeli mitti ke neeche hai." Aasman aur zameen mein aur unke darmiyan jo kuch bhi hai, wo sab Allah ki milkiyat aur uske zer-e-saltanat hai, unme se koi bhi cheez Allah ki marzi ke baghair harkat nahi karti, na badalti hai aur na qarar pati hai. وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى ٧ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ ٨ "Aur agar tu oonchi aawaz se baat kare to wo posheeda aur uss se bhi posheeda baat ko janta hai. Allah wo hai jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, sabse achhe naam usi ke hain" Yani agar aap ba-aawaz buland Allah ko yaad karte hain aur dua-o-munaajaat karte hain, to jaan lijiye ke Allah isse beniyaaz hai, kyonki wo to chhupe hue raazo'n ko bhi jaanta hai, balke raaz haaye sar basta se bhi zyada makhfi baaton ko jaanta hai, jinhe ibn-e-aadam nahin jaanta, jinka ilm sirf allam-ul-ghayyub ko hota hai, jaisa ke irshad farmaya قُلۡ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا ٦ Al-Furqan 25 6 "To keh isey usne naazil kiya hai jo aasmano aur zameen mein sab poshidah baaton ko jaanta hai. Beshak wo hamesha se behadd bakhshane wala, nihayat reham wala hai." Aage farmaya ke mazkurah baala e tareeqey ibadat ka mustahiq wo Allah hai jiske siwa koi mabood haqeeqi nahi hai aur tamaam pakeeza naamo ka sirf wahi sazawaar hai. ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ Saiyyadna Abu Huraira'h (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya " Allah Taala ke ek kam saw 99 naam hain jo shakhs unko yaad karega wo jannat me dakhil hoga." Bukhari 7392 وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ ٩ إِذۡ رَءَا نَارٗا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدٗى ١٠ فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ ١١ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوٗى ١٢ وَأَنَا ٱخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَٱسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ ١٣ إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ ١٤ "Aur kya tere paas Moosa ki khabar pahuchi hai. Jab usne ek aag dekhi to apne gharwalo se kaha tum thehro, beshak maine ek aag dekhi hai, shayad main tumhare paas usse koi angara le aaun, ya us aag par koi rehnumayi haasil kar lu. To jab wo uske paas aaya to use aawaz di gayi Aye Moosa! Beshak main hi tera Rab hoon, so apni dono jootiyan utar de, beshak tu paak wadi Tuwa mein hai. Aur maine tujhe chun liya hai, pas ghaur se sun jo kuch wahi kiya jata hai. Beshak main hi Allah hoon, mere siwa koi ma'bood nahin, so meri ibadat kar aur meri yaad ke liye namaz qayam kar." In aayaat mein Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam par nuzool wahi ki ibteda aur Allah Taala se humkalaam hone ka waqia bayan kiya ja raha hai. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam "Madyan" mein dus saal guzar kar apni biwi ke saath Misr ki taraf rawana hue, to maslehat-e-ilaahi ke mutabiq Toor-e-seena k qareeb raasta kho baithe, mausam-e-sarma ki sard aur andheri raat thi, unhe roshni aur aag dono ki zarurat thi, Toor ki taraf se unhe aag ki roshni nazar aayi to apni biwi se bataur khush khabri kaha ke tum yahin ruki raho, main tumhare liye aag lekar aata hoon, ya shayad wahan koi aadmi mil jaye jo humari rehnumayi kare. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam jab aag ke qareeb pahuche to wahan maamla hi doosra tha. Wahan waadi ke dahine janib ek darakht tha jo baqaa-e-noor bana hua tha, wahan se aawaz aayi, Aye Moosa! Main aap ka Rab hoon aur aap se mukhatib hoon aur aap is waqt muqaddas wadi Tuwa mein khade hain. Apne Rab ke liye taazeem-o-tawazey aur adab ka izhar karte hue joota utar dijiye. Maine aapko iss zamane ke tamam logon ke darmiyan se chun liya hai aur apni paighambari ke liye muntakhib kar liya hai, isliye ab aap par jo wahi nazil hone ja rahi hai use ghaur se suniye aur uski zimmedari qubool karne ke liye tayyar ho jaiye. Main hi Allah hoon, mere siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahi hai, isliye sirf meri ibadat kijiye aur mujhe yaad karne ke liye namaz qayam kijiye. وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ Saiyyadna Abu Huraira'h (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Khaibar se laut'te waqt raat ko safar karte rahe, jab aakhir shab hui to aapko oongh aane lagi, tab Aap ne padao kiya aur Bilal(Razi Allahu anhu) se kaha " Aaj ki raat tum hamara pehra do." Chunanche Saiyyadna Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) namaz padhte rahe, jitni ke unki taqdeer mein thi aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) so gaye aur aapke as-haab bhi so gaye. Phir jab subeh qareeb hui to Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) mashriq ki taraf munh karke apni oontni se tekk laga kar baith gaye aur unki aankh lag gayi. Phir na to Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hi jaage aur na Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) aur na aapke sahaba mein se kisiko jaag aayi, yahan tak ke jab un par dhoop padi, to sab se pehle Rasool Allah (ﷺ) jaage. Aap ghabra gaye aur pukara " Aye Bilal!" Bilal(Razi Allahu anhu) ne arz ki, Aye Allah ke Rasool ! Mere maa baap aap par qurban ! Mere nafs ko bhi usi ne pakad liya jis ne aapke nafs ko pakda. Aap ne sahaba se farmaya "oonto ko haanko!" Unhone thodi der oonto ko haanka to phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ) utre. Aap ne wazu kiya aur Saiyyadna Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) ko iqamat kehne ka hukam diya, so Saiyyadna Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) ne namaz ki iqamat kahi aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne subeh ki namaz padhayi. Jab aap namaz padh chuke to farmaya "Jo shakhs namaz padhna bhool jaye to jab yaad aajaye tab padh le, isliye ke Allah Taala farmata hai وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ Taha 20 14 "Aur meri yaad ke liye namaz qayam kar." Muslim 680 Saiyyadna Anas (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya " Jab koi namaz ke waqt soya reh jaye ya namaz padhna bhool jaye to usko chahiye ke jab yaad aajaye to namaz padhle, isliye ke Allah Taala farmata hai وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ Taha 20 14 "Aur meri yaad ke liye namaz qayam kar." Muslim 683 316, Bukhari 597 Saiyyadna Anas (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Jo shakhs namaz bhool jaye ya so jaye to uska kaffara ye hai ke use usi waqt padh le jab use yaad aaye, bas uska yehi kaffara hai." Bukhari 597, Muslim 684 315, 314 إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۢ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ ١٥ "Yaqeenan qayamat aane wali hai, mai qareeb hoon ke use chhupa kar rakhun, taake har shakhs ko uska badla diya jaye jo wo koshish karta hai." Yaani qayamat ka waqoo pazeer hona amar yaqeeni hai, isme koi shak-o-shuba'h nahi hai, lekin Allah ne uska waqt mehdood tamam ins-o-jin se itna poshidah rakha hai ke qareeb tha ke uska zikr hi na karta, use sigha-e-raaz me rakhta yahan tak ke achanak waqa'y ho jati. Lekin apne momin bando par reham karte hue, unhe amal saleh ki targheeb dilane ke liye aur taake ghair momino ke liye koi uzr baqi na rahe, uska ajmaali taur par zikr kar diya. Uss din Baari Taala tamam insano ko unke nek-o-bad aamaal ka badla chukayega jo unhone duniya mein apne ikhtiyaar aur marzi se kiye honge, irshad farmaya فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ ٧ وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ ٨ "To jo shakhs ek zarra barabar neki karega use dekh lega. Aur jo shakhs ek zarra barabar burayi karega use dekh lega." فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ ١٦ "So tujhe usse wo shakhs kahi rok na de jo us par yaqeen nahi rakhta aur apni khwahish ke peechhe laga hua hai, pas wo halaak ho jayega." Is aayat me Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ko nasihat ki ke kahi aisa na ho ke munkareen-e-aakhirat aur khwahishat ki itteba karne wale aapko aakhirat par imaan lane se rok de. Yaani aap aise logon ki pairawi na kijiye jo aakhirat ka inkaar karte hain aur jinki zindagi ka maqsad husool-e-lazzat duniya hai, isliye wo husool razaa-e-maula se bilkul ghafil hain. وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ١٧ قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَ َٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ ١٨ "Aur ye tere daye hath mein kya hai Aye Moosa!? Kaha ye meri laathi hai, main iss par tekk lagata hoon aur uske saath apni bakriyon par patte jhaadta hoon aur mere liye isme kayi aur zaroorate hain." Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se poochha ke aapke daye hath mein kya hai? Unhone jawab diya, ye meri laathi hai, jis par main tekk lagata hoon aur iske zariye se main apni bakriyon ke khane ke liye darakhto'n se patte giraata hoon aur main ise deegar kaamo ke liye bhi istemal karta hoon, yaani main is par apna zaad-e-safar aur pani latka kar apne kandhe par dhota hoon. قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ ١٩ فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٞ تَسۡعَىٰ ٢٠ قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٢١ "Farmaya use phenk de Aye Moosa! To usne use phenka to achanak wo ek saanp tha jo daudta tha. Farmaya use pakad aur darr nahi, anqareeb hum use uski pehli haalat me lauta denge." Allah Taala ne farmaya, Aye Moosa! Aap apni laathi zameen par daal dijiye. Unhone use zameen par daal diya, to Allah Taala ne uske ausaaf badal kar use ek lambe chaude maheeb saanp ki shakal de di, jo tezi se darawni harkate karne laga aur rassi ke saanpo'n ko nigalne laga. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne apni laathi ka jab ye haal dekha to darr kar bhaagne lage. Allah Taala ne unse kaha ke aap use pakad lijiye aur darein nahi, hum use pehle ki tarah laathi bana denge. Chunanche unhone aisa hi kiya to wo laathi ban gayi jo unke haath mein pehle se thi. وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ ٢٢ لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى ٢٣ "Aur apna haath apne pehlu ki taraf mila, wo kisi aib ke baghair safed (chamakta hua) niklega, iss haal mein ke ek aur nishani hai. Taake hum tujhe apni chand badi nishaniyan dikhaye." Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se farmaya ke aap apna haath apne gireban mein daal kar nikaaliye, wo baghair kisi beemari aur aib ke khoobsurat chamakta hua hoga. Ye aapki nabuwwat ki sadaqat par dalalat karne wala dusra maujaza hoga, jaisa ke irshad farmaya ٱسۡلُكۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٖ وَٱضۡمُمۡ إِلَيۡكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ ٱلرَّهۡبِۖ فَذَٰنِكَ بُرۡهَٰنَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ ٣٢ Al-Qasas 28 32 "Apna haath apne gireban mein dakhil kar, wo kisi aib ke baghair safed (chamakdaar) niklega aur khauf se (bachne ke liye) apna baazu apni janib mila le, so ye dono tere Rab ki janib se Firaun aur uske sardaaro'n ki taraf do daleelein hain." ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ٢٤ "Firaun ki taraf ja, beshak wo sarkash ho gaya hai." Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ko maujzaat diye jane ka maqsad bayan kiya ja raha hai ke Aye Moosa! Maujzaat lekar hamare Rasool ki haisiyat se aap Firaun ke paas jaiye, jo apni hadd se tajawuz karke ma'bood hone ka dawa kar baitha hai, use uski haisiyat yaad dilaiye aur meri ibadat ka hukum dijiye. Dusre maqam par Allah Taala ne irshad farmaya ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ٤٣ فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ ٤٤ Taha 20 43, 44 "Dono Firaun ke paas jao, beshak wo sarkash ho gaya hai. Pas usse baat karo, narm baat, iss ummeed par ke wo nasihat haasil kar le, ya darr jaye."Aur farmaya ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ١٧ فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ ١٨ وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ ١٩ فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ ٢٠ Al-Nazi'at 79 17 to 20 "Firaun ke paas ja, yaqeenan wo hadd se badh gaya hai. Pas keh kya tujhe iss baat ki koi raghbat hai ke tu paak ho jaye? Aur main tere Rab ki taraf teri rehnumayi karu, pas tu darr jaye. Chunanche usne use bahot badi nishani dikhayi." قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي ٢٥ وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي ٢٦ وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي ٢٧ يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي ٢٨ "Usne kaha Aye mere Rab! Mere liye mera seena khol de. Aur mere liye mera kaam aasaan karde. Aur meri zubaan ki kuch gireh khol de. Ke wo meri baat samajh le." Jab unhe Firaun ke saamne dawat-o-tauheed dene ka hukum hua, to socha ke unke kandho par ek azeem zimmedari daal di gayi hai, ek taraf ba-haisiyate insaan unhe apni kam maayegi aur besar-o-saamani yaad aarahi thi, to dusri taraf Firaun jaise azeem shah Misr ki quwwat-o-jabroot aur uska jaah-o-jalal unki aankho'n ke saamne ghoom raha tha. Isiliye unhone Allah se dua ki ke Aye Allah! Mera seena khol de aur mujh par jo zimmedari daali hai, use aasan karde, isliye ke teri nusrat-o-aanat ke baghair itni badi zimmedari mere naatawa'n kandhe bardasht nahi kar sakenge aur meri zubaan ki gireh khol de, taake jab main firauniyo ke saamne teri dawat paish karu to meri baat ko samajh sakein. Irshad farmaya قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ ١٢ وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ ١٣ وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ ١٤ Ash-Shu'ara 26 12 to 14 "Usne kaha Aye mere Rab! Beshak main darta hoon ke wo mujhe jhutla denge. Aur mera seena tang padta hai aur meri zuban nahi chalti, so tu Haroon ki taraf paigham bhej. Aur unka mere zimme ek gunah hai, pas main darta hoon ke wo mujhe qatal kar denge." وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرٗا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي ٢٩ هَٰرُونَ أَخِي ٣٠ ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي ٣١ وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي ٣٢ كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرٗا ٣٣ وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا ٣٤ إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرٗا ٣٥ قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٣٦ "Aur mere ghar walo mein se ek bojh bataane wala bana de. Haroon ko, jo mera bhai hai. Uske sath meri pusht mazboot karde. Aur use mere kaam mein shareek karde. Taakey hum teri bahot tasbeeh kare. Aur tujhe bahot yaad kare. Beshak tu hamesha humare haal ko khoob dekhne wala raha hai. Farmaya beshak tujhe tera sawal ata kar diya gaya Aye Moosa!" Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne dua ki, Aye mere Rab ! Mere khandaan walo mein se mere bhai Haroon ko risalat ki zimmedari uthane mein mera shareek-o-madadgaar bana de, taakey hum teri khoob tasbeeh bayan kare aur tujhe khoob yaad kare. Tu humare halaat se baa khabar hai aur tu jaanta hai ke maine tujh se jo maanga hai wo humare liye mufeed hai. Allah Taala ne unki dua qubool farma li, unka seena khol diya, unki nusrat-o-aanat ka wada farmaya, unki zaban ki girah khol di aur unke bhai Haroon ko nabi bana kar Firaun ke saamne dawat paish karne ki zimmedari mein unka shareek-o-madadgaar bana diya. Irshad farmaya قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي قَتَلۡتُ مِنۡهُمۡ نَفۡسٗا فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ ٣٣ وَأَخِي هَٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفۡصَحُ مِنِّي لِسَانٗا فَأَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِيَ رِدۡءٗا يُصَدِّقُنِيٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ ٣٤ Al-Qasas 28 33, 34 "Kahaa- Aye mere Rab! Beshak maine unme se ek shakhs ko qatal kiya hai, isliye darta hoon ke wo mujhe qatal kar denge. Aur mera bhai Haroon, wo zaban mein mujhse zyada faseeh hai, to use mere saath madadgaar bana kar bhej ke meri tasdeeq kare, beshak main darta hoon ke wo mujhe jhutla denge." Saiyyadna Saad Bin Abi Waqas (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Saiyyadna Ali (Razi Allahu anhu) se farmaya "Kya tum iss par khush nahi ho ke tum mere liye aise ho jaise Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ke liye Haroon (AS)Alehis Salam the?" Bukhari 3706 قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجۡعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيۡكُمَا بِ َٔايَٰتِنَآۚ أَنتُمَا وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكُمَا ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ ٣٥ Al-Qasas 28 35 "Kaha hum tere bhai ke sath tera baazu zaroor mazboot karenge aur tum dono ke liye ghalba rakhenge, so wo tum tak nahi pahuchenge, humari nishaniyo'n ke sath tum dono aur jinhone tumhari pairawi ki, ghalib aane wale ho." وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ ٣٧ إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ ٣٨ أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوّٞ لِّي وَعَدُوّٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةٗ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ ٣٩ "Aur bila shuba h yaqeenan hum ne tujh par ek aur baar bhi ehsaan kiya. Jab humne teri maa ko wahi ki, jo wahi ki jati thi. Ye ke tu use sandooq me daal, phir use dariya mein daal de, phir dariya usey kinare par daal de, use ek mera dushman aur uska dushman utha lega aur maine tujh par apni taraf se ek mohabbat daal di aur taakey teri parwarish meri aankhon ke saamne ki jaye." Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki maa ko bazariye ilham hukum diya ke wo apne bachche ko ek sandooq me rakh kar apne khaliq-o-maalik par bharosa karte hue dariya me daal de, taakey dariya Allah ke hukum se uss sandooq ko uss jagah pahucha de jahan Firaun nahaya karta tha. Chunanche aisa hi hua aur sandooq tairta hua us neher tak pahunch gaya jo dariya se nikal kar Firaun ke mahal tak pahunchti thi. Jab Allah aur uske Rasool Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ke dushman ne wo sandooq dekha to use nikaalne ka hukum diya. Usme bachcha dekh kar Allah ki masiyat ke mutabiq Firaun bahot hi khush hua. Allah ne uske aur dusro ke dil me Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki mohabbat paiwast kardi, taakey Allah ke hifz-o-amaan me Firaun ke ghar hi mein parwarish-o-pardaakht ho. أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوّٞ لِّي وَعَدُوّٞ لَّهُۥۚ فَٱلۡتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمۡ عَدُوّٗا وَحَزَنًاۗ إِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُواْ خَٰطِ ِٔينَ ٨ وَقَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ قُرَّتُ عَيۡنٖ لِّي وَلَكَۖ لَا تَقۡتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوۡ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدٗا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٩ Al-Qasas 28 8,9 "To Firaun ke ghar walo ne use utha liya, taakey aakhir unke liye dushman ho aur gham ka ba-iss ho. Beshak Firaun aur Haamaan aur unke lashkar khatakaar the. Aur Firaun ki biwi ne kaha ye mere liye aur tere liye aankhon ki thandak hai, ise qatal na karo, ummeed hai ke wo hume fayda pahuchaye, ya hum use beta bana lein aur wo samajhte na the." إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٖ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٤٠ وَٱصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِي ٤١ "Jab teri behan chali jati thi, pas kehti thi kya main tumhe uska pata doon jo uski parwarish kare? Pas humne tujhe teri maa ki taraf lauta diya, taakey uski aankh thandi ho aur wo gham na kare. Aur tune ek shakhs ko qatal kar diya humne tujhe gham se nijaat di aur humne tujhe aazmaaya, khoob aazmaana, phir kayi saal tu madyan walo me thehra raha, phir tu ek muqarrar andaze par aaya Aye Moosa! Aur maine tujhe apne liye khaas taur par banaya hai." Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam jab Firaun ke ghar pahuch gaye to wo aur uski biwi unse khoob mohabbat karne lage, lekin masiyat e Ilaahi ke mutabiq wo kisi bhi doodh pilane wali daiya ka doodh peene se munh band kar lete the. Unki behan Maryam Bint-e-Imraan ne jo lamha ba-lamha unki khabar le rahi thi, jab suna ke Firaun aur uski biwi Aasiya kisi daiya ki talaash mein hain, to kaha kya main aap logon ko ek daiya ka pata doon, jo is bachche ko doodh pilayegi aur uski parwarish-o-pardakht karegi? Unhone poochha ke wo kaun hai? To kaha ke wo meri maa hai, jinki godd mein mera ek saal ka bhai Haroon hai. Chunanche jab unhe bulaya gaya to Moosa fauran unka doodh peene lage. Iss tarah Allah ne unhe unki maa tak pahuncha diya, taakey unki maa ki aankhein thandi ho aur bachche ko dariya mein daal dene ki wajah se unhe jo gham laahaq hua tha uska azaala ho. Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam par ek ehsaan ye bhi kiya ke unhone Firaun ke ghar mein bade hokar ek qabti ko ghalti se qatal kar diya to sabhi firauni unke qatal ke dar pe ho gaye. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam wahan se jaan bacha kar bhaag nikle aur Allah Taala ne unki ye laghzish maaf kardi. Isi tarah nabi banne se pehle gonago'n aazmaisho'n se guzre aur har baar Allah Taala ne unki madad ki aur jab firauniyo ke darr se bhaag kar madyan pahunche to ek mard saleh ne sara majra sun kar kaha ke ab tumhe darne ki zarurat nahi, yahan aakar tum zaalimo se nijaat paa chuke ho. Chunanche wahan 20 ya 28 saal iss nek shakhs ki zer tarbiyat rahe aur phir hikmat-e-ilaahi ke taihat wahan se apni biwi ko lekar chale aur Toor-e-seena ke paas pahuche to Allah Taala ne unhe paighambari ata ki aur unse hum kalaam hua. Toor tak uss waqt unka pahuchna Allah taala ke ilm mein pehle se muqaddar tha jiski unhe koi khabar nahi thi. Agli aayat me Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se farmaya ke maine aapko apni risalat ke liye chun liya hai aur mukhtalif maraahil se guzaar kar iski zimmedariyan poori karne ke qabil banaya hai, lihaza Firaun aur bani Israel ko mera paigham achhi tarah pahuncha dijiye aur unhe mujh par imaan laane aur amaal saleh karne ki dawat dijiye, taakey unhe duniya-o-aakhirat mein bhalayi haasil ho. وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ Jawan hone ke baad Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne Firaun ki qaum ke ek shakhs ko ghalti se qatal kar diya aur jab unhe maloom hua ke hukumat unhe qasaas mein qatal karne wali hai to wo uss shehar ko chhorh kar chale gaye, irshad farmaya وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ١٤ وَدَخَلَ ٱلۡمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيۡنِ يَقۡتَتِلَانِ هَٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَٰذَا مِنۡ عَدُوِّهِۦۖ فَٱسۡتَغَٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِي مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِي مِنۡ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهِۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِنۡ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوّٞ مُّضِلّٞ مُّبِينٞ ١٥ Al-Qasas 28 14, 15 "Aur jab wo apni jawani ko pahucha aur poora taqatwar ho gaya to humne use quwwat faisla aur ilm ata kiya aur isi tarah neki karne walo ko hum badla dete hain. Aur wo shehar mein uske rehne walo ki kisi qadar ghaflat ke waqt dakhil hua to usme do aadmiyo ko paya ke ladd rahein hain, ye uski qaum se hai aur ye uske dushmano mein se hai. To jo uski qaum se tha uss ne usse uske khilaf madad maangi jo uske dushmano mein se tha, to Moosa ne use ghoonsa maara to uska kaam tamam kar diya. Kaha ye shaitaan ke kaam se hai, yaqeenan wo khullam khulla gumraah karne wala dushman hai." Irshad farmaya فَخَرَجَ مِنۡهَا خَآئِفٗا يَتَرَقَّبُۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٢١ وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلۡقَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَن يَهۡدِيَنِي سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ٢٢ Al-Qasas 28 21, 22 "to wo darta hua usse nikal pada, intezar karta tha, kaha Aye mere Rab! Mujhe un zaalim logon se bacha le. Aur jab usne Madyan ki taraf rukh kiya to kaha mera Rab qareeb hai ke mujhe seedhe raste par le jaye." Fazeel bin Ayaaz (RahimaUllah) bayan karte hain ke maine Saalim bin Abdullah (Razi Allahu anhu) ko farmate hue suna, Aye Ahle Iraaq! Main tumse chhote gunah se mutalliq nahin poochhta, na uske mutalliq poochhta hoon jo kabeera gunah karta ho. Maine suna apne baap Saiyyadna Abdullah bin Umar(Razi Allahu anhu) se, wo kehte the, maine suna Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se, Aap (ﷺ) farmate the "Fitna idhar se aage aayega." Aur aapne apne haath se mashriq ki taraf ishara kiya aur farmaya "Jahan se shaitaan ke dono qarn niklenge aur tum ek dusre ki gardan maarte ho (haalake momin ka qatal kitna bada gunah hai)." Aur Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne jo Firaun ki qaum ka ek shakhs maara tha wo khata se maara tha (na ke qatal ki niyat se, kyunki ghoonse se aadmi nahi marta) is par Allah Taala ne farmaya وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ "Aur tune ek shakhs ko qatal kar diya to humne tujhe gham se nijat di aur humne tujhe aazmaya, khoob aazmana." Muslim 7297 Yaani maine apni marzi-o-masiyat se apne apne rasool ke taur par tumhara intekhab kar liya hai, Imam Bukhari (RaimaUllah) ne is aayat-e-kareema ki tafseer bayan karte hue wo hadees bayan ki, jise Saiyyadna Abu Huraira'h (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Saiyyadna Adam (AS)Alehis Salam aur Saiyyadna Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki mulaqat hui, to Saiyyadna Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha, Aapne logon ko mashqqat me daal diya aur unhe jannat se nikalwa diya? Saiyyadna Adam (AS)Alehis Salam ne farmay, Aap wahi hain jinhe Allah ne apni risalat se mumtaz farmaya aur apne liye pasand farmaya aur Tauraat ata farmayi? Saiyyadna Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne farmaya, Haan! Phir Saiyyadna Adam (AS)Alehis Salam ne farmaya, Kya aap ne usme ye nahi padha ke meri paidaish se pehle ye sab mere liye likh diya gaya tha? Kaha, Haan ! Algharz Saiyyadna Adam (AS)Alehis Salam Saiyyadna Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam par daleel mein ghalba pa gaye." Bukhari 4736, Muslim 2652 ٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِ َٔايَٰتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكۡرِي ٤٢ ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ٤٣ فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ ٤٤ "Tu aur tera bhai meri aayaat lekar jao aur meri yaad mein susti na karna. Dono Firaun ke paas jao, beshak wo sarkash ho gaya hai. Pas usse baat karo, narm baat, iss ummeed par ke wo nasihat haasil kar le, ya darr jaye." Aye Moosa ! Aap aur aapke bhai Haroon jinke liye aapne dua ki hai, mere dono maujzaat lekar, jinka zahoor meri qudrat se aapke saamne ho chuka hai, daawat ke liye aage badhiye aur aap dono par ab tak maine jo ehsanaat-o-inaamaat kiye hain unhe yaad rakhiye aur tableegh risalat mein tand hi se kaam lijiye. Aap dono mera paigham lekar Firaun ke paas jaiye jisne sarkashi ki raah ikhtiyaar karli hai aur apne aapko ek banda-e-aajiz maanne ke bajaye Rab aur Maabood hone ka dawa kar baitha hai aur dekhiye aap dono ka asloob-e- bayan narm hona chahiye. Isliye ke narm guftugu bade bade zaalimo'n aur sarkasho'n ko bhi baaz auqaat mom bana deti hai. Shayad ke aap dono ki baatein use ghaur-o-fikr par majboor kar de aur wo imaan-o-hidayat ki raah apna le, ya dare ke agar kufr-o-zulm par misr raha to Allah ka azaab usey apni giraft mein le lega. فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ Ye aayat-e-kareema azeem-o-shaan nasihat par mushtamil hai, dekhiye ! Firaun zulm-o-istabdaad aur sarkashi-o-baghawat mein hadd se badha hua tha, Moosa uss waqt saare insaano mein sabse pasandeedah aur Allah Taala ke muntakhib kardah the, iske bawajood Allah Taala ne unhe hukum diya ke Firaun se mukhatib hote waqt lab-o-lehja narm rakhein aur use malaimat-o-shaistagi se daawat de, jaisa ke irshad farmaya ٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَٱلۡمَوۡعِظَةِ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ وَجَٰدِلۡهُم بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُۚ An-Nahl 16 125 "Apne Rab ke raste ki taraf hikmat aur achhi nasihat ke sath bula aur unse iss tareeqey ke sath behas kar jo sabse achha hai." Saiyyadna Jareer (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Jo shakhs narmi se mehroom kar diya gaya wo bhalaayi se mehroom kar diya gaya". Muslim 2592 Saiyyada Ayesha (Razi Allahu anha) bayan karti hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Aye Aayesha ! Beshak Allah narm hai, narmi ko pasand karta hai aur jo kuch wo narmi par ataa farmata hai sakhti par ataa nahin farmata aur na uske alawa kisi aur cheez par ataa farmata hai." Muslim 2593 قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ ٤٥ قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ ٤٦ فَأۡتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡۖ قَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِ َٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ٤٧ إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ٤٨ قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٤٩ قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ ٥٠ "Dono ne kaha Aye mere Rab! Yaqeenan hum darte hain ke wo hum par zyadti karega, ya ke hadd se badh jayega. Farmaya daro nahin, beshak main tum dono ke sath hoon, main sun raha hoon aur dekh raha hoon. To uske paas jao aur kaho beshak hum tere Rab ke bheje hue hain, pas tu bani Israel ko humare sath bhej de aur unhe azaab na de, yaqeenan hum tere paas tere Rab ki taraf se ek nishani lekar aaye hain aur salam uss par jo hidayat ke peechhe chale. Beshak hum, yaqeenan humari taraf wahi ki gayi hai ke beshak azaab uss par hai jisne jhutlaya aur munh phera. Usne kaha to tum dono ka Rab kaun hai Aye Moosa!? Kaha humara Rab wo jisne har cheez ko uski shakal-o-surat bakhshi, phir rasta dikhaya." Dono bhaiyo ne Allah ka hukum paane ke baad jab haalaat par ghaur kiya aur apni bekasi aur Firaun ke qahr-o-jabroot ka tasawwur kiya to insaani fitrat ke mutabiq dare aur uska apne Rab se izhaar karte hue kaha, Aye humare Rab ! Hum darte hain ke kahin ghazab-o-ghusse mein wo humein qatal na karde, ya koi sakht saza na de de, ya uski sarkashi aur badh jaye aur teri shaan-o-azmat ke khilaf koi baat na kar baithe, to Allah Taala ne unhe itminaan dilaya aur kaha ke darne ki aisi koi baat nahi, main tum dono ke sath hoon, aap dono aur uske darmiyan jo guftugu hogi aur jo kuch waqoo pazeer hoga, use main sununga aur dekhunga aur tum dono ki hifazat karta rahunga. Isliye aap dono uske paas jaiye aur usse kahiye ke hum dono tumhare Rab ke paighambar hain, tumhare paas isliye bheje gaye hain ke tum bani Israel ko qaid-o-band se aazad kardo, unhe azaab dena band karo aur humare sath unhe humare watan Philisteen jane do aur ye bhi kahiye ke humare paas tumhare Rab ki janib se humare Rasool hone ki daleel yaani maujze maujood hain. Hakeemana asloob ikhtiyaar karte hue usse kahiye ke jo shakhs Allah Taala ki nishaniyo'n ki tasdeeq nahi karega aur uske deen se rugardani karega, wo uske azaab ka mustahiq hoga. Firaun ne unki poori baat sunne ke baad kaha, Aye Moosa ! Tum dono ka Rab kaun hai? To Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha ke humara Rab wo hai jisne saari makhlooq ko uski makhsoos shakal-o-surat mein paida kiya hai, phir sabhi ko talab-e-rizq ke gurr sikhaye aur unki naslo'n ki baqaa ke liye wasaail-o-asbaab muhaiya farma kar unhe istemal karne ka tareeqa bhi sikhaya hai. وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ Yaani agar tu hidayat ki baat ko maan le to tere liye bhi salaamati hogi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne har qul ko khat likhte waqt bhi yahi andaaz ikhtiyaar kiya, jaisa ke Saiyyadna Abdullah bin Abbas (Razi Allahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne jo khat Shah Rom Har Qul ko likha tha, usme "Bismillah Hirrehmaan Nirraheem" ke baad ye mazmoon likha tha "Ye khat Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool Muhammad (ﷺ) ki taraf se Shah Rom Har Qul ke naam hai. Jo hidayat ki pairawi kare uspar salam ho. Iske baad ye ke main tujhe islaam ki taraf bulata hoon, tum islaam qubool karlo to salamat rahoge aur Allah Taala tujhe dohra ajr inayat farmayega." Bukhari 7, Muslim 1773 إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ Yaani Allah Taala ne wahi ke zariye se hamein ye bataya hai ke azaab sirf uss shakhs ke liye hai jo Allah Taala ki aayaat ko jhutlaye aur uski ataat se rugardani kare, jaisa ke irshad farmaya فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ ٣٧ وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ٣٨ فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ ٣٩ Al-Nazi'at 79 37 to 39 "Pas lekin jo hadd se badh gaya. Aur usne duniya ki zindagi ko tarjeeh di. To beshak jahannum hi (uska) thikana hai." aur farmaya فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ ١٤ لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى ١٥ ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ١٦ Al-Lail 92 14 to 16 "Pas maine tumhe ek aisi aag se daraa diya hai jo shola maarti hai. Jismein uss bade bade bad bakht ke siwa koi dakhil nahin hoga. Jisne jhutlaya aur munh phera." Aur farmaya فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ ٣١ وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ٣٢ Al-Qiyama 75 31, 32 "So naa usne sach mana aur naa namaz ada ki. Aur lekin usne jhutlaya aur munh phera." قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٥١ قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبٖۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى ٥٢ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّن نَّبَاتٖ شَتَّىٰ ٥٣ كُلُواْ وَٱرۡعَوۡاْ أَنۡعَٰمَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ ٥٤ "Usne kaha to pehle zamaane ke logon ka kya haal hai? Kaha unka ilm mere Rab ke paas ek kitaab mein hai, mera Rab na bhatakta hai aur na bhoolta hai. Wo jisne tumhare liye zameen ko bichhauna banaya aur tumhare liye usmein raaste jari kiye aur aasman se kuch paani utara, phir humne uske sath kayi qismein mukhtalif nabaataat se nikali'n. Khao aur apne chaupaayo'n ko charaao, beshak usmein aqlon walon ke liye yaqeenan bahut si nishaniyan hain." Jab Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne Firaun ko bataya ke unka Rab wo hai jisne sari makhlooqat ko paida kiya hai, unhe rozi di hai aur unhe zindagi guzaarne ka tareeqa sikhaya hai to wo laajawab ho gaya, aakhir shikast khurdah hokar kehne laga ke phir un aqwam guzishta ke baare mein tum kya kahoge jo buto'n ki pooja karti thi? Jaise Nooh, Hood, Loot aur Saleh (AS)Alehis Salam ki qaumein, jo ek Allah par imaan nahin laaye aur buto'n ki parastish karti hui duniya se rukhsat ho gayin. To Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha ke unn tamam qaumo'n ke aamaal ka Allah ko poora poora ilm hai. Unka har qaul-o-amal unke naamaye aamaal mein mehfooz hai aur roz-e-qayamat unhe unka badla mil jayega. Mere Rab ke daaire ilm se koi adna cheez bhi kharij nahi hai aur naa uss par nasyaan taari hota hai, mera Rab in dono ayyub aur deegar tamam naqaais se yaksar paak hai. Mera Rab wo hai jisne zameen ko tumhare liye farsh bana diya, taakey tum uspar zindagi guzaar sako aur mera Rab wo hai jisne zameen par tumhare liye raaste humwaar kar diye, taakey tum ek jagah se dusri jagah ja sako aur mera Rab wo hai jo aasman se barish naazil karta hai jisse nehrein banti hain aur kuwein bharte hain. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ka jawab khatam ho jane ke baad Allah Taala ne ahle kitaab ko apni wehdaniyat par imaan lane ki nasihat ke taur par farmaya ke hum hi iss pani ke zariye se inwaa-o-iqsaam ke paudhe, phal aur darakht waghaira paida karte hain, jo rang, maza, buu aur deegar ausaaf-o-khasais mein ek dusre se mukhtalif hote hain. Isliye aqal taqaza karti hai ke tum hum par imaan le aao, inn paudhon aur phalon mein se jo tumhare khane ke liye hain unhe khud khao aur jo tumhare jaanwaro ke liye hain wo unhe khilao. Mazkoorah baala tamam aamal iss baat ki daleel hain ke Allah Rabbul Izzat har baat par qadir hai, uska ilm har shay ko muheet hai aur uski rehmat tamam makhlooqat ko shamil hai, isliye sirf wahi ibaadat ka mustahiq hai, lekin inn dalaael se sirf ahle aqal-o-danish hi mustafeed hote hain. ۞مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ ٥٥ "Usi se humne tumhe paida aur usi mein tumhe lautayenge aur usi se tumhe ek aur baar nikalenge." Yaani tum sab ke baap Adam (AS)Alehis Salam ka putla mitti se banaya gaya aur tamam ghizayein bhi mitti se nikalti hain, marne ke baad khuwah koi insaam qabr mein dafan ho ya na ho, bilwaasta ya bila'waasta uske ajza bhi mitti hi mein mil jayenge. Qayamat ke roz unhi ajza ko dobara jama karke aur unmein rooh phoonk kar zinda kar diya jayega, jaisa ke irshad farmaya قَالَ فِيهَا تَحۡيَوۡنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنۡهَا تُخۡرَجُونَ ٢٥ Al-A'raf 7 25 "Farmaya tum isi mein zinda rahoge aur isi mein maroge aur isi se nikaale jaoge." Baaz riwayaat mein dafnane ke baad teen mutthiyaan mitti daalte waqt iss aayat ka padhna Nabi (ﷺ) se manqool hai, lekin ye riwayat sanad zaeef hain, taaham aayat ke baghair teen mutthiyaan mitti daalne wali riwayat jo Ibn-e-Maaja, kitaab Al-janaaiz(1565) mein hai, wo sahi hai. وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ ٥٦ قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٥٧ فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانٗا سُوٗى ٥٨ قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحۡشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحٗى ٥٩ فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ ٦٠ "Aur bila shuba'h yaqeenan hum ne use apni nishaniyan sab ki sab dikhlayi, pas usne jhutlaya aur inkaar kar diya. Kaha kya tu humare paas isliye aaya hai ke hamein hamari sar zameen se apne jaadu ke zariye nikaal de Aye Moosa! To hum bhi har soorat tere paas iss jaisa jaadu layenge, pas tu humare darmiyan aur apne darmiyan waade ka ek waqt tay karde ke na hum uske khilaf kare aur na tu, aisi jagah mein jo masawi ho. Kaha tumhare waade ka waqt zeenat ka din hai aur ye ke log din chadhe jama kiye jaye. Pas Firaun wapas lauta, pas usne apne daon pech jama kiye, phir aagaya." Yahan aayaat se muraad wo nishaniyan hain jo Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ko di thi, wo nishaniyan ye hain, laathi, yadbaiza, qahat saali, phalon ki kami, toofan, tiddi, juwein, maindak aur khoon. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam lambe arse tak Firaun ko daawat tauheed dete rahe aur iss taweel muddat mein Allah Taala ne mazkoorah baala nishaniyan bhej kar use raah dikhayi, lekin wo kibr-o-ghuroor mein sab ko jhutlata raha aur imaan laane se inkaar karta raha, balke iske bar aqs Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se kaha ke tum Misr walo ko apne jaadu ke zor se iss weham mein mubtala karna chahte ho ke Allah ne tumhe apna Nabi bana kar bheja hai, taakey humari sultanat aur mulk Misr par qabiz ho jao aur humein yahan se nikaal do, to sunlo ke hum tumhare jaadu ka todd isse qawi jaadu se karenge, taakey logon ko maaloom ho jaye ke tum Nabi nahi balke jaadugar ho. Isliye tum khud hi humare darmiyan muqable ka ek waqt muqarrar kardo, jiski hum mein se koi khilaf warzi na kare aur iske liye ek aisi jagah muqarrar kardo jahan khade hokar sabhi log muqabla dekh lein. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha ke humare darmiyan muqable ka waqt eid ka din raha aur log muqabla dekhne ke liye subah ke waqt jama ho jayenge, taakey din ki poori roshni mein use dekh sakein. Iss guftugu ke baad Firaun ne apni majlis barkhast kardi aur Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ko maghloob karne ke liye apni saazish ke taane baane bunne laga aur mulk ke tamam bade bade jaadugaron ko jama karke muqabla jeetne ke liye apne tayein tamam intezam mukammal kar liye. قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٖۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ ٦١ فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ ٦٢ قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخۡرِجَاكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلۡمُثۡلَىٰ ٦٣ فَأَجۡمِعُواْ كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱئۡتُواْ صَفّٗاۚ وَقَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَعۡلَىٰ ٦٤ "Moosa ne unse kaha tumhari barbadi ho! Allah par koi jhoot na baandhna, warna wo tumhe azaab se halaak kar dega aur yaqeenan naa kaam hua jisne jhoot baandha. To wo apne maamle mein aapas mein jhagad pade aur unhone poshidah sargoshi ki. Kaha beshak ye dono yaqeenan jaadugar hain, chahte hain ke tumhe tumhari sar zameen se apne jaadu ke zariye nikaal de aur tumhara wo tareeqa le jaye jo sab se achha hai. So tum apni tadbeer pukhta karo, phir saff bandh kar aajao aur yaqeenan aaj wo kaamyaab hoga jisne ghalba haasil kar liya." Jab jaadugar waqt muqarrar'h par Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ke saamne aaye, to unhone unse azraah hujjat kaha ke tum log Allah ke baare mein iftaraa pardaazi na karo aur apne jaadu ke zariye se mehaz khayali cheez paish karke logon ko dhoka na do, agar tum aisa karoge to ek dardnaak azaab ke zariye se Allah tumhe nest-o-nabood kar dega aur jaan lo ke iftaraa pardaaz hamesha ghaatey mein rehta hai. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki baatein sun kar jaadugaron mein ikhtilaaf ho gaya aur aapas mein sargoshiyan karne lage ke ye koi jaadugar hai ya waqayi Allah ka Rasool hai. Bila aakhir unki yehi raay hui ke ye dono jaadugar hi hain, apne jaadu ke zariye se Firaun aur humein sar zameen Misr se nikaal kar khud saltanat par qaabiz ho jana chahte hain aur humari jagah apni qaum ko yahan basa kar humare achhe bhale deen aur akhlaaq ka khatma chahte hain. Isliye hum log ek baat par muttafiq ho jaye aur saff bana kar aage badhein, taakey dekhne walo par humara roab pade aur phir aapas mein ek dusre se kehne lage ke aaj jo ghalib hoga wo Firaun aur firauniyo ki janib se khoob daad-o-dahash payega. لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٖۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ Saiyyadna Abdullah bin Masood (AS)Alehis Salam bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "(Jhoot se bacho, kyonki) jhoot fasq-o-fajoor ki taraf le jata hai aur fasq-o-fajoor jahannum ki taraf le jate hain aur aadmi jhoot bolta rehta hai, yahan tak ke Allah Taala ke nazdeek jhoota likh diya jata hai." Muslim 2607 قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ ٦٥ قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ ٦٦ فَأَوۡجَسَ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ خِيفَةٗ مُّوسَىٰ ٦٧ قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ ٦٨ وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرٖۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ ٦٩ "Unhone kaha Aye Moosa! Ya to ye ke tu phenke ya ye ke hum pehle ho jo phenke. Kaha balke tum phenko, to achanak unki rassiyan aur unki laathiyan, uske khayal mein daala jata tha, unke jaadu ki wajah se ke waqayi wo daud rahi hain. To Moosa ne apne dil mein ek khauf mehsoos kiya. Humne kaha khauf na kar, yaqeenan tu hi ghalib hai. Aur phenk jo tere dayein hath mein hai, wo nigal jayega jo kuch unhone banaya hai, beshak unhone jo kuch banaya hai wo jaadugar ki chaal hai aur jaadugar kaamyaab nahi hota jahan bhi aaye." Jab jaadugaron ke darmiyan ittefaq ho gaya ke muqabla kaise kiya jaye to unhone Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se poochha ke pehle tum ibteda karoge ya hum shuru kare? Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha ke pehle tum hi daalo aur unhone aisa isliye kaha ke jab jaadugar apna kartab dikha chukenge aur unke khayali saanpo'n ko Moosa ki laathi nigal jayegi, to maujza-e-nabwi zyada waaze shakal mein dars ibrat ban kar logon ke saamne aayega. Jaadugaron ne jab apni rassiyan aur laathiyan zameen par phenki to Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne dekha ke wo jaadu ke asar se daud rahi hain. ES By Effat Saleh Founder of islamtics Sources Quran ( Al-Ahzab 33 56 ), Sahih Muslim 408, Sahih al-Bukhari 6357, Sunan an-Nasa i 1297, Jami at-Tirmidhi 3546 Last updated 16 May 2026 Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ), often shortened to the Arabic ligature ﷺ or the Latin abbreviations SAW , SAWS , or PBUH , is the salawat a short prayer of blessing that Muslims recite every time the name of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is mentioned. It means May Allah send His peace and blessings upon him. This page covers the full Arabic spelling with and without diacritics, a word-by-word breakdown, the Quranic command from Surah al-Ahzab 33 56, the most-cited hadith on the reward for sending salawat, the difference between ﷺ SAW PBUH, when Muslims say it (in salah, on Fridays, after adhan), the correct response when you hear someone say it, and the common spelling variants people search for. Quick answer Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam (صلى الله عليه وسلم ﷺ SAW PBUH) means May Allah s peace and blessings be upon him. Muslims say it whenever Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is mentioned, as commanded in Quran 33 56 Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe send your salah upon him and salute him with a worthy salutation. The Prophet ﷺ said whoever sends one salawat upon him, Allah sends ten back upon them ( Sahih Muslim 408). The abbreviations SAW, SAWS, and PBUH all carry the same meaning. Table of Contents Pronunciation The phrase is read in five syllables Sal-la-LLA-hu a-LAY-hi wa-SAL-lam . The double ll in Sallallahu is doubled (shadda) the h in alaihi is a clear, breathy h the final wasallam ends with a soft m . The video below walks through each word at a slow pace before repeating the phrase at conversational speed Key takeaways Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam (ﷺ SAW PBUH) is the salawat a short prayer of blessing recited every time the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is named. Allah commands Muslims to send salawat in Surah al-Ahzab 33 56 the only act of worship Allah Himself joins with the angels. Sahih Muslim 408 Whoever sends one salawat upon me, Allah will send ten upon him the ﷺ ligature counts as a full salawat in writing. Forms Arabic ligature ﷺ, full صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ, abbreviations SAW SAWS PBUH all valid writing in full is encouraged in scholarly work. Refusing to send salawat when his name is mentioned is described as miserly in Jami at-Tirmidhi 3546. Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam in Arabic The phrase is four words. Written with diacritical marks (tashkīl), which is how it appears in the Mushaf and most printed Islamic books صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ And without diacritics, which is how it usually appears in modern Arabic news, websites, and chat صلى الله عليه وسلم Most Arabic publishers also use the single-character ligature ﷺ one Unicode glyph that contains the full phrase in compressed calligraphic form. It is read aloud in full as Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam , never as a separate word. Word-by-Word Meaning Breaking the phrase into its four parts makes the meaning precise Related Walaikum Assalam Meaning in Arabic, Assalamualaikum Warahmatullahi The Shahada Meaning in English, Transliteration Arabic Meaning Salla صَلَّى May He bless send prayer upon Allahu اللّٰهُ Allah (subject of the verb) Alayhi عَلَيْهِ upon him Wa sallam وَسَلَّمَ and grant peace The verb salla shares its root with salah (prayer). When Allah is the subject, classical scholars explain that salla alayhi does not mean Allah prays for him it means Allah praises him among the angels and elevates his rank. When the same verb has angels or believers as the subject, it means asking Allah to send those blessings upon him. Common Spellings and Abbreviations Salla Allahu Alaihi Wasallam Salallahu Alayhi Wasalam Sal lal lahu alaihi wasallam S.A.W Latin initials SAW SAWS SAAW PBUH Peace Be Upon Him (English translation) ﷺ Arabic ligature (Unicode U FDFA) The Quranic Command ( Surah al-Ahzab 33 56) Sending salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ is not a cultural courtesy it is a direct command from Allah in Surah al-Ahzab . The verse opens by stating that Allah Himself does this act, and that the angels do it too only after that does the command reach the believers Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels ask Him to do so . O you who have believed, ask Allah to confer blessing upon him and ask Allah to grant him peace. Surah al-Ahzab 33 56 The Arabic word for blessing in this verse is salat , and the word for peace is salam the same two words that form the phrase salla alayhi wa-sallam . The full salawat we say today is the verbal action that fulfils the command. When this verse was revealed, the companions asked the Prophet ﷺ how they should send salawat upon him. He replied with what is now known as Salawat al-Ibrahimiyyah , taught in Sahih al-Bukhari 6357 the long form recited at the end of every salah after Tashahhud. So Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam is the short form of that long salawat, used outside of formal prayer. The Reward in the Hadith The Prophet ﷺ described the reward for sending one salawat upon him in several authentic narrations. The most-cited is from Sahih Muslim Whoever sends one salawat upon me, Allah will send ten salawat upon him. Sahih Muslim 408 An expanded version recorded in Sunan an-Nasa i 1297 adds two more rewards Allah will send ten salawat upon him, raise him by ten ranks, and erase ten of his sins. Four blessings flow from a single recitation divine prayer, rank, forgiveness, and the original mercy itself. The Prophet ﷺ also warned about neglect. Jami at-Tirmidhi records The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned and he does not send salawat upon me. Jami at-Tirmidhi 3546 For Friday, Sunan Abi Dawud 1047 narrates The most virtuous of your days is Friday. On it, send abundant salawat upon me, for your salawat will be presented to me. This is why many Muslims increase salawat on Fridays specifically. And the salam is returned in real time. Abu Hurayrah (raḍiyallahu anhu) reported Whenever someone greets me, Allah returns the soul to my body so that I return his greeting. Sunan Abi Dawud 2041 SAW vs PBUH vs ﷺ Which Should You Use? All three forms refer to the same salawat, but they differ in completeness and adab (etiquette) The full phrase (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam, written or spoken) carries the full reward of the salawat. This is what scholars and classical books always preferred. The Arabic ligature ﷺ is functionally identical to the full phrase it is the four words compressed into a single Unicode glyph. When read aloud, it is pronounced in full. SAW SAWS SAAW are Latin abbreviations of the same phrase. They are tolerated for speed in writing, but Imam Nawawi and Ibn Salah (rahimahumullah) discouraged the abbreviated form, holding that the salawat should be written in full out of respect. PBUH ( Peace Be Upon Him ) is an English translation, not a transliteration. It conveys the meaning but loses the Arabic structure. Practical rule in books, articles, and formal writing, prefer the full Arabic or transliteration. In chat, social media, and informal notes, the abbreviations are acceptable but if you have time, write it in full. The reward is in the recitation, not the abbreviation. The ﷺ Symbol Unicode and Typography The single-glyph form ﷺ is encoded at Unicode U FDFA in the Arabic Presentation Forms-A block. It is one of a small set of religious ligatures registered with the Unicode Consortium specifically because the phrase is so common in Arabic typography. The HTML entity is 65018 and you can copy the symbol from this page directly ﷺ . On Windows, the keyboard shortcut Alt 65018 on the numpad inserts it. On macOS and iOS, the easiest way is the Arabic keyboard s character picker, or simply copy-paste from any Islamic text. Most modern Arabic fonts (Amiri, Lateef, Scheherazade, Noto Naskh) render ﷺ correctly. Some Latin fonts do not contain the glyph and will display a fallback box. When Muslims Say Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam The Prophet ﷺ taught his ummah to send salawat in many situations. The most common are Whenever his name is mentioned in lectures, conversations, books, social media, or your own recitation. This is the immediate response taught by the hadith of the miser. In every salah the long Salawat al-Ibrahimiyyah is recited after the second Tashahhud, before the final salam. This is the Darood Sharif most Muslims memorize. On Friday and Friday night based on Sunan Abi Dawud 1047, many Muslims set a daily target (100, 300, or 1,000 salawat) on Fridays. When entering and leaving the masjid salawat is part of the recommended du a sequence. After the adhan the Prophet ﷺ said whoever sends salawat upon him after the adhan and asks Allah for al-Wasilah for him will be granted his intercession on the Day of Judgment ( Sahih Muslim 384). As daily dhikr many Muslims include 100 salawat as part of morning or Tahajjud prayer dhikr. What to Say When You Hear It If someone says Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam after mentioning the Prophet ﷺ, the appropriate response is to say it yourself either repeating the same phrase or replying with عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاةُ وَالسَّلام Alayhi al-salah wa al-salam Upon him be prayer and peace. The reply is itself a salawat saying it earns the same tenfold reward described in Sahih Muslim 408. There is no requirement to vary your phrasing reciting the same Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam back is fully valid. Common Spelling Variants Because the phrase is transliterated from Arabic, English spellings vary widely. All of the following point to the same salawat the differences are typographic, not theological Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam standard academic transliteration Salla Allahu Alayhi wa Sallam word-spaced, Library of Congress style Sallallahu Alayhi Wasallam alayhi instead of alaihi Sallallaahu Alaihi Wasallam doubled aa to mark the long vowel Sav , sa.w , s.a.w. common Indonesian and Turkish abbreviations SAWS sometimes written as Sallallahu Alayhi Wa Sallam SAA Sallallahu Alayhi Aalihi (used by some Shia communities adding and his family ) सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम (Hindi Devanagari), সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম (Bangla), صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم (Urdu) The recitation is what matters. If you are not sure how to spell it, say it or write the phrase in full Arabic or as ﷺ. Frequently Asked Questions What does Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam mean? Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ) means May Allah send His blessings and peace upon him. It is the salawat (prayer) Muslims say after mentioning the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ s name. The saying is a direct command from Allah in the Quran (33 56) and a continuous expression of love and respect for the Messenger. When do Muslims say Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam? Muslims say it every time they mention or hear the name of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in speech, writing, lectures, and du a. It is also said during salah after Tashahhud, when reciting Darood Ibrahimi, and as part of daily dhikr. Many Muslims also say it on Fridays in greater frequency, based on Sunan Abi Dawud 1047 that du a sent on the Prophet ﷺ on Friday is conveyed to him. What is the symbol ﷺ? The ﷺ symbol (Unicode U FDFA, HTML entity 65018 ) is a single Arabic ligature that contains the full phrase صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ in compressed calligraphic form. It is a typographic shorthand used in modern Arabic and Islamic publishing. Pronunciation is the same as the full phrase the symbol is read aloud in full as Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam. What is the difference between SAW, PBUH, and ﷺ? All three refer to the same salawat. SAW is the Latin abbreviation for Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam. PBUH stands for Peace Be Upon Him the English translation. ﷺ is the Arabic ligature symbol. Scholars including Imam Nawawi preferred writing or saying the phrase in full because it carries the full reward of the salawat abbreviations are tolerated but considered less complete than the full phrase. Why do Muslims say Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam after the Prophet s name? Saying Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam is a direct command from Allah in Surah al-Ahzab 33 56 and a daily Sunnah of love and respect. The Prophet ﷺ said Whoever sends one salawat upon me, Allah will send ten upon him, raise him by ten ranks, and forgive ten of his sins. ( Sunan an-Nasa i 1297). The hadith of the miser ( Jami at-Tirmidhi 3546) warns against neglecting salawat when his name is heard. Is there a Quranic command to say Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam? Yes. Surah al-Ahzab , ayah 56 says Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels ask Him to do so . O you who have believed, ask Allah to confer blessing upon him and ask Allah to grant him peace. This is the foundational command, and the exact wording of the long salawat (Salawat al-Ibrahimiyyah) was taught by the Prophet ﷺ himself in Sahih al-Bukhari 6357 when companions asked him how to send blessings.
