Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). Click to Scan Face Upload Photo Supports JPG PNG (Max 5MB) Forgot Password? Create New Account What is SSO ID? (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

Posted in Blog Global News Science Startups Tech Technology Posted by Sobdar Ali September 21, 2025 No Comments Brazil Paves a Greener Future with Sugarcane Waste Roads Tasawwur karein ek aisi sarak ka jo na sirf garion ka bojh uthaye balke mahol (environment) ka bojh bhi halka kare. Yeh koi science fiction film ka scene nahi, balke Brazil mein ek haqeeqat ban chuka hai. Brazil, jo dunya mein gannay (sugarcane) ka sab se bara producer hai, ab is fasal ke bachay hue fuzlay (waste) se sarkein bana kar green infrastructure mein ek inqilab barpa kar raha hai. Yeh anokhi technology na sirf sarkon ko mazboot bana rahi hai balke mustaqbil ki tameerat (construction) ke liye ek naya raasta dikha rahi hai. Brazil Paves a Greener Future with Sugarcane Waste Roads From Waste to Wonder Material (Fuzlay Se Anokha Material) Har saal, gannay se ras nikalne ke baad, laakhon tan fibrous waste bach jaata hai, jise bagasse ya phog kehte hain. Pehle is fuzlay ko thikanay lagana ek bara masla tha. Lekin ab, Brazilian innovators ne is bekaar cheez ko ek besh qeemat material mein tabdeel kar diya hai. Yeh tareeqa sugarcane waste for roads ki technology ka bunyadi nuqta hai. Is fuzlay ko ab sarak banane walay material, yaani asphalt aur concrete, mein milaya ja raha hai, jis se na sirf ek maslay ka hal nikla hai balke iske fawaid ne sab ko hairan kar diya hai. How Does It Work? (Yeh Kaam Kaise Karta Hai?) Aap soch rahe honge ke gannay ka phog sarak ko mazboot kaise bana sakta hai? Iska jawab iske fibrous structure mein chupa hai. Jab is bagasse ko asphalt aur concrete ke sath milaya jaata hai, to iske reshay (fibers) ek jaal (network) bana letay hain, bilkul usi tarah jaise concrete ko mazboot karne ke liye steel ki salakhein (bars) istemal hoti hain. Is anokhi technology ke chand ahem fawaid yeh hain Crack Reduction Yeh reshay sarak mein cracks ko phailne se roktay hain. Flexibility Yeh sarak ko thori lachak (flexibility) faraham karte hain, jis se woh garion ke dabao ko behtar tareeqay se bardasht karti hai. Weather Resistance Yeh sarak ko shadeed garmi aur sardi ke asraat se bachane mein madad deta hai, jis se uski umar barh jaati hai. Yeh sab mil kar ek aisi sarak banate hain jo aam sarkon ke muqablay mein zyada payedar (durable) aur long-lasting hoti hai. Benefits for All (Sab Ke Liye Fawaid) Brazil ka yeh qadam sirf engineering ka kamal nahi, balke iske maashi (economic), maholiyati (environmental), aur tameerati (constructional) fawaid bhi hain. Is innovation se sustainable road construction materials ki ek nayi misaal qayam hui hai. Maholiyati Fawaid Fuzlay ka dobara istemal kachray ko kam karta hai aur qudrati wasail (natural resources) par dabao ghatata hai. Maashi Fawaid Ek fuzlay ko qeemti product mein tabdeel karne se maeeshat ko faida hota hai aur mustaqbil mein sarak banane ki laagat (cost) kam ho sakti hai. Tameerati Fawaid Zyada mazboot aur payedar sarkein maintenance ke kharchay ko kam karti hain aur saalon saal chalti hain. Brazil Leading the Way (Brazil Dunya Ki Rehmumai Karta Hua) Is innovation ke sath, Brazil ne khud ko green infrastructure mein ek leader ke taur par manwa liya hai. Dunya bhar ke mulk ab is technology par gehri nazar rakhe hue hain. Yeh is baat ka saboot hai ke zarai fuzlay (agricultural waste) mein mustaqbil ki tameerat ke liye kitna potential chupa hua hai. Lekin, is technology ko aam karne aur iske long-term asraat ko mukammal taur par samajhne ke liye abhi mazeed research aur data ki zaroorat hai. Lekin ek baat tay hai sugarcane waste for roads ka istemal ek inqilabi qadam hai jo hamare shehron ke mustaqbil ko badal sakta hai. Download Your e-Aadhaar Instantly Get your digitally signed, password-protected Aadhaar PDF on your phone or computer in just 2 minutes. Secure and valid everywhere. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . (Note If you visit an offline Aadhaar Center, you will have to pay 50.) Which Documents do you need to upload? You need to upload one document for Identity and one for Address. Common valid documents include 1. Proof of Identity (PoI) To verify your Name and Photo. PAN Card e-PAN Driving License Passport Voter ID Ration Card (with Photo) Mark Sheet School Certificate 2. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Complaint Kaise Kare Company Complaint Number Online Indane 1800 2333 555 iocl.com HP Gas 1800 2333 555 myhpgas.in Bharat Gas 1800 224 344 mybharatgas.in Complaint Steps Pehle distributor ko call karo - delivery status poocho Agar 3 din se zyada ho gaye toh toll-free number pe complaint karo Complaint number note karo Agar response nahi milta toh pgportal.gov.in pe online grievance file karo 25 Din Ka Waiting Rule (March 2026 - Naya Rule) March 2026 se ek naya rule lagu hua hai Do consecutive bookings ke beech minimum 25 din ka gap hona chahiye Ye rule panic buying aur hoarding rokne ke liye hai Matlab mahine mein sirf 1 cylinder book kar sakte ho Commercial cylinders pe ye rule applicable nahi hai Agar emergency hai toh distributor se baat karo - special cases mein exception ho sakta hai. Safety Tips - LPG Cylinder Ke Saath Tip Details Delivery pe check Seal intact hai ya nahi, weight check karo (14.2 kg hona chahiye) Expiry date Cylinder pe embossed date dekho - expired cylinder reject karo Leak test Sabun ka paani lagao regulator pe - bubble aaye toh leak hai Emergency Gas leak ho toh khidki-darwaza kholo, bijli ka switch mat chhoona, bahar jaao Fire LPG fire mein paani mat daalte - wet cloth se cover karo Emergency Number 112 (All India Emergency) Scam Warning LPG booking ke naam pe bhi fraud hota hai! "Subsidy Rs 500 wapas milega, ye link pe click karo" - FRAUD. Subsidy automatically bank mein aati hai Fake booking numbers WhatsApp pe circulate hote hain - sirf upar wale official numbers use karo "e-KYC online Rs 200 mein" - FRAUD. e-KYC distributor ke paas FREE hai "New connection Rs 1,000 mein" - FRAUD. Ujjwala mein FREE hai eligible logo ke liye Fake delivery boy - delivery pe ID card zaroor check karo Sirf official apps aur numbers se booking karo. Scam Database dekho. FAQs Q Kaunsa tarika sabse fast hai cylinder book karne ka? A WhatsApp ya Missed Call sabse fast hai - 2 minute mein booking confirm. App bhi achha hai agar tracking chahiye. Q Registered mobile number change karna hai, kaise? A Nearest distributor ke paas jaao Aadhaar card ke saath. Woh number update kar denge. Online nahi hota ye. Q Cylinder price kab change hoti hai? A Har mahine ki 1 tareekh ko oil companies price revise karti hain. Increase ya decrease dono ho sakta hai. Q Subsidy kaise milti hai? A Agar eligible ho toh subsidy directly bank account mein aati hai (DBT - Direct Benefit Transfer). Aadhaar bank se link hona chahiye. Q Double cylinder connection le sakte hain? A Haan! Ek hi company se ya alag companies se 2 cylinders le sakte ho. Distributor se baat karo. Q Cylinder delivery mein kitna time lagta hai? A Normal mein 1-3 din . Festival season ya shortage mein 5-7 din bhi lag sakte hain. Booking ke baad tracking check karo. Q Commercial cylinder ghar pe use kar sakte hain? A Nahi! Commercial cylinder domestic use ke liye illegal hai. Pakde gaye toh fine lagega. Domestic cylinder hi use karo. Makanan dan Minuman agar Kuat Lari, 7 Pilihan untuk Jaga Stamina saat Running Banyak pelari fokus menambah jarak tempuh atau memperbaiki pace, tetapi lupa bahwa performa juga dipengaruhi oleh apa yang masuk ke dalam tubuh. Makanan dan minuman agar kuat lari berperan penting dalam menjaga energi, mempertahankan daya tahan, sekaligus membantu tubuh pulih lebih cepat setelah latihan maupun race. Kalau asupan nutrisi kurang tepat, tubuh akan lebih cepat kehabisan tenaga, konsentrasi menurun, hingga risiko kram dan dehidrasi meningkat. Latihan dan pola makan sebaiknya berjalan beriringan agar hasilnya benar-benar terasa. Berikut beberapa makanan dan minuman yang bantu meningkatkan performa saat berlari! Makanan dan Minuman Agar Kuat Lari Saat berlari, tubuh menggunakan glikogen sebagai sumber energi utama. Cadangan glikogen ini berasal dari karbohidrat yang kamu konsumsi sebelumnya. Jika cadangannya menipis, tubuh akan terasa lebih berat, pace mulai turun, dan rasa lelah datang lebih cepat. Selain energi, tubuh juga kehilangan cairan dan elektrolit melalui keringat. Itulah sebabnya banyak pelari yang mengalami kram, pusing, atau performanya menurun saat kurang minum. Memilih makanan sebelum lari, minuman selama berlari, hingga asupan setelah selesai olahraga sama pentingnya dengan latihan itu sendiri. Berikut beberapa pilihan makanan dan minuman yang bisa membantu menjaga stamina saat berlari. 1. Pisang, Sumber Energi yang Praktis Kalau berbicara tentang makanan dan minuman agar kuat lari, pisang hampir selalu masuk dalam daftar utama. Alasannya sederhana, buah ini mengandung karbohidrat yang mudah dicerna sehingga bisa menjadi sumber energi dalam waktu relatif singkat. Pisang juga kaya kalium, salah satu elektrolit yang banyak hilang melalui keringat. Asupan kalium yang cukup membantu menjaga fungsi otot tetap optimal sekaligus mengurangi risiko kram ketika berlari. Tidak heran jika pisang sering tersedia di water station atau area finish berbagai event lari. Kamu bisa mengonsumsinya sekitar 30-60 menit sebelum berlari atau menjadikannya camilan setelah latihan. 2. Roti Gandum dan Oatmeal untuk Energi Lebih Stabil Jika masih punya waktu sekitar dua hingga tiga jam sebelum latihan, roti gandum atau oatmeal bisa menjadi pilihan yang lebih mengenyangkan. Karbohidrat kompleks pada kedua makanan ini dicerna lebih lambat dibanding karbohidrat sederhana. Hasilnya, pelepasan energi berlangsung lebih stabil sehingga tubuh tidak mudah kehabisan tenaga saat berlari. Supaya lebih lengkap, kamu bisa menambahkan madu, selai kacang, atau irisan pisang. 3. Telur untuk Membantu Pemulihan Otot Protein memang bukan sumber energi utama ketika berlari, tetapi tetap dibutuhkan untuk memperbaiki jaringan otot yang bekerja keras selama latihan. Telur menjadi pilihan praktis karena mengandung protein berkualitas tinggi serta vitamin B yang membantu proses pembentukan energi dari makanan. Setelah sesi lari yang cukup berat, mengombinasikan telur dengan sumber karbohidrat seperti roti gandum atau kentang dapat membantu proses pemulihan berlangsung lebih optimal. Kalau kamu rutin menjalani program latihan menuju half marathon atau marathon, asupan protein seperti ini sebaiknya tidak dilewatkan. 4. Semangka dan Buah Segar untuk Mengembalikan Cairan Tubuh Setelah berlari, tubuh membutuhkan lebih dari sekadar minum air. Buah dengan kandungan air tinggi seperti semangka dapat membantu mengganti cairan yang hilang sekaligus memberikan gula alami sebagai tambahan energi. Semangka juga mengandung kalium dan senyawa alami seperti L-sitrulin yang sering dikaitkan dengan pemulihan otot setelah aktivitas fisik. Selain semangka, buah beri, jeruk, maupun anggur juga kaya antioksidan yang membantu mengurangi stres oksidatif akibat latihan intens. Sebagai variasi, kamu bisa memadukan buah dengan yoghurt rendah lemak agar mendapatkan tambahan protein dan probiotik. Baca Juga Tips Fueling Saat Lari Marathon agar Finish Lebih Cepat dan Stabil! 5. Energy Gel Saat Lari Jarak Jauh Saat berlari santai 5 kilometer, energy gel biasanya belum terlalu diperlukan. Namun, jika kamu mengikuti long run, half marathon, atau marathon, energy gel bisa menjadi solusi praktis untuk mempertahankan energi. Produk ini umumnya mengandung karbohidrat sederhana yang cepat diserap tubuh sehingga membantu menjaga kadar glukosa darah tetap stabil selama aktivitas berlangsung. Beberapa produk juga sudah ada yang dilengkapi elektrolit, bahkan tambahan kafein untuk meningkatkan fokus. Meski begitu, setiap pelari memiliki respons yang berbeda. Sebaiknya, kamu mencoba energy gel saat sesi latihan terlebih dahulu dan bukan pertama kali ketika mengikuti race. 6. Air Putih Tetap Menjadi Minuman Terpenting Banyak pelari mencari suplemen atau minuman khusus, padahal air putih masih menjadi kebutuhan paling mendasar. Dehidrasi ringan saja sudah cukup membuat detak jantung meningkat, tubuh terasa lebih berat, dan performa menurun. Sebaiknya, jangan menunggu hingga haus baru minum. Sebaiknya, biasakan memenuhi kebutuhan cairan sejak beberapa jam sebelum lari, lalu minum sedikit demi sedikit selama aktivitas jika memungkinkan. Setelah selesai berlari, kamu dapat melanjutkan hidrasi hingga warna urine kembali jernih sebagai salah satu tanda tubuh mendapatkan cairan yang cukup. 7. Minuman Isotonik untuk Mengganti Elektrolit Selain air putih, minuman agar kuat lari yang sering dipilih pelari adalah minuman isotonik. Minuman ini membantu menggantikan natrium, kalium, dan elektrolit lain yang hilang melalui keringat. Minuman isotonik umumnya lebih bermanfaat pada sesi lari berdurasi lebih dari satu jam atau ketika cuaca sangat panas. Selain mengandung elektrolit, sebagian minuman isotonik juga memiliki karbohidrat sederhana yang dapat menjadi sumber energi tambahan selama berlari. Meski begitu, jika kamu hanya melakukan latihan ringan atau lari dengan durasi singkat, air putih biasanya sudah cukup untuk memenuhi kebutuhan cairan tubuh. Makanan yang Wajib Dihindari Sebelum Lari Pagi Selain memilih makanan dan minuman agar kuat lari, kamu juga perlu tahu makanan apa yang sebaiknya tidak dikonsumsi sebelum berlari. Hindari makanan tinggi lemak, gorengan, makanan pedas, serta makanan tinggi serat dalam jumlah besar karena membutuhkan waktu lebih lama untuk dicerna. Kondisi ini bisa membuat perut terasa penuh, kembung, atau bahkan memicu sakit perut saat berlari. Minuman beralkohol dan makanan dengan gula berlebihan juga kurang disarankan sebelum lari pagi. Gula memang dapat memberikan energi dengan cepat, tetapi lonjakan gula darah yang diikuti penurunan drastis bisa membuat tubuh lebih cepat lelah. Pilih makanan yang mudah dicerna dan sesuai dengan kebutuhan latihan agar tubuh tetap nyaman selama berlari. Kapan Waktu Terbaik Carbo Loading Sebelum Lomba? Banyak pelari bertanya, kapan waktu terbaik carbo loading sebelum lomba? Carbo loading umumnya dilakukan sekitar 1-3 hari sebelum race, terutama untuk lomba berdurasi panjang seperti half marathon atau marathon. Tujuannya adalah meningkatkan cadangan glikogen di otot sehingga tubuh memiliki lebih banyak energi saat bertanding. Namun, carbo loading bukan berarti makan sebanyak mungkin. Fokuslah pada peningkatan porsi karbohidrat secara bertahap sambil tetap menjaga asupan protein, cairan, dan elektrolit. Untuk lomba dengan jarak lebih pendek, seperti 5K atau sebagian 10K, strategi ini biasanya tidak terlalu diperlukan karena cadangan energi tubuh umumnya sudah mencukupi jika pola makan sehari-hari seimbang. Baca Juga 7 Tips Memilih Event Lari yang Sesuai, Jangan Asal Daftar! Memilih makanan dan minuman agar kuat lari bukan berarti harus mengonsumsi makanan mahal atau suplemen tertentu. Pisang, roti gandum, telur, buah segar, air putih, hingga minuman isotonik sudah bisa membantu memenuhi kebutuhan energi dan hidrasi jika dikonsumsi pada waktu yang tepat. Saat kebutuhan nutrisi terpenuhi, tubuh akan lebih siap menghadapi setiap kilometer dengan stamina yang tetap terjaga! Akarsari.com - Allahumma ya ghoniyyu ya mughni aghnini merupakan penggalan doa dimudahkan rezeki oleh Sang Maha Pemberi Kekayaan. Pada bacaan doa dimudahkan rezeki, lafadz Allahumma ya ghoniyyu ya mughni aghnini ginan abadan artinya Ya Allah, Dzat Yang Mahakaya dan memberikan kekayaan, berilah kekayaan yang abadi kepadaku. Berikut ini bacaan doa dimudahkan rezeki, dengan lafadz Allahumma ya ghoniyyu ya mughni aghnini arab latin dan artinya. Baca Juga Allahummaghfirlaha Warhamha Wa'afiha Wa'fuanha, Doa untuk Orang Meninggal dan Artinya Doa Dimudahkan Rezeki اَللَّهُمَّ يَاغَنِيُّ يَامُغْنِيْ أَغْنِنِيْ غِنًى أَبَدًا وَيَاعَزِيْزُ يَامُعِزُّ أَعِزَّنِيْ بِإِعْزَازٍ عِزَّةَ قُدْرَتِكَ وَيَامُيَسِّرَاْلأُمُوْرِ يَسِّرْ لِيْ أُمُوْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالدِّيْنِ يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ يُرْجَى يَا اللهُ Latin Allahumma ya ghoniyyu ya mughni aghnini ginan abadan wa ya aziizu ya mu izzu a izzani bi-i zazin izzatia qudrotika, wa ya muyassirol umuri yassir lii umurod dun-ya waddini ya khoiro man yurja ya allah. Artinya Ya Allah, Dzat Yang Mahakaya dan memberikan kekayaan, berilah kekayaan yang abadi kepadaku. Wahai Dzat Yang Mahamulia dan yang memberikan kemuliaan, berilah kemuliaan kepadaku dengan kemuliaan kekuasaan-Mu. Wahai Dzat yang mempermudah semua urusan, berilah kemudahan kepadaku di dalam semua urusan dunia dan agama, wahai Dzat yang paling diharapkan, ya Allah. Baca Juga Doa Selamat Dunia Akhirat Allahumma Inna Nas Aluka Salamatan Fiddin Arab dan Artinya Lengkap Untuk Panduanmu Ya Ghoniyyu (Al-Ghaniyyu) dan Ya Mughni (Al-Mughni) merupakan salah satu dari 99 Asmaul Husnah atau nama-nama terbaik dan indah milik Allah SWT. Al Ghaniyyu artinya "Yang Maha Kaya", dan Al Mughni artinya "Yang Maha Pemberi Kekayaan". Sebagai umat muslim, berdoa dengan menyebut Asmaul Husna merupakan hal yang sangat dianjurkan. Allah SWT berfirman وَلِلّٰهِ الْاَسْمَاۤءُ الْحُسْنٰى فَادْعُوْهُ بِهَاۖ وَذَرُوا الَّذِيْنَ يُلْحِدُوْنَ فِيْٓ اَسْمَاۤىِٕهٖۗ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۖ ١٨٠

A Har mahine ki 1 tareekh ko oil companies price revise karti hain. Increase ya decrease dono ho sakta hai. Q Subsidy kaise milti hai? A Agar eligible ho toh subsidy directly bank account mein aati hai (DBT - Direct Benefit Transfer). Aadhaar bank se link hona chahiye. Q Double cylinder connection le sakte hain? A Haan! Festival season ya shortage mein 5-7 din bhi lag sakte hain. Booking ke baad tracking check karo. Q Commercial cylinder ghar pe use kar sakte hain? A Nahi! Commercial cylinder domestic use ke liye illegal hai. Pakde gaye toh fine lagega. Domestic cylinder hi use karo. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). We were divided by a wall. But, Sardar Patel's dream is now fulfilled, the wall has been demolished by us ". It is with these words that Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi paid tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel on his 144th birth anniversary. PM Modi dedicated his decision to abolish Article 370 at the feet of the country's first home minister atÂ Statue of Unity Â in Gujarat. Sardar (chief) was how he was addressed and with good reason. The tremendous contributions made by Sardar Patel to India's freedom struggle and the resolute leadership displayed by him while our great nation was still in its early years of independence are indeed praiseworthy and memorable. Sardar Patel Iron Man of India Born to a farmer in Gujarat (in the year 1875), Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel displayed a resolute determination from an early age. Undaunted by his humble beginnings and the disheartening condition of the country under British colonial rule, Patel went on to study in England and became a barrister. Coming back home, Sardar Patel rose to eminence as one of the best barristers of Ahmedabad city. The idea of servitude, however, was not a pleasant one, and his ideological clashes with the British continued to grow. He soon threw himself heart and soul into the national freedom movement. He rose to become one of the most influential leaders of the Indian National Congress and came to be regarded as a very close associate of Mahatma Gandhi. Though he remained very active in organizing mass civil disobedience protests in his home state, Gujarat, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel did not lose sight of the nation as a whole. Integration of Princely States By the time Indian independence from the British Raj became imminent, there were over 550 princely states. These states were varied in size and might. The royal families were, in most cases, reluctant to join the Indian union. Integration of these princely states became a matter of prime importance, and this responsibility was handed to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Along with V. P. Menon, another exceptional administrator, Patel was responsible for bringing together these states and building up the Indian Republic. His strong, determined approach, his frank communication, and his excellent negotiation skills managed to give shape to the country. Sardar Patel was not a man to mince words. He extended every possible concession for the royal families but did not hold back on the possibility of military action in case the states did not join India. Not only did he manage to secure the accession of these states but also oversaw the transformation of administration in a phased way. This earned him the monikerÂ "Unifier of India". Patel worked extensively with the civil servants and bureaucrats to establish unified nationwide systems across the country. He is also fondly referred to as theÂ "patron saint" Â of our civil services for this reason, but it is the common man who enjoys the benefits of these services that Patel managed to establish in India. Sardar Patel First Home Minister As the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of the country, Sardar Patel steered the nation through turbulent times. For a leader who passionately led India through (the latter part of) its freedom struggle, the violent partition and consequent bloodbath would have been heart wrenching and disappointing. Patel did not let the grief overshadow his sense of responsibility. He set up large scale relief camps and refugee shelters across northern India and set about restoring peace and stability in the country. The newly inaugurated Sardar Sarovar dam is but a translation of this great man's vision, his commitment to regional prosperity and national upliftment. In the years following India's independence, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel played a vital role in shaping national policies. His success was at times limited due to the imposition of contrary ideas by Mahatma Gandhi, Nehru, and others still, the wisdom of his ideals and his policies remain at the very foundation of India's growth. A Legacy of Unity Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel leaves behind a rich legacy of unity and integrity. The Government of India has recognized his toils and efforts which managed to stitch together the numerous small and often conflicting princely states into the colourful tapestry that makes up Indian society. Since the year 2014 his birth anniversary, 31 October, is commemorated as National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas). This year, the University Grants Commission (UGC) has asked all the universities and higher education institutions in the country to celebrate his birth anniversary in the hope that the youth of the country shall imbibe the same sense of national pride and unity as demonstrated by Sardar Patel. Sardar Patel s 21-day Blitz How India thwarted Raja-sthan threat Josy Joseph's Birth of a Nation is a riveting account of the negotiations and machinations of the princely states in the weeks leading up to India's Independence. For Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, the alternative to accepting Partition was something worse than Pakistan Raja-sthan . That is, the potential fragmentation of India as a result of princely states refusing to accede to the Union. Jawaharlal Nehru feared balkanisation or an indefinite number of partitions . Choudhry Rahmat Ali once imagined, as Sunil Purushottam writes inFrom Raj to Republic Sovereignty, Violence and Democracy in India, a Pakistan consisting of a fragmented yet subcontinental landscape of Muslim sovereignty , including an Osmanistan roughly corresponding toHyderabadState yet with no notion of the ruling Asaf Jahi dynasty retaining their sovereignty. These imaginations of the future, national and non-national , left little room forthe princely states. Yet, some of the latter, with support from elements of the British establishment, were busy trying to carve out a niche for themselves in the run-up to Independence. Josy Joseph sBirth of a Nation The Twenty-one Days that Made India, is an account of some of the negotiations and machinations the leaders of these states engaged in over the three weeks leading up to August 15, 1947, and how India s interim government, and particularly the newly formed States Department under Patel, worked to thwart their ambitions. On the one side, the cast of characters includes the leaders of several states, such as the Nizam of Hyderabad, the Nawab ofBhopal, the Jam Saheb of Nawanagar, and the Dewan of Travancore, Sir C P Ramaswami Iyer. On the other side, there are the giants Gandhi, Nehru, Patel, Mountbatten and the unsung heroes working in their shadow. One might quibble about how unsung a figure like V P Menon really is. Even others such as Aravamudu Aiyangar, the Nizam s minister who secretly passed on information to the leadership in Delhi, are not unknown to history. Some of the stories, including K C S Mani s assassination attempt on Sir C P and how it stopped his bid to secure independence for Travancore, are quite well known. On the other hand, tidbits such as the efforts by some of the erstwhile rajas of Malabar who had not held political power since Tipu Sultan s invasion to secure greater recognition amid the manoeuvres by the states are interesting. The book s stories are plucked from the dust of the Archives files and several private papers and academic collections . An engaging read, it might have benefitted from incorporating more of the scholarship on that period, including recent works such as Purushottam s book cited above and Rama Sundari Mantena sProvincial Democracy Political Imaginaries at the End of Empire in Twentieth-Century South India. The narrative is also teleological in nature, which shifts the focus on the tactics Nehru s idealistic, hardline republican approach to the princely states, contrasted with Patel and Menon s seemingly accommodating pragmatism, or missteps in the Northeast. At the same time, the antagonists are painted with a broad brush. Only Sir C P s proverbial intelligence survives. As stated in the introduction, the book has a lesson in mind That a Republic is hard-won, and that its preservation lies in knowing its roots . That is a grand project, and a vital one today. The book provides a narrative of some important political manoeuvring, but the issues surrounding the birth of the Republic including contradictions and violence were complex and entailed more than the heroic efforts of a few men. A, perhaps, fanciful exercise might be to wonder how realistic the states ambitions, such as Sir C P s vision of an American-model , thorium-exporting Travancore, or the pretensions the Nizam held at one point to international Muslim leadership, were in the face of reality The disintegration of their patron, the British Empire, and the overwhelming economic leverage and military weight of the Dominion of India. That s not to mention the rising nationalism and Congress influence among the public in the states. Maybe it was always an impossible dream, despite all the plots and conspiracies in the world, as the Nizam would find out. But what makes the princely states interesting is precisely how they came to have these ambitions, and how these kingdoms, shaped by colonial modernity yet claiming pre-colonial legitimacy, conceived of themselves. They offered their own critiques of what was happening in British India. Hyderabad, for instance, claimed that is not to say this reflected reality that it was not affected by communalism, that Hindus and Muslims were the two eyes of the state . It has been argued that a balance was struck between the communities through the politics of interest rather than the politics of numbers, as Purushottam puts it, with Muslims getting a disproportionate share of power and representation despite making up just 15 per cent of the population. However anti-democratic and unjust, there was a theory of politics here, perhaps, even a worldview. That, and the fact that a quarter of India s population lived under the rule of these sovereigns , makes them deserving of far more study and popular attention.
