राहुल गांधी ने बताया लोकसभा विपक्ष के नेता राहुल गांधी ने कहा, आज सुबह मेरी मुलाकात लोकसभा अध्यक्ष से हुई और मैंने उनसे कहा कि हमें कल छात्रों के साथ हुई घटना पर बहस करने की अनुमति दी जानी चाहिए। अध्यक्ष ने कहा कि उन्हें सरकार से अनुमति लेनी होगी। इससे स्पष्ट हो गया कि सरकार को बहस कराने में कोई दिलचस्पी नहीं है। इसके बाद हमने प्रधानमंत्री आवास के सामने जाकर विरोध प्रदर्शन करने और छात्रों के मुद्दों को राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर उठाने का फैसला किया। छात्रों की मांगों में शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान और गृह मंत्री अमित शाह का इस्तीफा, संसद मार्च के दौरान छात्रों को पीटने और अपमानित करने वालों के खिलाफ कार्रवाई और दिल्ली पुलिस में दर्ज छात्रों के खिलाफ सभी मामले वापस लिया जाना शामिल हैं। पूरा विपक्ष चाहता है कि कल लोकसभा और राज्यसभा में इस मुद्दे पर बहस हो। भारत के छात्रों और प्रधानमंत्री को मेरा सीधा संदेश... pic.twitter.com pgZZHLLz8h Rahul Gandhi ( RahulGandhi) July 21, 2026 11 26 PM, 21-Jul-2026 राहुल गांधी के प्रदर्शन पर क्या बोले धर्मेंद्र प्रधान? लोकसभा में नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधी ने मंगलवार को पीएम आवास के पास कांग्रेस समेत विपक्ष के नेताओं के साथ प्रदर्शन किया। इस पर शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान ने कहा कि राहुल गांधी छात्रों का फायदा उठा रहे हैं। उन्होंने सरकार की जवाबदेही की तरफ संकेत करते हुए कहा, हमें युवाओं और छात्रों के लिए इनके गुस्से से कहीं अधिक करने की जरूरत है। प्रधान का बयान ऐसे समय में सामने आया है जब दिल्ली में कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (CJP) और कांग्रेस पार्टी समेत कई दलों के नेता और प्रतियोगी परीक्षा के अभ्यर्थी सड़कों पर उतर आए हैं। विज्ञापन 11 10 PM, 21-Jul-2026 प्रियंका गांधी बोलीं- शिक्षा व्यवस्था को सुधारना होगा, धर्मेंद्र प्रधान दें इस्तीफा कांग्रेस नेता प्रियंका गांधी वाड्रा ने मंगलवार को मंडी मार्ग थाने से रिहा होने के बाद केंद्र सरकार पर निशाना साधा। उन्होंने कहा कि देश की शिक्षा व्यवस्था को सुधारने की जरूरत है और केंद्रीय शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान को इस्तीफा देना चाहिए। नीट के मुद्दे और छात्रों की मांगों के समर्थन में कांग्रेस के प्रदर्शन के दौरान दिल्ली पुलिस ने प्रियंका गांधी को हिरासत में लिया था। रिहाई के बाद उन्होंने पत्रकारों से बातचीत में कहा कि छात्रों की मांगें पूरी तरह जायज हैं और लोकतंत्र में विरोध-प्रदर्शन करना हर नागरिक का मौलिक अधिकार है। उन्होंने कहा, "देश के बच्चों, जो हमारे देश का भविष्य हैं, उनकी बात सुनने में क्या दिक्कत है? उनकी मांग बिल्कुल जायज है। उनके प्रतिनिधि होने के नाते उनकी आवाज उठाना और उन्हें मजबूती देना हमारी जिम्मेदारी है। लोकतंत्र में विरोध-प्रदर्शन करना एक मौलिक अधिकार है। जहां भी जरूरत होगी, हम अपनी आवाज उठाएंगे। हमारी मांग शुरू से ही स्पष्ट है। हमें टूटी हुई शिक्षा व्यवस्था को ठीक करना होगा।" प्रियंका गांधी ने कहा, "धर्मेंद्र प्रधान को इस्तीफा देना होगा। संसद में इस मुद्दे पर चर्चा होनी चाहिए और छात्रों की बात सुनी जानी चाहिए। 'वंदे मातरम्' का क्या मतलब है? अपनी मातृभूमि का सम्मान करना। हमारी मातृभूमि लोकतंत्र है। ये बच्चे कौन हैं? यही वे लोग हैं जिन्होंने हमें संसद में भेजा है। शिक्षा व्यवस्था में व्यापक सुधार के लिए विधेयक क्यों नहीं लाया जाता? अडानी-अंबानी के 16 लाख करोड़ रुपये के कर्ज माफ कर दिए गए, लेकिन पूरे देश की शिक्षा पर सिर्फ 1.4 लाख करोड़ रुपये खर्च किए गए।" 10 20 PM, 21-Jul-2026 प्रियंका गांधी अपने आवास पर पहुंची, पुलिस ने हिरासत से किया रिहा वायनाड से सांसद और कांग्रेस नेता प्रियंका गांधी वाड्रा को पुलिस ने हिरासत से रिहा कर दिया है। इसके बाद वो अपने आवास पर पहुंच गई हैं। प्रियंका गांधी को मंदिर मार्ग पुलिस स्टेशन ले जाया गया था। यहां उनसे मिलने उनकी मां सोनिया गांधी भी पहुंची थीं। WATCH Delhi Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra reaches her residence. She was detained by the Delhi Police earlier today while protesting outside the PM's residence at Lok Kalyan Marg. pic.twitter.com ssskkEtiPh ANI ( ANI) July 21, 2026 09 50 PM, 21-Jul-2026 कांग्रेस के प्रदर्शन पर नितिन नवीन बोले- राहुल गांधी का आचरण अशोभनीय और निंदनीय कांग्रेस द्वारा प्रधानमंत्री के आवास पर किए गए विरोध प्रदर्शन को लेकर भारतीय जनता पार्टी (भाजपा) ने कड़ी प्रतिक्रिया व्यक्त की है। भाजपा अध्यक्ष नितिन नवीन ने विपक्ष के नेता (एलओपी) राहुल गांधी के आचरण को "पूर्णतः अशोभनीय और निंदनीय" बताते हुए कहा कि उनका व्यवहार इस बात का स्पष्ट प्रमाण है कि वह नेता प्रतिपक्ष के पद की गरिमा को गंभीरता से नहीं लेते। भाजपा अध्यक्ष ने कहा कि पार्टी लगातार यह मानती रही है कि राहुल गांधी "अराजकता का प्रतीक" बनते जा रहे हैं। उन्होंने इस बात पर जोर दिया कि कुछ संसदीय कार्यालय किसी एक दल की संपत्ति नहीं हैं, बल्कि प्रधानमंत्री केवल एक पार्टी के नेता नहीं, बल्कि 140 करोड़ नागरिकों के चुने हुए प्रतिनिधि हैं। नवीन ने आरोप लगाया कि राहुल गांधी और उनकी टीम द्वारा प्रधानमंत्री के आवास पर आज जो व्यवहार प्रदर्शित किया गया और अराजकता फैलाने का प्रयास किया गया, वह स्पष्ट रूप से दर्शाता है कि यह "विरोध की राजनीति नहीं, बल्कि अराजकता की राजनीति" है। उन्होंने कहा कि यह विशेष रूप से चिंताजनक है कि कांग्रेस के वरिष्ठ नेता मल्लिकार्जुन खरगे भी राहुल गांधी के साथ थे। भाजपा अध्यक्ष ने आज की घटना को "निश्चित रूप से दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण" और "भारत के राजनीतिक इतिहास का एक काला दिन" बताया। उन्होंने कहा कि भाजपा भी लंबे समय तक विपक्ष में रही है, लेकिन उन्होंने कभी भी ऐसी सीमाएं नहीं लांघीं। उन्होंने कहा कि जब राहुल गांधी ने शर्तें रखीं, तो उन्हें स्वीकार किया गया, फिर भी यह दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण है कि नेता प्रतिपक्ष के पद पर बैठे व्यक्ति प्रक्रिया आगे बढ़ने पर पीछे हट जाते हैं। नितिन नवीन ने कांग्रेस के अपने साथियों को संबोधित करते हुए कहा कि वे संसद के पटल पर किसी भी तरह की बातचीत के लिए हमेशा तैयार हैं। हालांकि, उन्होंने कहा कि शिष्टाचार की सीमाओं को लांघने की उभरती प्रवृत्ति और कांग्रेस के भीतर विकसित हो रही "अराजक मानसिकता" निश्चित रूप से देश को परेशान कर रही है। उन्होंने विश्वास व्यक्त किया कि देश अपने प्रधानमंत्री के साथ मजबूती से खड़ा है। 09 46 PM, 21-Jul-2026 हिरासत से रिहा किए गए राहुल गांधी लोकसभा में विपक्ष के सदस्य और कांग्रेस सांसद राहुल गांधी छत्रसाल स्टेडियम से रवाना हुए। दिल्ली पुलिस ने Congress Protest कांग्रेस ने पीएम मोदी के आवास का घेरने का कब बनाया था प्लान? सामने आ गई जानकारी धरनास्थल पर राहुल गांधी। (Photo-IANS) Congress Protest दिल्ली में मंगलवार को पीएम आवास के बाहर कांग्रेस सांसद धरने पर बैठे हैं। इस दौरान केंद्रीय शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान और पीएम मोदी के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर जमकर नारेबाजी की जा रही है। हालांकि कांग्रेस ने इस प्रदर्शन की किसी को भनक भी नहीं लगने दी। कांग्रेस नेताओं ने मल्लिकार्जुन खरगे के आवास से पीएम आवास तक विरोध मार्च निकाला। इसका नेतृत्वलोकसभा में नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधीने किया। जब पीएम आवास से 100 मीटर दूर कांग्रेस नेता थे, तब मीडिया को जानकारी दी गई। बता दें कि कांग्रेस के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष मल्लिकार्जुन खरगे का आज 84वां जन्मदिन है। मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, खरगे का जन्मदिन मनाने के लिए कांग्रेस नेता उनके आवास पर इकट्ठा हुए थे। जब वहां पर सभी एकत्रित हो गए, तब यह तय किया गया कि पीएम आवास तक मार्च करते हुए जाएंगे और धर्मेंद्र प्रधान-नरेंद्र मोदी के इस्तीफे की मांग करेंगे। कई कांग्रेसियों को लिया हिरासत में पीएम आवास के बाहर कांग्रेस के प्रदर्शन की सूचना मिलने पर पुलिस फोर्स मौके पर पहुंची। पुलिस ने कई कांग्रेस नेताओं को हिरासत में लिया है, जिसमें पंजाब के पूर्व सीएम और सांसद चरणजीत सिंह चन्नी भी शामिल हैं। पीएम आवास के बाहर प्रदर्शन कर रहे कांग्रेस सांसद नासिर हुसैन ने कहा कि राहुल गांधी और मल्लिकार्जुन खरगे ने आज लोकसभा और राज्य सभा दोनों में यह मुद्दा उठाने की कोशिश की कि कैसे कल देश भर से यहां इकट्ठा हुए और एक ऑर्गेनिक आंदोलन में हिस्सा ले रहे स्टूडेंट्स पर लाठीचार्ज, वॉटर कैनन और आंसू गैस का इस्तेमाल किया गया। लेकिन उन्हें बोलने नहीं दिया गया। असल में, किसी सांसद को बोलने नहीं दिया गया। उन्होंने कहा कि पीएम मोदी तो संसद में नहीं आते है, इसलिए सभी विपक्षी सांसद उनके घर आए हैं, ताकि हमारी आवाज सुनी जा सके। इस दौरान सांसद राजीव शुक्ला ने कहा कि हमारे पास कोई और रास्ता नहीं बचा था। वे पार्लियामेंट में बहस नहीं कर रहे हैं। तो हम और क्या कर सकते थे? हमें सड़कों पर उतरना पड़ा। कांग्रेस सांसद जयराम रमेश ने कहा कि हमारी एक सीधी सी मांग है। हमारे विपक्ष के नेताओं ने लोकसभा और राज्य सभा दोनों में यह मांग उठाई है। मांग यह है कि गृह मंत्री पार्लियामेंट में इस पर सफाई दें और इस मुद्दे पर हाउस में चर्चा हो। हम चाहते हैं कि जिस तरह से लोकतंत्र और हमारे संविधान की हत्या हो रही है और स्टूडेंट्स पर ज़ुल्म हो रहे हैं, उस पर वह एक बयान जारी करें। हम 45 दिनों से एजुकेशन मिनिस्टर के इस्तीफे की मांग कर रहे हैं। CJP Protest छात्रों की मांगों का TMC के बागी सांसदों ने किया समर्थन, पुलिसिया कार्रवाई को लेकर भी कही बात Birla Open Mind School अंबिकापुर की शिक्षिका ने 8वीं के छात्र से 200 बार लिखवाई गाली, कहा- पैरेंट्स के सिग्नेचर कराकर लाना Air India London Flight प्लेन का फ्यूल स्विच ठीक, बोइंग की जांच में कुछ नहीं निकला, भारत सरकार ने क्या कहा? Ngoài Bắc Ninh, 3 tỉnh diện tích nhỏ nhất Việt Nam đều "nằm cạnh" Hà Nội Thế Kha (Dân trí) - Bắc Ninh là tỉnh có diện tích nhỏ nhất ở Việt Nam với 822,70km2, đứng thứ 2 là Hà Nam 860,90km2, Hưng Yên đứng thứ 3 với 930,20km2 và tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc đứng kế tiếp với 1.235,20km2. Khi Bộ Nội vụ xây dựng dự thảo nghị quyết của Quốc hội về tiêu chuẩn đơn vị hành chính cấp tỉnh năm 2021, 4 tỉnh giáp ranh với Thủ đô Hà Nội này đều được đưa vào danh sách nghiên cứu sáp nhập do diện tích quá nhỏ. Tỉnh Hà Nam có diện tích tự nhiên chỉ lớn hơn tỉnh Bắc Ninh. Tuy nhiên, tỉnh này lại có ít đơn vị hành chính cấp huyện nhất cả nước - 6 cấp huyện (thấp hơn tiêu chuẩn về số đơn vị hành chính huyện thuộc tỉnh là 9 cấp huyện). Cụ thể, Hà Nam có 4 huyện gồm Kim Bảng, Thanh Liêm, Lý Nhân, Bình Lục thị xã Duy Tiên và thành phố Phủ Lý. Chùa Tam Chúc, tỉnh Hà Nam (Ảnh Mạnh Quân). Trong lịch sử phát triển, Hà Nam trải qua nhiều thay đổi về địa danh và địa giới hành chính. Ngày 20 10 1890, tỉnh Hà Nam được thành lập theo Điều I của Nghị định Toàn quyền Đông Dương trên cơ sở toàn bộ vùng đất của phủ Lý Nhân, hai tổng của Phú Xuyên, gồm 5 huyện Kim Bảng, Duy Tiên, Lý Nhân, Bình Lục, Thanh Liêm và tỉnh lỵ Phủ Lý. Sau Cách mạng Tháng Tám năm 1945, để đáp ứng yêu cầu nhiệm vụ cách mạng, Đảng và Nhà nước đã có một số lần thay đổi, điều chỉnh địa giới hành chính tỉnh Hà Nam. Năm 1965, Hà Nam hợp nhất với tỉnh Nam Định thành tỉnh Nam Hà. Đến năm 1976, tỉnh này hợp nhất với tỉnh Ninh Bình thành tỉnh Hà Nam Ninh. Tới năm 1991, Hà Nam Ninh được tách ra thành hai tỉnh là Nam Hà và Ninh Bình. Năm 1997, Quốc hội đồng ý chia tách tỉnh Nam Hà để tái lập hai tỉnh Hà Nam và Nam Định như hiện nay. Hà Nam có dân số khoảng 0,85 triệu, nằm cách trung tâm Hà Nội hơn 50km và được xem là cửa ngõ phía Nam của Thủ đô. Hà Nam hiện nay không đảm bảo cả 3 tiêu chí về diện tích tự nhiên, dân số và số đơn vị hành chính cấp huyện, theo nghị quyết của Quốc hội về tiêu chuẩn đơn vị hành chính cấp tỉnh. Tỉnh Hưng Yên có 8 huyện gồm huyện Ân Thi, Khoái Châu, Kim Động, Phù Cừ, Tiên Lữ, Văn Giang, Văn Lâm, Yên Mỹ thị xã Mỹ Hào và thành phố Hưng Yên. Hưng Yên được thành lập vào năm Minh Mạng thứ 12 (năm 1831). Từ thế kỷ XVI-XVII, vùng đất Hưng Yên được biết đến qua địa danh Phố Hiến với câu ca "Thứ nhất Kinh kỳ, thứ nhì Phố Hiến", là thương cảng nổi tiếng một thời, lớn nhất Đàng Ngoài, có hoạt động buôn bán, giao thương sầm uất với nhiều nước trên thế giới và nhanh chóng trở thành chốn phồn hoa đô hội - một tiểu Tràng An. Bản đồ hành chính tỉnh Hưng Yên (Ảnh UBND tỉnh Hưng Yên). Tỉnh Hưng Yên chính thức được thành lập vào năm 1931. Đầu năm 1968, Quốc hội phê chuẩn hợp nhất hai tỉnh Hưng Yên và Hải Dương thành tỉnh Hải Hưng, tỉnh lỵ đặt tại thị xã Hải Dương. Đầu năm 1997, tỉnh Hưng Yên được tái lập. Tháng 2 1997, Chính phủ đồng ý tách huyện Phù Tiên thành hai huyện Phù Cừ, Tiên Lữ thành lập và điều chỉnh các phường thuộc thị xã Hưng Yên. Giữa năm 1999, Chính phủ đồng ý tách hai huyện Mỹ Văn và Châu Giang thành 5 huyện Văn Lâm, Văn Giang, Mỹ Hào, Yên Mỹ và Khoái Châu. Tới tháng 9 2003, Chính phủ tiếp tục điều chỉnh địa giới hành chính mở rộng thị xã Hưng Yên, thành lập phường, điều chỉnh địa giới hành chính giữa các phường của thị xã Hưng Yên. Đầu năm 2009, thành phố Hưng Yên trực thuộc tỉnh Hưng Yên được thành lập. Tỉnh Hưng Yên hiện có dân số trên 1,29 triệu người. Tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc được thành lập ngày 12 2 1950, trên cơ sở hợp nhất tỉnh Vĩnh Yên và tỉnh Phúc Yên. Đến tháng 2 1968 tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc hợp nhất với tỉnh Phú Thọ thành tỉnh Vĩnh Phú. Từ ngày 1 1 1997 tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc được tái lập. Tháng 9 1998, huyện Tam Đảo tách thành hai huyện Tam Dương và Bình Xuyên. Ngày 9 12 2003, Chính phủ ra nghị định thành lập thị xã Phúc Yên và huyện Tam Đảo mới. Ngày 1 12 2006 Chính phủ ra nghị định thành lập thành phố Vĩnh Yên, tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc. Vào năm 2008, thực hiện chủ trương của Đảng và Nhà nước về mở rộng địa giới hành chính Hà Nội, huyện Mê Linh thuộc tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc chuyển về thuộc Thủ đô Hà Nội. Tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc hiện có 9 đơn vị hành chính, gồm hai thành phố (Vĩnh Yên, Phúc Yên) và 7 huyện (Tam Dương, Tam Đảo, Yên Lạc, Vĩnh Tường, Lập Thạch, Sông Lô, Bình Xuyên). Lâu đài Tam Đảo, công trình nổi tiếng ở huyện Tam Đảo, Vĩnh Phúc (Ảnh Lạc Hồng). Vĩnh Phúc có tiềm năng lớn về tài nguyên du lịch tự nhiên và nhân văn. Cho đến nay, Vĩnh Phúc vẫn mang đậm dấu ấn của văn hóa Hùng Vương và Kinh Bắc, Thăng Long, của nền văn hóa dân gian đặc sắc, của khoa bảng, với lối sống xã hội và chuẩn mực đạo đức luôn được giữ gìn. Địa phương này còn có một quần thể danh lam, thắng cảnh tự nhiên nổi tiếng Vườn quốc gia Tam Đảo, thác Bản Long, hồ Đại Lải, hồ Làng Hà... Nhiều lễ hội dân gian đậm đà bản sắc dân tộc và rất nhiều di tích lịch sử, văn hóa mang đậm dấu ấn lịch sử và giá trị tâm linh như Danh thắng Tây Thiên, Tháp Bình Sơn, Đền thờ Trần Nguyên Hãn, Di chỉ khảo cổ học Đồng Đậu... Vĩnh Phúc hiện có dân số khoảng 1,2 triệu người. Bộ Chính trị nêu thời hạn báo cáo sáp nhập tỉnh Như Dân trí thông tin, Bộ Chính trị, Ban Bí thư yêu cầu xây dựng đề án sáp nhập một số đơn vị hành chính cấp tỉnh, không tổ chức cấp huyện, tiếp tục sáp nhập đơn vị hành chính cấp xã. FAQs Q Kaunsa tarika sabse fast hai cylinder book karne ka? A WhatsApp ya Missed Call sabse fast hai - 2 minute mein booking confirm. App bhi achha hai agar tracking chahiye. Q Registered mobile number change karna hai, kaise? A Nearest distributor ke paas jaao Aadhaar card ke saath. Woh number update kar denge. Online nahi hota ye. Q Cylinder price kab change hoti hai? A Har mahine ki 1 tareekh ko oil companies price revise karti hain. Increase ya decrease dono ho sakta hai. Q Subsidy kaise milti hai? A Agar eligible ho toh subsidy directly bank account mein aati hai (DBT - Direct Benefit Transfer). Aadhaar bank se link hona chahiye. Q Double cylinder connection le sakte hain? A Haan! Ek hi company se ya alag companies se 2 cylinders le sakte ho. Distributor se baat karo. Q Cylinder delivery mein kitna time lagta hai? A Normal mein 1-3 din . Festival season ya shortage mein 5-7 din bhi lag sakte hain. Booking ke baad tracking check karo. Q Commercial cylinder ghar pe use kar sakte hain? A Nahi! Commercial cylinder domestic use ke liye illegal hai. Pakde gaye toh fine lagega. Domestic cylinder hi use karo. Quickstart For streamlined integration, we recommend using Qwen3.6 via APIs. Below is a guide to use Qwen3.6 via OpenAI-compatible API. Serving Qwen3.6 Qwen3.6 can be served via APIs with popular inference frameworks. In the following, we show example commands to launch OpenAI-Compatible API servers for Qwen3.6 models. Inference efficiency and throughput vary significantly across frameworks. We recommend using the latest framework versions to ensure optimal performance and compatibility. For production workloads or high-throughput scenarios, dedicated serving engines such as SGLang, KTransformers or vLLM are strongly recommended. The model has a default context length of 262,144 tokens. If you encounter out-of-memory (OOM) errors, consider reducing the context window. However, because Qwen3.6 leverages extended context for complex tasks, we advise maintaining a context length of at least 128K tokens to preserve thinking capabilities. SGLang SGLang is a fast serving framework for large language models and vision language models. sglang 0.5.10 is recommended for Qwen3.6, which can be installed using the following command in a fresh environment uv pip install sglang all See its documentation for more details. The following will create API endpoints at Standard Version The following command can be used to create an API endpoint with maximum context length 262,144 tokens using tensor parallel on 8 GPUs. python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen Qwen3.6-27B --port 8000 --tp-size 8 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --context-length 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 Tool Use To support tool use, you can use the following command. python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen Qwen3.6-27B --port 8000 --tp-size 8 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --context-length 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) The following command is recommended for MTP python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen Qwen3.6-27B --port 8000 --tp-size 8 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --context-length 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --speculative-algo NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 For detailed deployment guide, see the SGLang Qwen3.5 Cookbook . vLLM vLLM is a high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs. vllm 0.19.0 is recommended for Qwen3.6, which can be installed using the following command in a fresh environment uv pip install vllm --torch-backend auto See its documentation for more details. The following will create API endpoints at Standard Version The following command can be used to create an API endpoint with maximum context length 262,144 tokens using tensor parallel on 8 GPUs. vllm serve Qwen Qwen3.6-27B --port 8000 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 Tool Call To support tool use, you can use the following command. vllm serve Qwen Qwen3.6-27B --port 8000 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) The following command is recommended for MTP vllm serve Qwen Qwen3.6-27B --port 8000 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --speculative-config ' "method" "qwen3_next_mtp","num_speculative_tokens" 2 ' Text-Only The following command skips the vision encoder and multimodal profiling to free up memory for additional KV cache vllm serve Qwen Qwen3.6-27B --port 8000 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --language-model-only For detailed deployment guide, see the vLLM Qwen3.5 Recipe . KTransformers KTransformers is a flexible framework for experiencing cutting-edge LLM inference optimizations with CPU-GPU heterogeneous computing. For running Qwen3.6 with KTransformers, see the KTransformers Deployment Guide . Hugging Face Transformers Hugging Face Transformers contains a lightweight server which can be used for quick testing and moderate load deployment. The latest transformers is required for Qwen3.6 pip install "transformers serving " See its documentation for more details. Please also make sure torchvision and pillow are installed. Then, run transformers serve to launch a server with API endpoints at it will place the model on accelerators if available transformers serve Qwen Qwen3.6-27B --port 8000 --continuous-batching Using Qwen3.6 via the Chat Completions API The chat completions API is accessible via standard HTTP requests or OpenAI SDKs. Here, we show examples using the OpenAI Python SDK. Qwen3.6 will think by default before response. You can obtain direct response from the model without thinking by configuring the API parameters. For example, from openai import OpenAI Configured by environment variables client OpenAI() messages "role" "user" , "content" "type" "image_url" , "image_url" "url" " , "type" "text" , "text" "Where is this?" chat_response client.chat.completions.create( model "Qwen Qwen3.6-27B" , messages messages, max_tokens 32768 , temperature 0.7 , top_p 0.8 , presence_penalty 1.5 , extra_body "top_k" 20 , "chat_template_kwargs" "enable_thinking" False , , ) print ( "Chat response " , chat_response) If you are using APIs from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, in addition to changing model , please use "enable_thinking" False instead of "chat_template_kwargs" "enable_thinking" False . Preserve Thinking By default, only the thinking blocks generated in handling the latest user message is retained, resulting in a pattern commonly as interleaved thinking. Qwen3.6 has been additionally trained to preserve and leverage thinking traces from historical messages. You can enable this behavior by setting the preserve_thinking option from openai import OpenAI Configured by environment variables client OpenAI() messages ... chat_response client.chat.completions.create( model "Qwen Qwen3.6-27B" , messages messages, max_tokens 32768 , temperature 0.6 , top_p 0.95 , presence_penalty 0.0 , extra_body "top_k" 20 , "chat_template_kwargs" "preserve_thinking" True , , ) print ( "Chat response " , chat_response) If you are using APIs from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, in addition to changing model , please use "preserve_thinking" True instead of "chat_template_kwargs" "preserve_thinking" False . This capability is particularly beneficial for agent scenarios, where maintaining full reasoning context can enhance decision consistency and, in many cases, reduce overall token consumption by minimizing redundant reasoning. Additionally, it can improve KV cache utilization, optimizing inference efficiency in both thinking and non-thinking modes. Agentic Usage Qwen3.6 excels in tool calling capabilities. Qwen-Agent We recommend using Qwen-Agent to quickly build Agent applications with Qwen3.6. To define the available tools, you can use the MCP configuration file, use the integrated tool of Qwen-Agent, or integrate other tools by yourself. import os from qwen_agent.agents import Assistant Define LLM Using Alibaba Cloud Model Studio llm_cfg Use the OpenAI-compatible model service provided by DashScope 'model' 'qwen3.6-27b' , 'model_type' 'qwenvl_oai' , 'model_server' ' , 'api_key' os.getenv( 'DASHSCOPE_API_KEY' ), 'generate_cfg' 'use_raw_api' True , When using Dash Scope OAI API, pass the parameter of whether to enable thinking mode in this way 'extra_body' 'enable_thinking' True , 'preserve_thinking' True , , , Using OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. functionality of the deployment frameworks and let Qwen-Agent automate the related operations. llm_cfg Use your own model service compatible with OpenAI API by vLLM SGLang 'model' 'Qwen Qwen3.6-27B', 'model_type' 'qwenvl_oai', 'model_server' ' api_base 'api_key' 'EMPTY', 'generate_cfg' 'use_raw_api' True, When using vLLM SGLang OAI API, pass the parameter of whether to enable thinking mode in this way 'extra_body' 'chat_template_kwargs' 'enable_thinking' True, 'preserve_thinking' True , , Define Tools tools 'mcpServers' You can specify the MCP configuration file "filesystem" "command" "npx" , "args" "-y" , " modelcontextprotocol server-filesystem" , " Users xxxx Desktop" Define Agent bot Assistant(llm llm_cfg, function_list tools) Streaming generation messages 'role' 'user' , 'content' 'Help me organize my desktop.' for responses in bot.run(messages messages) pass print (responses) Streaming generation messages 'role' 'user' , 'content' 'Develop a dog website and save it on the desktop' for responses in bot.run(messages messages) pass print (responses) Qwen Code Qwen Code is an open-source AI agent for the terminal, optimized for Qwen models. It helps you understand large codebases, automate tedious work, and ship faster. For more information, please refer to Qwen Code . Processing Ultra-Long Texts Qwen3.6 natively supports context lengths of up to 262,144 tokens. For long-horizon tasks where the total length (including both input and output) exceeds this limit, we recommend using RoPE scaling techniques to handle long texts effectively., e.g., YaRN. YaRN is currently supported by several inference frameworks, e.g., transformers , vllm , ktransformers and sglang . In general, there are two approaches to enabling YaRN for supported frameworks Modifying the model configuration file In the config.json file, change the rope_parameters fields in text_config to "mrope_interleaved" true , "mrope_section" 11 , 11 , 10 , "rope_type" "yarn" , "rope_theta" 10000000 , "partial_rotary_factor" 0.25 , "factor" 4.0 , "original_max_position_embeddings" 262144 , Passing command line arguments For vllm , you can use VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN 1 vllm serve ... --hf-overrides ' "text_config" "rope_parameters" "mrope_interleaved" true, "mrope_section" 11, 11, 10 , "rope_type" "yarn", "rope_theta" 10000000, "partial_rotary_factor" 0.25, "factor" 4.0, "original_max_position_embeddings" 262144 ' --max-model-len 1010000 For sglang and ktransformers , you can use SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN 1 python -m sglang.launch_server ... --json-model-override-args ' "text_config" "rope_parameters" "mrope_interleaved" true, "mrope_section" 11, 11, 10 , "rope_type" "yarn", "rope_theta" 10000000, "partial_rotary_factor" 0.25, "factor" 4.0, "original_max_position_embeddings" 262144 ' --context-length 1010000 All the notable open-source frameworks implement static YaRN, which means the scaling factor remains constant regardless of input length, potentially impacting performance on shorter texts. We advise modifying the rope_parameters configuration only when processing long contexts is required. It is also recommended to modify the factor as needed. For example, if the typical context length for your application is 524,288 tokens, it would be better to set factor as 2.0. Best Practices To achieve optimal performance, we recommend the following settings Sampling Parameters We suggest using the following sets of sampling parameters depending on the mode and task type Thinking mode for general tasks temperature 1.0 , top_p 0.95 , top_k 20 , min_p 0.0 , presence_penalty 0.0 , repetition_penalty 1.0 Thinking mode for precise coding tasks (e.g., WebDev) temperature 0.6 , top_p 0.95 , top_k 20 , min_p 0.0 , presence_penalty 0.0 , repetition_penalty 1.0 Instruct (or non-thinking) mode temperature 0.7 , top_p 0.80 , top_k 20 , min_p 0.0 , presence_penalty 1.5 , repetition_penalty 1.0 For supported frameworks, you can adjust the presence_penalty parameter between 0 and 2 to reduce endless repetitions. However, using a higher value may occasionally result in language mixing and a slight decrease in model performance. Adequate Output Length We recommend using an output length of 32,768 tokens for most queries. For benchmarking on highly complex problems, such as those found in math and programming competitions, we suggest setting the max output length to 81,920 tokens. This provides the model with sufficient space to generate detailed and comprehensive responses, thereby enhancing its overall performance. Standardize Output Format We recommend using prompts to standardize model outputs when benchmarking. Math Problems Include "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within boxed ." in the prompt. Multiple-Choice Questions Add the following JSON structure to the prompt to standardize responses "Please show your choice in the answer field with only the choice letter, e.g., "answer" "C" ." Long Video Understanding To optimize inference efficiency for plain text and images, the size parameter in the released video_preprocessor_config.json is conservatively configured. It is recommended to set the longest_edge parameter in the video_preprocessor_config file to 469,762,048 (corresponding to 224k video tokens) to enable higher frame-rate sampling for hour-scale videos and thereby achieve superior performance. For example, "longest_edge" 469762048 , "shortest_edge" 4096 Alternatively, override the default values via engine startup parameters. For implementation details, refer to vLLM SGLang . The Physics of Radiative Cooling Before exploring the methods, it is essential to understand the mechanism. Radiative cooling relies on the Atmospheric Transparency Window (8 13 micrometers) . The Concept The Earth s atmosphere is opaque to most infrared (IR) radiation due to greenhouse gases ( CO_2 , water vapor), trapping heat. However, between 8 and 13 µm, the atmosphere is largely transparent. The Sink Outer space acts as a thermal sink at approximately 3 Kelvin (-270 C). The Process If a surface is engineered to have high emissivity ( epsilon ) in the 8 13 µm range and high reflectivity (albedo) in the solar spectrum, it can emit thermal energy directly into space, bypassing the greenhouse effect. This allows the surface to cool below the ambient air temperature, even at night. 1. Global Deployment of Super-Radiative Roofing The most immediate application is replacing standard roofing materials with Passive Radiative Cooling (PRC) materials . Mechanism Traditional white paint reflects sunlight (albedo 0.9) but absorbs heat in the infrared spectrum. Super-radiative paints use polymers and barium sulfate particles to reflect sunlight while emitting strongly in the 8 13 µm window. Implementation Global retrofitting of commercial and residential buildings. Impact on Global Temps Direct Reduces the Urban Heat Island (UHI) effect. Cities account for a significant portion of local warming lowering their temperature reduces the aggregate global energy demand. Indirect Reduces electricity consumption for air conditioning by 20 40 , thereby lowering CO_2 emissions from power plants, which enhances the atmospheric window further. Technical Specs Achieves sub-ambient cooling of Delta T approx 5-8 C . 2. Infra-Red Emissive Road Surfaces Asphalt is a primary driver of urban heating due to its low albedo and low IR emissivity. Mechanism Developing "Cool Pavement" composites that incorporate phase-change materials (PCMs) and IR-emissive ceramics. Implementation Laying these materials in major highway networks and urban centers globally. Impact Nighttime Sink During the night, these roads actively radiate the heat absorbed during the day directly into space, rather than radiating it back into the street-level air. Albedo Increases the planetary albedo of urban infrastructure, reflecting more solar energy before it is absorbed. 3. Floating Ocean Radiative Cooling Platforms The oceans absorb the vast majority of excess heat in the climate system. Enhancing their ability to shed this heat is critical. Mechanism Deploying large-scale floating arrays (similar to solar farms) covered in high-emissivity hydrophobic membranes. Implementation Placing these platforms in warm ocean currents (e.g., the Gulf Stream, Kuroshio). Process The platform floats on the water. At night, the membrane radiates heat into space. Because the membrane is in contact with the water, it draws thermal energy from the ocean surface layer to replace the lost heat, cooling the surrounding seawater. Impact Reduces the thermal load of the oceans, potentially slowing the release of heat back into the atmosphere and reducing ocean acidification rates. 4. Nighttime Thermal Energy Storage (TES) for HVAC Instead of just cooling buildings, we can use radiative cooling to store energy, reducing the need for fossil-fuel-based power generation. Mechanism Large-scale radiative cooling towers are installed. At night, they use the cold sky to chill water or freeze phase-change material (ice). Implementation Replacing traditional water-intensive cooling towers with dry radiative cooling towers in industrial complexes. Impact Peak Shaving The stored "coolth" is used during the day to air-condition cities. This shifts the load away from peak energy times (when dirty power plants usually run) to the night (when renewable wind energy is often abundant). 5. Radiative Cooling for Power Plant Condensers Power plants (nuclear, coal, natural gas) rely on cooling towers to condense steam, often releasing massive plumes of hot water and heat into the environment. Mechanism Replace water-based condenser cooling with radiative cooling condensers . Process These systems use a vacuum-insulated panel with a high-emissivity surface facing the night sky. Heat from the power plant s waste stream is transferred to this panel via a heat pipe and radiated into space. Impact Zero-Water Usage Solves the conflict between energy production and water scarcity. Global Temp Reduces the thermal pollution of local water bodies and the atmosphere, maintaining the efficiency of the Rankine cycle while preventing excess waste heat accumulation. 6. Cirrus Cloud Thinning (Geoengineering) While this is a geoengineering technique, it is fundamentally about enhancing radiative cooling. The Problem High-altitude Cirrus clouds act like a blanket. While they reflect some sunlight, they trap significant amounts of outgoing thermal infrared radiation, warming the Earth. The Method Using aircraft to inject ice nuclei (like silver iodide) into supercooled cirrus clouds. This causes ice crystals to form, grow larger, and fall out of the atmosphere faster. Result Thinner cirrus clouds allow more terrestrial infrared radiation (heat) to escape through the atmospheric window into space. Impact This is one of the most effective ways to utilize the "nighttime cooling" mechanism on a planetary scale, directly reversing the radiative forcing caused by aviation and natural cloud thickening. 7. Process At night, the film radiates heat away from the soil and crop canopy into space. Impact Frost Protection Historically used to stop frost, but optimized for cooling, it can reduce heat stress on crops during heatwaves. New York aur London mein students ne 'Main bhi cockroach' slogan se NEET system ke khilaf avaaz uthai. Biplab Biswas Published on 22 Jul 2026 Follow Advertisement NEET ke against chal rahe student protests ab sirf India tak mehboob nahi rahe ye London aur New York tak pahunch gaye hain! Hazar se zyada Indian students jo videshi sheher mein padhai kar rahe hain, unhone streets par utar kar "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare lagaaye hain aur NEET exam system ko leke apna gussa zahir kiya hai. Ye global movement dekh kar sarkari talash ho gai hai, kyunki National Testing Agency ke exam conduct karne ke tareekon ko lekar poore desh mein ek bada shukhna badh gaya hai aur ab videshi universities ke students bhi apna voice uthaane lage hain. Poori Khabar Kya Hai? NEET examination ko leker jo controversy badh gai hai, voh sirf desh ke andar tak simit nahi rahi. Lakho students jo India se bahar padhne gaye hain, unhe bhi iska prabhav pad raha hai kyunki unke parivar aur bhai-bahan jo desh mein hain, unko NEET dena padta hai. Jab se National Testing Agency ne exam conduct karne mein different tareekon ko follow kiya hai, tab se ek alag hi frustration ka mauhaul ban gaya hai. London aur New York mein Indian student communities ne "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare likhe hue placards le kar protests kiye hain, jo ek musical composition ke lyrics se liye gaye hain jo NEET se related ek satire ban gaya hai. Ye "Main bhi cockroach" slogan ek deep comment hai Indian education system aur NTA ke exam conduct ke tareekon par. Students ka kehna hai ki jis tarah cockroaches ko lab mein bekar samjha jata hai, usi tarah NTA unhein bhi sirf statistics samjh raha hai, numbers samjh raha hai, par unke actual learning aur skills ko nahi dekh raha. Jab National Testing Agency lakho students ke marks ko revise karta hai, jab answer keys mein galtiyan aati hain, toh students ko lagta hai ki unhein insaan ki tarah treat nahi kiya ja raha. Video clips aur social media posts se dekha ja sakta hai ki London ke Piccadilly Circus aur New York ke Times Square jaise jagahon par ye protests hue hain. NTA ke under NEET exam hota hai jo medical colleges mein admission ke liye zaruri hai. Pichle kuch mahine mein NEET ke marks mein jo modifications ane hain, jo grace marks diye gaye hain, jo ek saath multiple answer keys banaye gaye hain sab kuch mein ek bada jhoomla hai. Students ke hisaab se transparency nahi hai, sabka fairness nahi hai, aur jo topper ban gaye hain, unhe bhi shubh nahi hai kyunki unhe lagta hai ki shayad unhe galti se marks zyada mil gaye hain ya phir doosre ko kam mil gaye hain. Isse jo psychological pressure create hua hai, uspar ye global protests utha hai. Videshi sheher se ye protest signal bhej rahe hain ki NEET issue sirf ek local matter nahi raha. Agar lakho students jo abroad hain aur apne sapne poore kar rahe hain, ve bhi apne desh ke exam system ke khilaaf bolne ke liye bahar aaye, toh samajho ki problem kitna bada hai. International media ne bhi inn protests ko cover kiya hai, aur ye India ke education system par ek global spotlight ban gaya hai. Students kehte hain ki jab tak NTA ne NEET conduct karne ke tareekon ko transparent aur fair nahi banaya, tab tak ye protests chalte rahenge. Key Highlights Global Reach NEET protests London, New York aur doosre videshi sheher tak pahunch gaye hain jahaan large Indian student population hai Slogan "Main bhi cockroach" students ke gussa aur frustration ka symbol ban gaya hai jo NTA ke exam system ke khilaaf ek strong message de raha hai NTA ke Issues Multiple answer keys, grace marks, score revisions, aur transparency ki kami ke karan students mein ek bada distrust hai Student Base Hazaron Indian students jo videshi universities mein padhe hue hain, unhe apne family members ke NEET scores ko leker chinta hai International Coverage Global media networks ne in protests ko cover kiya hai aur India ke education system par international attention aa gaya hai Psychological Impact NEET takers ko ek bada stress aur anxiety feel ho raha hai kyunki unhe pata nahi ki final score kya hoga aur kab announce hoga Demand for Transparency Students chahte hain ki National Testing Agency sara detailed analysis public kare, har question ke liye explanation de, aur clear guidelines set kare Youth Frustration Symbol Ye protests sirf NEET tak nahi, balki Indian education system ke poore structure par ek bada sawaal ubhaara hai Advertisement Kisko Milega Fayda? Iss global movement se directly jo faida mil sakta hai voh hai medical education ko leker ek alag tarah ki consciousness create hona. Jab lakho students poore duniya se ek issue ko highlight kar rahi hain, toh sarkari vibhag ko sunna padta hai. NEET ke through jo lakho students har saal medical colleges mein admission lena chahte hain, unhe agar ye protests successful hote hain toh ek transparent aur fair system mil payega. Aaj jo NEET exam de raha hai, voh ek chota student nahi hai, uska ek international connection hai, uska voice international stage par suna ja sakta hai isse NTA ko samajhna padega ki exam conduct mein ek bada responsibility hai. Medical profession se jude 15-16 lakh students jo har saal NEET dete hain, unhe sab se zyada faida milega. Agar ye global movement se transparency aaye aur answer keys saaf-sutra ho jayen, toh future generations ko ek better examination experience milega. NEET ke marks par lakho students aur un ke parivar ke sapne depend karte hain. Jab scores revise hote hain, tab unhe lagta hai ki unhe na-insaafi hui hai. Agar protests se ye badlav aaye ki NTA apne processes ko improve kare, aapne training de, aapne double-check system banaye, toh lakho students ko aage faida milega. Indian government aur Ministry of Education ko bhi isse ek signal milega ki youth ko education system ke bare mein kitni chinta hai. Global level par agar India ke exam system ko lekar controversy ho raha hai, toh ye desh ke talent aur credibility ko affect karta hai. Videshi universities mein jo Indian students padhte hain, ve apne desh ko represent karte hain. Agar unhone videshi sheher mein streets par uttar kar protest kiya, toh iska matlab hai ki system mein kuch fundamental problems hain jo solve hone zaruri hain. International reputation ke liye bhi Indian government ko respond karna padega. Agency ke hisaab se, grace marks dena sirf un students ko tha jinhe exam conduct mein technical issues face karne pade. Score revisions ke bare mein NTA kahta hai ki scientific method se ye kiya gaya tha aur har student ke liye fair tha. Sarkari level se bhi Ministry of Education ne kaha hai ki NEET system India mein sabse transparent aur merit-based system hai, lekin students ke grievances ko seriously liya ja raha hai aur further improvements par kaam chal raha hai. Aage ke months mein ye protests aur bhi vocal ho sakte hain kyunki jo momentum iss global movement ne create ki hai, voh rokna mushkil hai. International students jo apne desh ke liye iska voice ban gaye hain, unhe support milega apne colleges aur universities se. Faculty members, international student organizations, aur even some foreign governments Indian education system ko lekar questions pooch sakte hain. NEET exam ke next year ke conduct mein NTA ko behti-soch-samajh kar decision lena padega. Agar 2025 mein bhi same tarah issues aaye, toh protests aur bhi bade hote jayenge. Government level par bhi iska impact padega. Sarkaari committees aur education ministry ko NEET system ke liye ek complete audit karna padega. Technical issues, human error, aur systematic problems sab ko identify karna padega aur ek robust system develop karna padega. Isse pehle ke exam conduct mein NTA ko apne QA QC processes ko strengthen karna chahiye. Students ke complaints ko ek structured mechanism ke through handle karna chahiye taaki transparency baniye rahe. Individual students jo NEET de rahe hain aur Jo future mein denge, unhe ye advice hai ki apne scores ko leker anxiety mein pad jayen toh isse no point hai. Jo kiya hai wo kiya hai, ab apne appeals aur grievance redressal process ko utilize karna chahiye. Agar kisi ko genuinely koi issue nazar aaye apne paper checking mein, toh NTA ke official website par detailed review request karna chahiye. Exam mein har question par ek answer key available hona chahiye with justification, aur uss par agar question mark hain toh official appeal file karna chahiye. Aksar Pooche Jaane Wale Sawaal Q1 "Main bhi cockroach" ka matlab kya hai? Ye ek symbolic statement hai jiska matlab ye hai ki students ko NTA unhe humans ki tarah value nahi de raha sirf statistics samjh raha hai. Cockroach lab experiment ka subject hote hain aur inhein scientific experiments mein use kiya jata hai. Students ye kehna chahte hain ki unhe same way treat kiya ja raha hai jaise lab specimens ko, unke individual concerns ignore ho rahe hain, sirf data collection chal raha hai. Ye phrase ekdum harsh criticism hai exam system ka. Q2 NEET scores revise kyun hote hain? Jab exam conduct ke baad NTA ko kisi question mein scientific error ya multiple valid answers mil jayein, toh voh answer key ko revise karte hain. Isse jo students affected hote hain, unhe grace marks diye jate hain. However, students ka point hai ki ye grace marks system arbitrary hai kisi ko mil gaya, kisi ko nahi. Transparency nahi hai kaunse exactly questions ko revise kiya gaya aur kyu, aur grace marking criteria kya tha. Q3 Videshi countries mein kyu ye protests ho rahe hain? Indian diaspora pura duniya mein phela hai. Jo students videshi universities mein padhe hue hain, unke younger siblings, cousins, aur family members ko India mein NEET dena padta hai. Jab apne gharwalon ke scores niyay karne wale system ko unfair dekha, toh unhone apna voice uthaaya. Plus, unhe videshi countries mein freedom of expression ka advantage hai jo unhe apni taraf India mein possible nahi hota. Q4 Kya NEET exam system badlega? Ye baat ki confirm nahi hai, lekin international pressure aur domestic protests se NTA ko zaroor apni processes improve karne padenge. Jo students demand kar rahe hain transparency, detailed answer explanations, grievance redressal mechanism ye sab reasonable hain. Sarkar ko bhi social unrest dekh kar respond karna padega. Changes slow hote hain, lekin ye momentum continue rahegi. Q5 Abhi NEET dene wale students ko kya karna chahiye? Apni preparation par focus rakhni chahiye aur exam mein apna best performance dena chahiye. Agar exam ke baad kisi ko kisi answer key par doubt ho, toh official review request file karna chahiye. Isme himmat mat haar system mein problems ho sakte hain, lekin individual effort se success milti hai. Apne score announce hone se pehle padhna mat chhod har mark matters. Advertisement Closing NEET protest jo "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare ke saath London aur New York tak pahuncha hai, voh sirf ek exam issue nahi hai ye India ke education system, student welfare, aur governance ko lekar ek bada global conversation hai. Lakho students unke dreams pursue karte hain, unhe fair aur transparent system deserve hai. Abhi jo protesting ho rahe hain aur jo government mein hain, dono ko bahut seriously iss issue ko lena chahiye. Students apne scores, apne future, apne rights ke liye apni awaaz uthaao, lekin registered aur structured tareekon se. Government aur NTA listen karo, respond karo, aur ek truly transparent exam system banao jo sabko capable banaye bina discrimination ke. Sabhi students ke liye advice National Testing Agency ki official website nta.ac.in par visit karo, apne scores aur answer keys check karo, agar koi issue ho toh official grievance portal mein appeal karo. Apne education aur apne future ko seriously lo, kyunki ye tumhara hi responsibility hai. Baaki, ye global movement ensure karega ki system mein change zaroor aayega sirf Time ka sawaal hai. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). Produced by Jamil Baig under JB Films and Hassan Zia under Mastermind Production, it stars Saba Qamar and Zahid Ahmed . It was released on Eid al-Fitr , 3 May 2022, by Geo Films . Premise edit Being an only child to her father, Zubeda was raised more like a son to be an empowered woman. She wants justice for her father, and seeks help from officer Sikandar. However, she gets trapped in a love triangle with him and her cousin. Cast edit Lead edit Saba Qamar as Zubeda Sajjad Zahid Ahmed as Sikandar, a cop Recurring edit Nayyar Ejaz as Bhai Miyan (Antagonist) Syed Jibran as Vicky, Zubeda's cousin Afzal Khan as Aslam Saleem Meraj as Rizwan Gul-e-Rana as Gul-e-Rana Dodi Khan as Raza Shazeal Shoukat as Secretary Tayyab Mahmood Sheikh as Police Constable (Right) 2 Sohail Ahmed as Chodhri Sajjad Additionally, YouTuber Junaid Akram and news reporter Amin Hafeez also appear in the film. 3 Production edit In September 2019, it was announced that Mohsin Khan and Saqib Khan would be making a film. Soon, Jamil Baig and Hassan Zia signed in as producers. The film was announced in January 2020 under the title Zubeda Mard Ban however it was changed to Ghabrana Nahi Hai in February. As the cast was finalized, the filming was set to begin in March 2020 however, after only two days, it was paused due to the COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan . 4 5 6 7 After the lockdown restrictions lifted, 90 principal photography took place in Malir District , Karachi , from November 2020 onward. Then filming took place respectively in Lahore and Faisalabad in January 2021, before wrap-up in February 2021 followed by post-production . 8 9 Arshad Khan served as cinematographer, and Hunain Shamim as editor the cast and crew included 17 debutants, as the producers wanted to put forward fresh talent. The film's title is derived from the famous dialogue of Imran Khan , 22nd Prime Minister of Pakistan , though not in a sarcastic way but for a positive message. 10 11 12 13 Soundtrack edit Ghabrana Nahi Hai Soundtrack album by Shuja Haider Released 7 May 2022 ( 2022-05-07 ) Recorded 2019 21 Length 17 31 Languages Urdu Punjabi Labels Geo JB Mastermind External audio Jukebox on YouTube All tracks are written by Shuja Haider, otherwise noted. Home Politics Ghabrana nahi hai, PM tells nation, again Ghabrana nahi hai, PM tells nation, again News Desk 6 years ago Prime Minister (PM) Imran Khan on Tuesday resorted to his popular mantra of ghabrana nahi hai as he urged the nation not to panic amid the global outbreak of coronavirus that has left at least 237 infected across the country and over 190,000 in the world with nearly 8,000 deaths. Addressing the nation as the new coronavirus COVID-19 spreads in Pakistan, the premier said that the virus was dangerous for the elderly since it attacked their already-weakened immune system, adding that there was no need to panic since 97 of the affectees recovered from the virus. Corona virus is a flu that spreads very quickly. 97 cases of the virus are treated successfully, and out of this, 90 are mild. Only 4-5 have to go to hospitals, he said as he downplayed the global pandemic that has forced countries to shut down entire cities, including the Italian capital. We formed the National Security Committee last week when only 20 cases had been reported. Italy didn t act immediately, which led to a lockdown after the virus rapidly spread. The United States (US) is now shutting down cities while the United Kingdom (UK) is dealing with it differently, PM Imran said, adding that his government mulled shutting down cities back when there were only 20 cases of the novel virus. He maintained that it, however, wasn t an option for a country like Pakistan. Our country is not like Europe. We are a poor country. Unemployment is high, businesses are slow, the economy is going through a tough time. So we thought people would die of hunger and poverty if we locked down cities. We are dealing with this in our own way. We have asked NDMA National Disaster Management Authority to be ready for an outbreak. NDMA will also provide ventilators as they will be needed in case of an outbreak. We have shut down educational institutions and banned public gatherings. A core committee of doctors specialising in infectious diseases is also working with us. The premier further said that the government had constituted two committees to deal with the virus. One is the coordination committee and the other one is an economic committee to determine how this will affect the economy. Our economic committee will ensure that there is no hoarding and prices of essential items do not increase. PM Imran said that his government took the difficult decision to prohibit public gatherings and ban events where public showed up in huge numbers such as the Pakistan Super League (PSL). Urging the people to join hands with the government in its war against the pandemic, he said that people should know that the virus will spread. But don t panic. It is our belief that life and death are in the hands of Allah. Every person should not get him or her self tested based on mild flu symptoms alone. Testing kits should be used only for those who actually have symptoms of the novel virus. The premier also paid tribute to the government of Balochistan and Pakistan army for ensuring that pilgrims arriving from Taftan were quarantined. He said that the government was following the coronavirus situation closely, and praised the efforts of doctors and nurses, saying that the government would help them in their jihad against the virus. 'Aap ne ghabrana nahi' Pak embassy in Serbia tweets parody video criticising PM Imran Khan The now-deleted tweet also mentions that the staff at the embassy haven't been paid for the past three months. By CNBCTV18.com December 3, 2021, 7 17 23 PM IST (Updated) Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan encountered a rather embarrassing moment on Twitter after a parody video criticising his policies for rising inflation was tweeted by Pakistan's Embassy in Serbia. The now-deleted tweet also mentions that the staff at the embassy haven't been paid for the past three months. With inflation breaking all previous records, how long do you expect Imran Khan that we government official will remain silent and keep working for you without being paid for past 3 months and our children been forced out of school due to non-payment of fees. Is this Naya Pakistan?" tweeted the Pakistan embassy in Serbia. Also Read What Pakistan conceded to banned militant group TL P The tweet featured a parody song where a man is heard humming the songs with visuals of Imran Khan saying, Aap ne ghabrana nahi (Don't worry under any circumstances). In the following tweet, the person who tweeted the video apologised to Imran Khan but said that he was left with no other option. The video soon grabbed the attention of many on the internet. While many came out in support of the person who had posted the video, others said that the page might have been hacked. Soon after, the tweets were pulled down and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Pakistan issued a clarification. MoFA in its tweet claimed that the social media pages of the Pak embassy in Serbia were compromised. It disassociated the embassy and its staff from the post and claimed that the Twitter account was 'hacked'. The Twitter, Facebook and Instagram accounts of the Embassy of Pakistan in Serbia have been hacked. Messages being posted on these accounts are not from the Embassy of Pakistan in Serbia. Amid rising prices, Pakistani artist gives musical twist to Imran Khan s Aap ne ghabrana nahi hai From talking about rising prices of flour to medicines, the singer pokes fun at the PM and asks citizens simply to ignore those items, reminding all of Khan's line -- don't panic. As prices of basic commodities continues to soar in Pakistan, a spoof video created by a music composer has tickled many online. Giving a musical twist to Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan s viral Aap ne ghabrana nahi hai line, the artist takes a jibe at the debilitating inflation in the country, and netizens seem to hooked. Written and performed by popular music artist and YouTuber, Saad Alavi, the song is titled Aap ne ghabrana nahi , which translates into don t panic. Drawing inspiration from Khan s line that has inspired many memes in the past, Alavi s song starts with, Sabun mehnga hojaey to aap ne lagana nahin(If soap becomes expensive, don t use it). From talking about rising prices of flour to medicines, the singer pokes fun at the PM and asks citizens simply to ignore those items, reminding all of Khan s line don t panic. Aap paise jama kar kar ke bas tax tum bhaaro phir pet ko patti baandho aur bas bhook se maro (You just save up and pay the tax then tie your stomach and die of hunger), the artist is heard singing in the song. The prime minister went viral for his line, which quickly became a catchphrase to troll him as he urged citizens not to worry in an address to the nation duringcoronaviruspandemic. Aap ne ghabrana nahi hai You should not panic . It is our belief that life and death are in the hands of Allah, he had said in March 2020. Contrary to government projections and market expectations, the cost of goods and services for the public during February rose by 8.7pc, one of the fastest increases in a given month owing mainly to the resurgence of food and electricity prices, the dailyDawnsaid in a report. According to the Sensitive Price Indicator (SPI), inflation for the week ending on March 4, 2021, has shown an increase of over 0.6 percent as compared to the last week of February. This is despite the continued claims of the government that inflation is under control,The News,Pakistan reported.
