Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Best AI Tools for Poster Editing Doston maine aapko niche kuch AI tools bataye hain jo ki aajkal kaafi zyada popular ho rahe hain aur adhikansh log inka istemal karke apni photo banate hain. ChatGPT Google Gemini Canva AI Grok AI Aap bilkul realistic poster bana sakte ho jo ki dekhne mein kaafi kamal ka lagega aur inmein aapko kuch free credits bhi mil jaate hain jinse aap kuch photos create kar sakte ho. How Create Trending Poster Doston to chaliye ab main aapko batata hoon ki kaise aap bhi trending poster bana sakte ho. Sabse pehle aapko article mein diye gaye prompt ko copy kar lena hai. Uske baad kisi bhi image generator AI tool ko open karna hai. Aur wahan par apna koi bhi photo upload karke copy kiye gaye prompt ko paste kar dena hai. Aur send par click karte hi thodi der mein aapka photo bankar ready ho jaega. Jise aap download par click karke apni gallery mein save kar sakte ho. Final Conclusion Doston trending AI poster editing ek trend nahi hai, balki aane wale future mein sabse zyada use hone wala poster editing style hai jise aap sirf prompt likhkar bana sakte ho. Bas aapko apna simple clear face wala photo upload karna hai aur prompt paste karke aap bilkul perfect trending poster create kar sakte ho. Aur agar aap aise hi aur photo edits create karna chahte ho to aapko meri website par kaafi saare alag-alag styles ke prompts mil jaenge jinka istemal karke aap alag-alag style mein apni photo create kar sakte ho. To doston aaj ke article mein itna hi, milte hain agle kisi article mein. Mujhe umeed hai aapko sab kuch samajh mein aa gaya hoga. Agar aapko phir bhi koi problem aati hai photo create karne mein to aapko 2 3 baar try karna hai, tab aapko accha result milega. Thank You

documents: Adsense kon kon se language ko support karta hai? by Anonymous - May 08, 2024 Blog ke jariye earning karne ka best or top most tarika hai ki aap apne blog ke jariye Adsense ke liye apply karo. Adsense approve hone ke bad aap Adsense ke ad ko apne blog par laga kar earning kar sakte ho, or jab koi Adsense ad par click karta hai to issay aapki earning hone lagti hai. Lekin agar aap Adsense ke jariye earning karna chahte ho to sabse pehle aapko ye baat dhyan me rakhni hogi ki Adsense kon kon se bhasha (language) ko support karta hai? 2008 me maine apna blog banaye tha, wajah saf thi ki me bhi Adsense ke jariye earning kar sakta hu. Tab mujhe ye nahi pata tha ki Adsense kon kon se language ko support karta hai. Mere ignorance ki wajah se maine Hindi blog banaya, us samay Hindi blog par competition na ke barabar thi or kuch hi mahino me mere blog par traffic bhi aane lagi thi. Lekin jab maine adsense ke liye apply kiya tab pata chala ki Hindi language ko Adsense support hi nahi karta. Tab me demotivate ho gaye or blogging karna chhod diye. Lekin 2014 me Adsense Hindi blog ko bhi support karne laga hai, agar me blogging continue karta to aaj me bhi problogger me samil ho jata. Aisa aapke sath na ho isliye aaj hum aapko wo sabhi languages ke bare me batane wale hai jo Adsense support karta hai. Lekin sabse pehle aap ye jaan lo ki kyun Adsense sabhi language ko support nahi karti? Kyu Adsense sabhi language ko support nahi karta? Adsense unhi language ko support karta hai jisay wo samajh sake. Me google ki baat nahi kar raha, Google to har language ko samajh sakta hai lekin agar baat ki jaye Adsense ki to Adsense kuch hi language ko samajh pata hai. Adsense contextual ad network hai, yani ki Adsense ke ad aapke blog ke content ke hisab se hi display hoti hai. Or agar Adsense aapke blog content ko samajh hi nahi payegi to wo ad nahi show kar sakti. Jab hum Adsense ka ad code apne blog par lagate hai to sabse pehle wo hamare blog post ko scan karti hai or samajhti hai ki kon sa ad display karna hai. Agar aap aise blog par mehnat kar rahe ho jis language ko ko Adsense support hi nahi karta to aapka blog Adsense ke liye eligible nahi hai. Lekin aisa nahi hai ki future me aapka blog language Adsense support hi na kare. Ho sakta hai ki future me Adsense apne language list me aapke blog language ko bhi add kar le or aapka blog language bhi Adsense ke liye eligible ho jaye. Mere kehne ka matla sirf itna hai ki agar aap apne blog ke jariye Adsense earning karna chahte ho to aapko wo sabhi language ke bare me pata hona chahiye jisay adsense support karti hai. India me bahut se aise language hai jisay Adsense support nahi karti jaise Gujrati, Marathi, Oriya, Punjabi etc. Agar aap aise language be apna blog banaye ho jisay Adsense support hi nahi karta to aap Adsense ke liye apply nahi kar sakte. Ab chaliye aapko wo sabhi languages ke bare me batate hai jisay Adsense support karti hai. Adsense kon kon se language ko support karta hai? Adsense hamesa apne language list ko improve karta hi hai, agar aapka blog language Adsense support nahi karta to niras hone ki jarurat nahi kyunki future me Adsense aapke blog language ko bhi support kar sakta hai. Aaj 27 April 2022 tak Adsense jitne bhi language ko support kar rahi hai uska list humne niche diye gaye screen shot me bataye hai. Arabic Bengali Bulgarian Catalan Chinese (simplified) Chinese (traditional) Croatian 2 Czech Danish Dutch English Estonian Filipino Finnish French German Greek Gujarati Hebrew Hindi Hungarian Indonesian Italian Japanese Kannada Korean Latvian Lithuanian Malay Malayalam Marathi Norwegian Polish Portuguese Punjabi Romanian Russian Serbian Slovak Slovenian Spanish Spanish (Latin American) Swedish Tamil Telugu Thai Turkish Ukrainian Urdu Vietnamese Google Adsense total 50 languages ko support karti hai. Agar baat ki jaye India me to India me Bengali, English, Gujarati, Hindi, Malyalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Urdu language support karti hai. Log hamesa confusion rehti hai ki Hinglish language ko Adsense kon sa language samajhti hai, to friends Adsense Hinglish language ko Hindi hi samajhti hai. Agar aapne Hinglish me blog banaye hua hai to aap Adsense ke liye apply kar sakte ho , bas aapko language me Hindi select karna hoga. Aap hamare blog ko dekh sakte ho hum apne blog par Hinglish language use karte hai, jisay Adsense Hindi language hi samajhti hai. Conclusion Agar aap Adsense ke jariye earning karna chahte ho to aapko blog banane se pehle ye jarur pata hona chahiye ki aap jis language me blog banaye ho ya fir banane wale ho wo language Adsense support karta hai ya nahi, taki aap usi ke hisab se apne blog par kaam kar sako. Friends Adsense hamesa apne supported language list ko update karta rehta hai. June 2018 ko hi Adsense ne announce kiya ki ab Adsense Urdu language ko bhi support karega. Aapko Adsense ke sabhi supported language ki list uske official site par mil jayegi. To friends aaj ka hamara post aapko kaisa laga aap hume comment ke jariye jarur bataye, or agar aapka blog language Adsense support nahi karta to aap uske bare me comment ke jariye jarur bataye taki hum apne blog me uske bare me bhi information de sake. Chrome est un navigateur Web créé par Google et introduit en 2008. Le logiciel d application est écrit en C , fonctionne sur le moteur WebKit et est basé sur le navigateur open source Chromium. Signification et histoire Le logo Chrome est une marque déposée de Google Inc. Cela a changé plusieurs fois, mais le concept général est resté le même un cercle coloré divisé en quatre segments de couleur. 2008 2011 La palette et le design du logo du navigateur Web sont un clin d œil au célèbre lettrage Google qui combine des lettres bleues, rouges, jaunes et vertes dans une forme circulaire. Le logo original de la société mère a été inventé par l entrepreneur et scientifique américain Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin, utilisant GIMP pour mettre en œuvre son idée. La marque de texte multicolore qui est devenue la base du symbole Chrome a été introduite à la fin des années 1990. Près de vingt ans après cet événement, la société a acquis son propre navigateur. Il est apparu en 2008, et avec lui un emblème circulaire de style 3D. Les développeurs ont obtenu un effet tridimensionnel grâce à des transitions de dégradé fluides, des ombres sombres presque noires et des reflets blancs. Cela donne à la surface une apparence lisse et brillante. Le logo Chrome représente une sorte d innovation technologique. À l intérieur se trouve une grosse boule bleue située en plein centre. Le long des bords se trouvent trois panneaux incurvés en relief jaune, vert et rouge. Des sillons gris clair peu profonds sont visibles sur le segment jaune. 2011 2014 En 2011, l emblème 3D a été remplacé par une illustration 2D plate rappelant la nouvelle icône Chromium. Comme l a admis le designer Steve Rura, cela a été fait pour montrer la simplicité, l accessibilité et la vitesse de Chrome. Malgré la simplification importante du graphisme, le dégradé n a pas disparu. Les artistes ont laissé un changement dans les nuances de sombre (sur les bords) à plus clair (plus près du centre). Ce faisant, ils ont placé le cercle bleu dans un large anneau blanc, le séparant des fragments multicolores. Ce logo a été introduit dans Google Chrome 11. Cependant, une icône légèrement différente a été utilisée dans le navigateur de la plate-forme Android 3.0-3.2. Il différait de la version principale par une texture prononcée les développeurs ont changé l emplacement des ombres et ont rendu le dégradé plus lisse, obtenant un effet 3D réaliste. 2014 présent Le logo a été modifié pour la dernière fois en 2014. Le but de la refonte est de repenser les produits Google tout en conservant le style existant. La nouvelle icône Chrome a d abord été introduite dans le système d exploitation mobile Android 5.0 Lollipop (2014), puis dans iOS (2015). En 2017, un logo animé est apparu. Cela se produit lorsque Chrome OS 57 ou version ultérieure est lancé sur des appareils tels que les Chromebooks. Ce logo, en fait, n est pas très différent du précédent. Les concepteurs ont légèrement modifié la palette de couleurs, rendu les bordures des ombres floues et supprimé un dégradé prononcé. L image est désormais 100 2D et suit le concept de simplicité. Il ne rappelle que vaguement le graphique original de 2008, principalement avec sa forme ronde et sa combinaison de couleurs. Police et couleurs du logo La marque déposée de Chrome est une figurine abstraite en forme de disque à plusieurs composants composée d un petit cercle bleu et d un large anneau coloré. Ce dernier, à son tour, est formé de trois segments, dont chacun est clairement délimité et a sa propre couleur. L icône unique rend le navigateur reconnaissable et souligne son identité visuelle. D un point de vue marketing, il s agit d un design réussi qui est devenu un attribut de marque invariable. C est peut-être pour cela que les développeurs n ont jamais changé le concept général, se limitant à des ajustements mineurs de la palette et expérimentant des techniques de conception graphique. Le logo Chrome contient souvent des lettres qui complètent la marque d origine. Leur caractéristique est une simple police sans empattement comme Myriad Pro ou Verdana. Le choix standard des écouteurs s explique par un concept déjà connu chez Google le plus simple sera le mieux. De toute évidence, les développeurs ont décidé de ne pas se concentrer sur le nom du produit, se limitant uniquement à sa mention formelle à côté de l emblème rond. Le lettrage est dans la plupart des cas gris clair, ce qui ne peut pas être dit à propos du symbole principal de Chrome. Il est vibrant et coloré car il combine les quatre couleurs du logo Google à la fois bleu, rouge, jaune et vert. Et peut-être tous les cinq, si vous prenez en compte l anneau blanc au milieu. Dans le même temps, les designers ont joué la palette de manière originale, présentant de nombreuses nuances différentes sous forme de pénombre et de dégradé. Apply Now Who Josef Šálek What 9 38 47 hour(s) minute(s) second(s) Where Czechia (Pilsen) When 20 May 2023 The longest time in an abdominal plank position (male) is 9 hours 38 minutes 47 seconds, achieved by Josef Šálek (Czech Republic also known as Czechia) in Pilsen, Czech Republic, on 20 May 2023. Josef, a therapist, lecturer and personal development coach, completely overhauled his lifestyle before breaking this record. Better known as Joska, he was living what he described as a life of excess and bad health until a life-changing event forced him to rethink everything. He said Five years ago, I was 15 kilos (33 lb) overweight, I used to be fond of alcohol and cigarettes. But a certain life-changing moment brought me to this transformation, so the thing I want to give to the world is that no matter your age, you can just make changes to feel happier, more vital, and healthier. It is, in fact, the very message I wanted to spread by breaking the record. Joska s life story is a remarkable one. Four years before his record attempt, he was detained at passport control in the UAE while travelling to Sri Lanka due to a case of mistaken identity and he was kept in prison for months. He kept his spirits up by sticking to a strict exercise routine. He said I am a happy person today. I am grateful for what I experienced and managed, because today it can inspire many to the fact that it is possible to overcome any unpleasant circumstance and push the physical and mental boundaries beyond the horizons of our imagination. Read all about Joska s incredible record attempt here . HOME NEWS Education NEET Protest 'Main bhi cockroach' New York aur London tak pahuncha - 2024 NEET exam ke khilaf students ka protest international level par pohunch gaya. New York aur London mein students ne 'Main bhi cockroach' slogan se NEET system ke khilaf avaaz uthai. Biplab Biswas Published on 22 Jul 2026 Follow Advertisement NEET ke against chal rahe student protests ab sirf India tak mehboob nahi rahe ye London aur New York tak pahunch gaye hain! Hazar se zyada Indian students jo videshi sheher mein padhai kar rahe hain, unhone streets par utar kar "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare lagaaye hain aur NEET exam system ko leke apna gussa zahir kiya hai. Ye global movement dekh kar sarkari talash ho gai hai, kyunki National Testing Agency ke exam conduct karne ke tareekon ko lekar poore desh mein ek bada shukhna badh gaya hai aur ab videshi universities ke students bhi apna voice uthaane lage hain. Poori Khabar Kya Hai? NEET examination ko leker jo controversy badh gai hai, voh sirf desh ke andar tak simit nahi rahi. Lakho students jo India se bahar padhne gaye hain, unhe bhi iska prabhav pad raha hai kyunki unke parivar aur bhai-bahan jo desh mein hain, unko NEET dena padta hai. Jab se National Testing Agency ne exam conduct karne mein different tareekon ko follow kiya hai, tab se ek alag hi frustration ka mauhaul ban gaya hai. London aur New York mein Indian student communities ne "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare likhe hue placards le kar protests kiye hain, jo ek musical composition ke lyrics se liye gaye hain jo NEET se related ek satire ban gaya hai. Ye "Main bhi cockroach" slogan ek deep comment hai Indian education system aur NTA ke exam conduct ke tareekon par. Students ka kehna hai ki jis tarah cockroaches ko lab mein bekar samjha jata hai, usi tarah NTA unhein bhi sirf statistics samjh raha hai, numbers samjh raha hai, par unke actual learning aur skills ko nahi dekh raha. Jab National Testing Agency lakho students ke marks ko revise karta hai, jab answer keys mein galtiyan aati hain, toh students ko lagta hai ki unhein insaan ki tarah treat nahi kiya ja raha. Video clips aur social media posts se dekha ja sakta hai ki London ke Piccadilly Circus aur New York ke Times Square jaise jagahon par ye protests hue hain. NTA ke under NEET exam hota hai jo medical colleges mein admission ke liye zaruri hai. Pichle kuch mahine mein NEET ke marks mein jo modifications ane hain, jo grace marks diye gaye hain, jo ek saath multiple answer keys banaye gaye hain sab kuch mein ek bada jhoomla hai. Students ke hisaab se transparency nahi hai, sabka fairness nahi hai, aur jo topper ban gaye hain, unhe bhi shubh nahi hai kyunki unhe lagta hai ki shayad unhe galti se marks zyada mil gaye hain ya phir doosre ko kam mil gaye hain. Isse jo psychological pressure create hua hai, uspar ye global protests utha hai. Videshi sheher se ye protest signal bhej rahe hain ki NEET issue sirf ek local matter nahi raha. Agar lakho students jo abroad hain aur apne sapne poore kar rahe hain, ve bhi apne desh ke exam system ke khilaaf bolne ke liye bahar aaye, toh samajho ki problem kitna bada hai. International media ne bhi inn protests ko cover kiya hai, aur ye India ke education system par ek global spotlight ban gaya hai. Students kehte hain ki jab tak NTA ne NEET conduct karne ke tareekon ko transparent aur fair nahi banaya, tab tak ye protests chalte rahenge. Key Highlights Global Reach NEET protests London, New York aur doosre videshi sheher tak pahunch gaye hain jahaan large Indian student population hai Slogan "Main bhi cockroach" students ke gussa aur frustration ka symbol ban gaya hai jo NTA ke exam system ke khilaaf ek strong message de raha hai NTA ke Issues Multiple answer keys, grace marks, score revisions, aur transparency ki kami ke karan students mein ek bada distrust hai Student Base Hazaron Indian students jo videshi universities mein padhe hue hain, unhe apne family members ke NEET scores ko leker chinta hai International Coverage Global media networks ne in protests ko cover kiya hai aur India ke education system par international attention aa gaya hai Psychological Impact NEET takers ko ek bada stress aur anxiety feel ho raha hai kyunki unhe pata nahi ki final score kya hoga aur kab announce hoga Demand for Transparency Students chahte hain ki National Testing Agency sara detailed analysis public kare, har question ke liye explanation de, aur clear guidelines set kare Youth Frustration Symbol Ye protests sirf NEET tak nahi, balki Indian education system ke poore structure par ek bada sawaal ubhaara hai Advertisement Kisko Milega Fayda? Iss global movement se directly jo faida mil sakta hai voh hai medical education ko leker ek alag tarah ki consciousness create hona. Jab lakho students poore duniya se ek issue ko highlight kar rahi hain, toh sarkari vibhag ko sunna padta hai. NEET ke through jo lakho students har saal medical colleges mein admission lena chahte hain, unhe agar ye protests successful hote hain toh ek transparent aur fair system mil payega. Aaj jo NEET exam de raha hai, voh ek chota student nahi hai, uska ek international connection hai, uska voice international stage par suna ja sakta hai isse NTA ko samajhna padega ki exam conduct mein ek bada responsibility hai. Medical profession se jude 15-16 lakh students jo har saal NEET dete hain, unhe sab se zyada faida milega. Agar ye global movement se transparency aaye aur answer keys saaf-sutra ho jayen, toh future generations ko ek better examination experience milega. NEET ke marks par lakho students aur un ke parivar ke sapne depend karte hain. Jab scores revise hote hain, tab unhe lagta hai ki unhe na-insaafi hui hai. Agar protests se ye badlav aaye ki NTA apne processes ko improve kare, aapne training de, aapne double-check system banaye, toh lakho students ko aage faida milega. Indian government aur Ministry of Education ko bhi isse ek signal milega ki youth ko education system ke bare mein kitni chinta hai. Global level par agar India ke exam system ko lekar controversy ho raha hai, toh ye desh ke talent aur credibility ko affect karta hai. Videshi universities mein jo Indian students padhte hain, ve apne desh ko represent karte hain. Agar unhone videshi sheher mein streets par uttar kar protest kiya, toh iska matlab hai ki system mein kuch fundamental problems hain jo solve hone zaruri hain. International reputation ke liye bhi Indian government ko respond karna padega. Zaroori Dates aur Timeline Event Date Period Details NEET Exam Controversies Shuru 2024 - Mid Year Multiple answer keys aur score revisions se frustration badha Grace Marks Announcement 2024 NTA ne kuch students ko grace marks diye jo baki students ko unfair laga Domestic Protests Intensify 2024 Poore desh mein college aur school ke students ne roads par protesting shuru kiya Global Protests Begin 2024 - Recent London, New York aur other international cities mein Indian students ne "Main bhi cockroach" protests organize kiye International Media Coverage 2024 - Current Global news channels ne Indian education system par criticism ki Ongoing Demands Abhi Complete transparency, answer key justification, aur NTA accountability ke liye chhoti-chhoti protests chalti rahin Sarkar Vibhag ka Aadhikarik Bayaan National Testing Agency ne apne official statements mein kaha hai ki NEET exam conduct mein transparency aur fairness sabse zaroori hai. NTA ke representatives ne media mein bola hai ki jab bhi koi error ya discrepancy dekha gaya hai, unhone usse immediately address kiya hai. Agency ke hisaab se, grace marks dena sirf un students ko tha jinhe exam conduct mein technical issues face karne pade. Score revisions ke bare mein NTA kahta hai ki scientific method se ye kiya gaya tha aur har student ke liye fair tha. Sarkari level se bhi Ministry of Education ne kaha hai ki NEET system India mein sabse transparent aur merit-based system hai, lekin students ke grievances ko seriously liya ja raha hai aur further improvements par kaam chal raha hai. Advertisement Important Details at a Glance Aspect Information Exam Name National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) Conducting Authority National Testing Agency (NTA) Purpose Medical colleges mein MBBS aur BDS courses ke liye admission Annual Candidates Approximately 15-16 lakh students Main Controversy Multiple answer keys, grace marks, score revisions, transparency kami Protest Symbol "Main bhi cockroach" systemic dehumanization ka representation Geographic Spread India ke ander plus London, New York, aur other international cities Student Demand Complete transparency, detailed explanation of marking, uniform answer keys Aage Kya Hoga? Aage ke months mein ye protests aur bhi vocal ho sakte hain kyunki jo momentum iss global movement ne create ki hai, voh rokna mushkil hai. International students jo apne desh ke liye iska voice ban gaye hain, unhe support milega apne colleges aur universities se. Faculty members, international student organizations, aur even some foreign governments Indian education system ko lekar questions pooch sakte hain. NEET exam ke next year ke conduct mein NTA ko behti-soch-samajh kar decision lena padega. Agar 2025 mein bhi same tarah issues aaye, toh protests aur bhi bade hote jayenge. Government level par bhi iska impact padega. Sarkaari committees aur education ministry ko NEET system ke liye ek complete audit karna padega. Technical issues, human error, aur systematic problems sab ko identify karna padega aur ek robust system develop karna padega. Isse pehle ke exam conduct mein NTA ko apne QA QC processes ko strengthen karna chahiye. Students ke complaints ko ek structured mechanism ke through handle karna chahiye taaki transparency baniye rahe. Individual students jo NEET de rahe hain aur Jo future mein denge, unhe ye advice hai ki apne scores ko leker anxiety mein pad jayen toh isse no point hai. Jo kiya hai wo kiya hai, ab apne appeals aur grievance redressal process ko utilize karna chahiye. Agar kisi ko genuinely koi issue nazar aaye apne paper checking mein, toh NTA ke official website par detailed review request karna chahiye. Exam mein har question par ek answer key available hona chahiye with justification, aur uss par agar question mark hain toh official appeal file karna chahiye. Aksar Pooche Jaane Wale Sawaal Q1 "Main bhi cockroach" ka matlab kya hai? Ye ek symbolic statement hai jiska matlab ye hai ki students ko NTA unhe humans ki tarah value nahi de raha sirf statistics samjh raha hai. Cockroach lab experiment ka subject hote hain aur inhein scientific experiments mein use kiya jata hai. Students ye kehna chahte hain ki unhe same way treat kiya ja raha hai jaise lab specimens ko, unke individual concerns ignore ho rahe hain, sirf data collection chal raha hai. Ye phrase ekdum harsh criticism hai exam system ka. Q2 NEET scores revise kyun hote hain? Jab exam conduct ke baad NTA ko kisi question mein scientific error ya multiple valid answers mil jayein, toh voh answer key ko revise karte hain. Isse jo students affected hote hain, unhe grace marks diye jate hain. However, students ka point hai ki ye grace marks system arbitrary hai kisi ko mil gaya, kisi ko nahi. Transparency nahi hai kaunse exactly questions ko revise kiya gaya aur kyu, aur grace marking criteria kya tha. Q3 Videshi countries mein kyu ye protests ho rahe hain? Indian diaspora pura duniya mein phela hai. Jo students videshi universities mein padhe hue hain, unke younger siblings, cousins, aur family members ko India mein NEET dena padta hai. Jab apne gharwalon ke scores niyay karne wale system ko unfair dekha, toh unhone apna voice uthaaya. Plus, unhe videshi countries mein freedom of expression ka advantage hai jo unhe apni taraf India mein possible nahi hota. Q4 Kya NEET exam system badlega? Ye baat ki confirm nahi hai, lekin international pressure aur domestic protests se NTA ko zaroor apni processes improve karne padenge. Jo students demand kar rahe hain transparency, detailed answer explanations, grievance redressal mechanism ye sab reasonable hain. Sarkar ko bhi social unrest dekh kar respond karna padega. Changes slow hote hain, lekin ye momentum continue rahegi. Q5 Abhi NEET dene wale students ko kya karna chahiye? Apni preparation par focus rakhni chahiye aur exam mein apna best performance dena chahiye. Agar exam ke baad kisi ko kisi answer key par doubt ho, toh official review request file karna chahiye. Isme himmat mat haar system mein problems ho sakte hain, lekin individual effort se success milti hai. Apne score announce hone se pehle padhna mat chhod har mark matters. Advertisement Closing NEET protest jo "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare ke saath London aur New York tak pahuncha hai, voh sirf ek exam issue nahi hai ye India ke education system, student welfare, aur governance ko lekar ek bada global conversation hai. Lakho students unke dreams pursue karte hain, unhe fair aur transparent system deserve hai. Abhi jo protesting ho rahe hain aur jo government mein hain, dono ko bahut seriously iss issue ko lena chahiye. Students apne scores, apne future, apne rights ke liye apni awaaz uthaao, lekin registered aur structured tareekon se. Government aur NTA listen karo, respond karo, aur ek truly transparent exam system banao jo sabko capable banaye bina discrimination ke. Sabhi students ke liye advice National Testing Agency ki official website nta.ac.in par visit karo, apne scores aur answer keys check karo, agar koi issue ho toh official grievance portal mein appeal karo. Apne education aur apne future ko seriously lo, kyunki ye tumhara hi responsibility hai. Baaki, ye global movement ensure karega ki system mein change zaroor aayega sirf Time ka sawaal hai. Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. भारतीय जनता पार्टी की स्थापना 1980 में हुई थी. यह पार्टी भारतीय लोकतंत्र को बनाने वाले सबसे बड़े राजनीतिक दलों में से एक है. यह केंद्र और राज्यों दोनों में अपनी मौजूदगी के हिसाब से देश की सबसे बड़ी पार्टी है. यह प्राथमिक सदस्यता के मामले में दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा राजनीतिक दल भी है. इस पार्टी ने देश को दो प्रधानमंत्री दिए हैं, 1996 में पीएम अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी और 2014 में पीएम नरेंद्र मोदी. इस पार्टी का चुनावी चिन्ह कमल का फूल है और रंग भगवा (BJP). साल 1977 में आपातकाल के बाद जनसंघ अन्य दलों के साथ विलय हो गया. लगभग तीन साल के बाद 1980 में जनता पार्टी विघटित हो गई और भारतीय जनता पार्टी का निर्माण किया गया. भाजपा आधिकारिक तौर पर अभिन्न मानवतावाद पर काम करती है, जिसे 1965 में दीनदयाल उपाध्याय द्वारा तैयार किया गया था. भाजपा की उत्पत्ति भारतीय जनसंघ से हुआ है, जिसकी स्थापना 1951 में श्यामा प्रसाद मुखर्जी ने प्रमुख कांग्रेस पार्टी की राजनीति के जवाब में की थी. यह हिंदू राष्ट्रवादी स्वयंसेवी संगठन, राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ (RSS) के सहयोग से स्थापित किया गया था, और व्यापक रूप से आरएसएस की राजनीतिक शाखा के रूप में माना जाता था (BJP Formation). भारतीय जनता पार्टी की विचारधारा एकात्म मानववाद सबसे पहले 1965 में दीनदयाल उपाध्याय ने दी थी (BJP Slogan). नरेंद्र मोदी, वर्तमान प्रधानमंत्री, जो एक बेहद लोकप्रिय नेता भी हैं और जो पहले गुजरात के मुख्यमंत्री थे, ने 2014 के आम चुनावों में भाजपा को शानदार जीत दिलाई और तब से पीछे मुड़कर नहीं देखा. पार्टी 2019 में ऐतिहासिक जनादेश के साथ फिर से सत्ता में आई (PM Narendra Modi). भाजपा राष्ट्रवादी सिद्धांतों पर केंद्रित विदेश नीति की वकालत करती है. अनुच्छेद 370 को निरस्त करने, अयोध्या में राम मंदिर के बहुप्रतीक्षित निर्माण, ट्रिपल तलाक विरोधी अधिनियम, नागरिकता संशोधन अधिनियम और बालाकोट हवाई हमले के संबंध में इसके प्रमुख निर्णय ऐतिहासिक रहे हैं (BJP Work). भाजपा सोशल मीडिया पर भी सक्रिय रहती है. इनका ऑफिशियल ट्विटर हैंडल BJP4India है और फेसबुक पेज का नाम Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). यह इंस्टाग्राम पर bjp4india यूजरनेम से है. 'कांग्रेस को Gen-G की चिंता रही, हमें Gen-Z की...', राहुल गांधी पर BJP का वार बीजेपी सांसद संबित पात्रा ने प्रेस कॉन्फ्रेंस कर कहा कि दिल्ली में छात्रों पर गोली नहीं चली. राहुल संसद में झूठ का पुलिंदा लेकर आए थे. उनके पास किसी तरह के तथ्य नहीं थे. गोली चलाने की बात झूठ है. उन्होंने सदन में झूठ बोला और देश को भ्रमित करने की कोशिश की. 'गोली चली ही नहीं, सिर्फ टियर गैस चली', संसद में विपक्ष के आरोपों पर बोले जितेंद्र सिंह लोकसभा में एंटी पेपर लीक बिल पर बहस के दौरान जितेंद्र सिंह ने राहुल गांधी और प्रियंका गांधी के दावों को तथ्यहीन बताया. उन्होंने कहा कि दिल्ली प्रोटेस्ट में गोली नहीं चली थी, सिर्फ टियर गैस का इस्तेमाल हुआ. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch).
